### Consumer-visible native proof

A temporary deterministic real-renderer fixture uses one mutable `CanvasTexture2D` in both straight PBR and premultiplied legacy cache domains, on two separately visible quads. Each antialias=false/true sequence renders cold, repeat hit, version update, updated hit, resize 8→16, resized hit, restore 16→8, destroyed source and explicit static fallback. It verifies both halves change on update/resize, hit equality, byte-exact original restoration, zero draws for the destroyed source and two fallback draws. Destruction is observed through public visibility; it does not directly test the private destroyed guard. The fallback is borrowed and survives scene/renderer destruction.

Canonical source and isolated-built ESM dist each pass on native GL and GPU against preserved P230 source/dist: 18 frames per page, 72 paired frames, 4,718,592 RGBA bytes plus 13 stable counters per frame byte/equality compared. Both domains change 2,652 pixels each on update and resize for GL both AA branches and GPU without AA; GPU with AA changes 2,703 per half. Restorations are exact, validation scopes/graphics events and page errors remain empty. The earlier isolated source prototype passed the same 36 frame pairs separately; it is not double-counted in the canonical total.

A separate GPU negative control suppresses only existing-texture version upload. The real consumer fails exactly on the third frame `version-update` with `One cache domain missed source version update: 0,0`, after successful cold/hit frames; no setup/page error substitutes for that expected failure.

Official unchanged effects pass 24 scenarios each on source/dist × GL/GPU (96 cases). Both official showcase backends switch Scene A→B and pass pagehide cleanup instrumentation with no page errors. The dist texture surface and GPU showcase PNG were opened and visually inspected. This does not newly certify compressed-format devices, other browsers, Canvas2D, audible audio/unlock, new texture formats or performance on physical devices.

### Checks, artifacts and delivery

TypeScript check, 71 tests in four existing files (`material-finish`, `native-pbr-material`, `resource-residency`, `resilient-renderer`), changed-source ESLint and Prettier pass. Isolated production build minifies 377 JS files and creates the CJS tree (720 files); only five GPU module ESM/CJS/maps/declaration outputs are promoted after pre-copy byte guards. The declaration change is exactly one added private helper; public API unchanged. User-owned physics/world2d source/dist outputs are not staged or overwritten.

README (Chinese/English/Japanese note), PLAN, DESIGN and both technical references are synchronized; historical ACCEPTANCE bytes are preserved by append only. Temporary fixtures/profiles/services are cleaned before the feature-only commit. No push, version bump, added permanent test or full-suite/browser/device recertification.

## P233 — GPU mesh residency callback scope (2026-11-15)

### Scope and fixed protocol

Baseline `267e05fc2` (P232). `cacheMesh` keeps its byte estimate and nullish existing-allocation reuse; only a miss calls private `allocateMesh(object, bytes)`. Callback tokens are asserted equal after whitespace normalization: uniform, visible instance/colors, instance colors, palette and influences destruction; instance destruction only when not the shared identity buffer; mesh entry deletion. ### Native budget eviction and recreation consumer

A deterministic public-renderer fixture uses ordinary Mesh, colored/partly culled InstancedMesh, and SkinnedMesh with four/eight influences. Each case proves a visible cold frame and stable hit; a retained-frame lease rejects geometryBytes=0 atomically without changing the current bytes/budget; a retained draw remains exact; releasing the lease allows a real zero-byte geometry budget to retire all resident geometry/mesh allocations. The same live object is then rendered/recreated with byte-exact original pixels and a stable hit. Public material color, instance matrix/color/visibility or joint pose updates must change at least 100 pixels. A second budget eviction and recreation restores those updated pixels exactly; a third eviction leaves zero live bytes/entries before scene disposal. Reusing the same renderer across all cases also exercises preservation of its shared identity buffer.

Canonical source/dist × native GL/GPU pass against preserved P232 source/dist: 38 frames/page, 152 paired frames, 9,961,472 RGBA bytes plus 13 deterministic counters/frame exactly equal between before/after, with empty initial/final pixel and geometry baselines. Each page has four lease rejections and twelve real budget-eviction operations. Original isolated source prototype passes another 76 pairs, not double-counted in canonical totals. Data below is after/source (dist observations match). Byte counts are tracked residency estimates, not total VRAM; zero is measured before final renderer destruction.

### Canonical color/shadow/lifecycle consumers

Retained native fixtures cover sorted radix/insertion boundaries (160→140→5→0→130), empty/restore, ordering/material transitions, membership removal/re-addition, weighted repeat/sorted restoration, and injected sort failure followed by same-frame recovery and subsequent rendering. Both antialias branches run. Offscreen shadow fixtures cover a color-culled caster's visible shadow, move, cache hit, castsShadow toggles and membership restoration, so union/drawn-prefix semantics cannot be replaced by color membership alone.

Canonical source/dist × GL/GPU pass against preserved P233 source/dist: 32 lifecycle plus 16 shadow frames/page, 192 paired frames, 12,582,912 RGBA bytes and 13 stable render counters/frame exactly equal. The temporary fixtures additionally record and compare four public live residency counters per frame (geometry/texture bytes and entries), not merely pixels. Original source prototype passes another 96 pairs, not double-counted in canonical totals.

### Auxiliary capture and formal runtime

The existing unchanged source material-lifecycle fixture runs eight real combined-resource cycles on one native GPU renderer before and after (16 cycles total), including planar reflection capture followed by normal rendering. Every cycle visibly renders nine draws, changes 6,651 animated pixels, and returns all six measured live/attachment counters to the warmed zero baseline before renderer destruction. Both variants observe peaks of 60,160 texture bytes/18 entries, 62,544 geometry bytes/14 entries and 3,145,728 attachment bytes (tracked sum 3,268,432); these are tracked estimates, not total VRAM. The auxiliary fixture validates each variant's own baseline, not a new cross-variant pixel golden or GPU-loss recovery certification.

Official unchanged effects pass 24 scenarios on each source/dist × GL/GPU page (96 cases). Both official showcase backends switch Scene A→B and pass pagehide cleanup instrumentation without page errors. The actual native GPU combined-resource/capture PNG is opened and visually inspected. No new physical-device/browser, Canvas2D, probe-face readback, audible audio/unlock, GPU destructive-loss or performance certification beyond the measured cohorts is implied.

### Checks, source maps and delivery

Exact source comparison initially stopped the check command before tests because Prettier had collapsed the now-shorter drawn-prefix ternary in the measured prototype. Only that ternary formatting was corrected; the exact formatted source then passes TypeScript, 49 existing tests across draw-order/render-visibility/shadow-cache/resource-residency/resilient-renderer, ESLint and Prettier. No benchmark rerun. The isolated build is refreshed from the exact formatted source so source maps match it (377 minified JS, 720 CJS tree files). Four GPU ESM/CJS JS/map outputs are promoted after byte guards; the declaration remains byte-identical.

README Chinese/English/Japanese note, PLAN, DESIGN and both technical references are synchronized. ACCEPTANCE is append-only, preserving its historical prefix. User-owned physics/world2d source/dist outputs are not overwritten or staged. Owned temporary fixtures/services/profiles/build staging are cleaned before feature-only commit; no push, version bump, permanent test addition or unrun full-suite certification.

## P235 — GPU unseen geometry pruning visitor (2026-11-15)

### Scope and protocol

Baseline `3449c7421` (P234). With the default infinite geometry budget, `releaseUnused()` visited the geometry and mesh caches with two `for…of` loops over `Map.values()`. It now calls `Map.forEach` with one prototype visitor and explicit `this`, `releaseUnseenGeometry(entry)`. The release condition (`seen !== frame` and no residency references), geometry-before-mesh order and finite-budget skip are unchanged. Deletion while visiting follows Map semantics: deleted entries not yet reached are skipped exactly as the iterator would skip them. No new state field, cache, parameter container, dependency or public API; GL code is unchanged.

An earlier P235 candidate, moving the cold geometry residency retire callback into a private allocator, was measured with the same fixed protocol and **not adopted**: total sampled-byte medians moved only −0.85% shared/−1.21% distinct-maps, one paired total grew, and GPU CPU medians were mixed. No source, dist or documentation behavior changed for that rejected trial.

Pinned Playwright-managed Chromium 153.0.8010.12, darwin/arm64, desktop automation. Fixed six fresh ABBA rounds × eight workloads × before/after × GL/GPU, 24 synchronous full submits per row (192 CPU rows), completed before heap sampling. No favorable-result retiming. Clocks measure CPU submit, not RAF/presentation/GPU completion or FPS.

### Canonical pruning consumers

A temporary public-API fixture draws 17 frames per backend: initial empty; six objects (three meshes sharing one geometry, a distinct-geometry mesh, a three-instance mesh and a one-joint skinned mesh); stable hit; removal of one shared user, then of all shared users; restoration of all members; a retained frame lease while every member is removed, then lease release; reload; a finite 64 MiB geometry budget with all members removed (kept), then return to infinity (retired); partial membership growing back to the full scene; scene removal plus destruction of a mesh with exclusive geometry; and an empty final scene. WebGPU asserts the exact public geometry counters at each step; GL asserts the same pixel restorations while using its own residency accounting. ## P236 — Reject GPU render-mesh observation visitor (2026-11-15)

### Scope and decision

Baseline `581f647c5` (P235). The measured prototype replaced the per-frame `for (const mesh of scene.renderMeshes ?? emptyMeshes)` observation loop in the WebGPU mesh pipeline with `scene.renderMeshes?.forEach(this.observeRenderMesh, this)` and one private prototype visitor, removing the then-unused `emptyMeshes` constant. The visitor body was byte-for-byte the former loop body (lazy occlusion backend, base-texture version stamp, native-material depth revision), so semantics did not change. **It is not adopted.** Only this evidence-and-rejection record is committed; source and `dist` stay at P235.

Reasons: the six paired total sampled-byte changes range from −2.58% to +0.70% (median −1.97% shared, −1.93% distinct-maps), one pair is worse, the native `next` reduction (≈1.3 MB) is largely replaced by +1.1 MB in `render` self sampling, and GPU CPU clocks are mixed (−6.59% to +5.26%). Compared with P235 (−26.8%, all six pairs lower with a mechanism visible in the stacks), this is not a material, reproducible improvement and does not justify another private method and deleting a shared constant.

Pinned Playwright-managed Chromium 153.0.8010.12, darwin/arm64, desktop automation. Fixed six fresh ABBA rounds × eight workloads × before/after × GL/GPU, 24 synchronous full submits per row (192 CPU rows), completed before heap sampling. GL code is unchanged. Clocks measure CPU submit, not RAF/presentation/GPU completion or FPS.

#### Rejected upper-bound experiment: skipping the GL per-material uniform/texture block for repeated material and program

The WebGL2 color phase repeats about forty cached uniform calls and a dozen texture-unit lookups for every mesh even when consecutive meshes share the same material and program, and `drawMeshes` self time plus the cached uniform wrappers amount to up to roughly a quarter of the shared GL frame in the profile above. A throwaway prototype skipped the base-texture, PBR-uniform and PBR-texture-unit block when both the material and the program equalled the previous executed draw of the phase. It was measured only as an upper bound with six fresh ABBA rounds of 600 warm-up plus 2,500 synchronous steady-state frames (2,000 draws each, same scene):

| Round | Before ms/frame | After ms/frame | Change % |
| ----- | --------------- | -------------- | -------- |
| 1     | 0.9632          | 0.9321         | -3.23    |
| 2     | 0.9808          | 0.9268         | -5.51    |
| 3     | 0.9795          | 0.9496         | -3.05    |
| 4     | 0.9770          | 0.9383         | -3.96    |
| 5     | 0.9918          | 0.9396         | -5.26    |
| 6     | 1.0596          | 0.9502         | -10.33   |

Median 0.9802 → 0.9390 ms/frame (−4.20%). Even in the most favorable shared-material workload and ignoring correctness, the whole block is worth about 4%, while safe reuse would require proving that nothing between draws changes those uniforms or texture units and that unversioned mutable `PBRMaterial` fields (no version/dirty counter exists in `pbr-material.ts`) cannot change within a frame. That risk is not justified by about 4% of one fallback backend; the prototype was discarded, never reached source or `dist`, and is not an adopted behavior.

### Checks and delivery

No source or `dist` change. Rejected prototypes ran only through temporary Vite overrides and were deleted with their fixtures, profiles and services. README Chinese/English/Japanese note, PLAN, DESIGN and both technical references record the rejection. ACCEPTANCE is append-only, preserving its historical prefix. User-owned physics/world2d source/dist outputs are not overwritten or staged; no push, version bump, permanent test addition or full-suite certification is implied.

## P237 — Scalar soft-body stretch projection (2026-11-17)

### Scope and decision

Only the private SoftBody3D stretch-projection loop changes. Spring differences and scaled corrections use scalar locals instead of overwriting the shared Vector3 scratch for every spring on every iteration. Magnitude still calls the existing robust hypot3 with the same three differences; correction multiplication, inverse masses, pin handling, spring order and iteration count retain their original arithmetic order. Force accumulation, integration, rigid-world sweeps, validation and mesh upload are unchanged. No approximate magnitude, new cache, public API, tunable, dependency or version change.

A baseline Node CPU profile of a 32×32 cloth over a real plane (600 warm-up plus 2,400 updates, 100 µs sampling) attributed about 26% to step self time and 8% to hypot3. This only ranked work and includes profiler overhead; it is not the speedup measurement. Two earlier candidates were rejected before the scalar change, as recorded below.

### Complete public-update CPU boundary

Node v26.7.0 and pinned Playwright Chromium 153.0.8010.12, darwin/arm64. Isolated before/after source modules are transpiled by TypeScript 6.0.3 to ES2022 and share the same production dist dependencies. Each sample constructs a fresh SoftBody3D with horizontal/vertical cloth springs, a real PhysicsWorld3D and PlaneCollider3D; its first row is pinned and the first anchor oscillates each update. The measured operation is pin plus public update(1/240), including force, integration, stretch projection, pose snapshot and actual engine sphere sweeps against the plane. There is no mesh or renderer in this CPU workload; mesh upload, GPU work, RAF and presentation FPS are not timed. Fixture construction and destruction are outside the timer.

Each of six rounds uses ABBA, alternating to BAAB on even rounds; every sample has 600 warm-up and 1,200 timed updates. Pair values average the two samples for that variant; summary values are medians of the six pair values. The small/cloth16/cloth32 cases use 4×4/16×16/32×32 particles, four projection iterations and maxStretch 1.2. tight32 uses maxStretch 1; iter1 and iter16 use one/sixteen iterations at 32×32. Browser document visibility was visible and page errors were empty; no profiling/build/tests ran concurrently with these timings.

## P238 — Scalar soft-body spring forces (2026-11-17)

### Scope and CPU boundary

Only the spring-force loop changes: differences, normalized direction and relative velocity use scalar locals instead of the shared Vector3 scratch. It still uses the same robust hypot3, the same length <1e-12 early exit, reciprocal then component multiplication, stiffness/damping expression, force accumulation and arithmetic order. P237 stretch projection, integration, collision sweeps, mesh upload, public API and ownership remain unchanged. No extra state, cache, approximate math, dependency or version change.

## P239 — Reject precomputed soft-body drag attenuation (2026-11-17)

### Candidate and decision

An isolated candidate replaced the private drag scalar with an attenuation scalar computed once after validating readonly fixedDelta: exp(-drag*fixedDelta). The particle integration loop loaded that factor instead of expressing exp(-drag*dt) per particle. No extra field was added and step always receives fixedDelta. Constructor validation order otherwise stayed intact. This candidate is **not adopted**: typical medians move only around 0–2%, paired clocks are mixed and Chromium cloth16/iter1 get slower. A reduced source-level Math.exp count is not evidence that compiled execution, CPU cost or allocations materially improve. Formal source, declarations, tests and dist remain at P238.

### Complete public-update CPU measurements

One pinned particle with no springs is the unchanged-loop control (10,000 warm-up /120,000 timed updates). Tables contain six-pair medians and per-round averages of two samples per variant, in CPU wall ms/update. Browser visible; page errors empty. No assistant-owned test/build/profile ran during timing.

## P240 — Reject scalar soft-body integration (2026-11-17)

### Candidate and decision

An isolated candidate expanded particle integration into scalar component operations. It stopped overwriting private force/displacement scratch during integration, because forces are reset at the start of every substep and collideParticles overwrites displacement before each sweep. Public velocity additions, the original per-particle exp(-drag*dt), velocity scaling and position additions retained their arithmetic order. There was no P239 precomputed attenuation, extra state, API or approximate math.

**Not adopted.** Node default cloth medians improve about 6–7%, but this is a browser engine: initial Chromium timings have mixed pairs and only small gains. A separate longer browser comparison still shows only about 1.17% lower median and a +3.68% pair. The Node-only improvement does not establish a material repeatable browser win, and does not justify replacing readable vector operations. Source, dist and permanent tests remain at P238; P239 was documentation-only.

### Complete public-update measurements

Same independent ES2022 modules /TypeScript 6.0.3 and same production dependencies, Node v26.7.0 and pinned Chromium 153.0.8010.12 darwin/arm64. Full moving-anchor pin +update(1/240), including actual rigid-plane sphere sweeps; no mesh upload/renderer. Node uses heterogeneous masses, browser mass 1. Same seven workload definitions as P238: four iterations/stretch 1.2 by default, small/cloth16/cloth32 =4×4/16×16/32×32, tight32 stretch 1, iter1/iter16 one/sixteen iterations. Unchanged no-springs control is one pinned particle.

Six counterbalanced ABBA/BAAB rounds. Each ordinary sample has 600 warm-up /1,200 timed updates; control 10,000 /120,000. Pair values average two samples per variant and summaries are six-pair medians, CPU wall ms/update. Setup/destruction excluded, browser visible, page errors empty. No assistant-owned build/test/profile ran during measurement.

## P241 — Exact navmesh edge-distance component pruning (2026-11-17)

### Scope and numerical contract

The private nearest boundary helper still computes each edge's clamped closest point exactly as before. It eagerly computes all three coordinate differences, preserving point getter read order/count, then skips robust hypot3 only when an absolute component is strictly greater than the best edge distance already found. A full Euclidean norm cannot be smaller than any component. Equal-distance cases, exact hypot arithmetic, stable edge order and the first winner remain unchanged. This follows the existing graph projection component-bound convention without adding bounds metadata, approximate squared norms, cache/state, public API or dependencies.

Both public project and budgeted createSearch endpoint projection already use this helper, so no caller/alias is left behind. Polygon candidate visitation/counts, radius-clipped regions, enabled-state revisions, path scheduling/work budgets, outputs and ownership do not change.

A baseline Node CPU profile of 50,000 warmed quad48-r02 queries (100 µs interval) measured 5.58 µs/query including profiler overhead: self samples included project 70,548 µs, nearest 64,501 µs, candidate generator 45,882 µs and hypot3 36,848 µs. It ranked costs only, not candidate speed.

### Complete public-query CPU boundary

Node v26.7.0 and pinned Playwright Chromium 153.0.8010.12, darwin/arm64; TypeScript 6.0.3 ES2022 before/after modules share production dependencies. Node and browser import the same throwaway workload module. All surfaces are real NavigationMesh3D instances, two-logical-unit cells, tileSize 8; polygon construction/cleanup outside timing. Each variant/case warms 4,096 project calls or 128 findPath calls once, then six ABBA/BAAB rounds time 4,096 public projections or 128 complete findPath queries per sample. Point pools cycle through 128 deterministic positions; path endpoints cycle eight pairs. Pair values average two samples/variant and summary values take medians of six pairs, CPU wall ms/query.

Cases: one unchanged-path square interior (no boundary loop); 48×48 quads with radius 0 or 0.2; exterior points beside a 48×48 mesh; continuous planar slope; two stacked 24×24 floors; 24×24 split triangles; complete short paths on a 12×12 quad mesh. All but the explicitly zero-radius cases use radius 0.2, agent height 1.4, maxDistance 1 and maxVerticalDistance 0.5. No renderer/RAF/GPU work is timed. Browser document visible and page errors empty; no assistant-owned build/test/profile during candidate timing.

### Behavioral, packaging and delivery evidence

- Canonical source and production ESM each exactly match the isolated unchanged baseline for 2,048 projections, 64 complete paths and seven point-getter trace cases. Histories vary radius, enabled polygons and points over quads/triangles/slopes/stacked floors and preserve saved output snapshots, IDs, coordinates, distance, revision, candidate count, visited nodes, cost and waypoint values.
- CJS initially failed strict object comparison solely because its Vector3 prototype differs from the ESM baseline prototype; all printed numeric/structural values were identical. The CJS comparison was corrected to recursively compare all own values while retaining exact Numbers (including signed zero), and also verifies frozen projection/position plus vector clone values. The same 2,048 projections /64 paths /seven getter traces pass; no engine change was made to hide the harness mismatch.

## P242 — Reject deferred navmesh projection materialization (2026-11-17)

### Candidate and decision

An isolated candidate replaces per-winning-polygon projection records with four local winner fields, capturing the winning revision at the same point, and freezes/materializes only the final public projection/position. The original nearest helper, candidate iteration, distances, stable ties, radius regions and job algorithms remain unchanged. Intermediate private projection records/freeze calls appear avoidable, but this is not evidence of a measured allocation/heap or CPU gain.

A fresh baseline profile after P241, 10,000 warm +50,000 profiled positive-radius quad projections at 100 µs sampling, measured 5.49 µs/query including profiler overhead. Self samples ranked project 78,601 µs, nearest 74,087 µs, candidate iteration 44,001 µs and hypot3 27,583 µs; the profile ranked investigation targets only. No candidate profiler ran during paired CPU timing.

The actual browser result rejects the candidate: ordinary positive-radius quads regress 4.80%, zero-radius quads 10.35%, outside queries 8.30%, slope 8.74% and stacked floors 8.72%, with all six paired values worse in each of those cases. Node's roughly 1–3% gains on several cases do not justify a browser-engine regression. No speculative JIT/GC explanation is presented as root cause. Source, tests and dist remain exactly at P241; this phase is evidence-only documentation, not an adopted optimization.

The throwaway candidate exactly matches the unchanged baseline for 2,048 projections, 64 complete paths and seven point-getter traces, with radius cycling, enabled-polygon revisions, quad/triangle/slope/stacked-floor histories and retained output snapshots. Arithmetic, metadata, candidate counts and getter order agree in these cases; numeric equivalence does not rescue the CPU regression.

## P243 — Reject conditional cyclic-edge wrapping after ablations (2026-11-17)

### Scope and decision

P242's unchanged-baseline profile still places nearest and inside among projection hot paths. The two private query helpers access the next boundary vertex with (i + 1) % vertices.length. A prototype uses the equivalent i + 1 === vertices.length ? 0 : i + 1. Both helpers reject fewer than three vertices before these loops, which visit integer indices from zero through length minus one; the final edge still wraps to vertex zero. No arithmetic, epsilon, edge order, getter read, candidate metadata, region, state/cache, public API or allocation policy changes. Cold construction/clipping code is not rewritten.

The combined candidate improves ordinary positive-radius projection by 1.23% Node /2.62% Chromium, but zero-radius quads regress 2.46% /3.30%, with all six paired values worse in both runtimes. To isolate the interaction rather than guess a JIT cause, each helper was separately benchmarked against the unchanged baseline using the same complete public workload.

Inside-only improves several Chromium cases but regresses Node zero-radius quads 3.09%, triangles 1.65% and stacked floors 0.66%, all six paired values worse in those cases. Nearest-only improves Node about 4–8% on many workloads, but ordinary positive-radius Chromium queries change only -0.25%, while zero-radius/slope/stacked medians regress. These are not an acceptable cross-case/cross-runtime improvement. All three candidates are rejected; no special casing by radius, shape or runtime is introduced, and canonical code/tests/dist stay at P241. Fewer source-level remainder operations do not prove a CPU gain.

### Measurement boundary

Node v26.7.0, TypeScript 6.0.3 ES2022, pinned Chromium 153.0.8010.12 darwin/arm64 desktop automation. Baseline freshly transpiled from canonical P241 code; both/inside-only/nearest-only differ only in the stated private successor expressions and share production dependencies. Each independent cohort uses the P241 real NavigationMesh3D workload module: one-square interior, 48×48 zero-/positive-radius quads, exterior points, sloped quads, stacked 24×24 floors, split triangles and 12×12 complete paths. Geometry setup/destruction outside timing; 4,096 project /128 findPath warm calls, then six ABBA/BAAB pairs per case with 4,096 projections /128 full paths per sample. Cells average two samples per variant per pair; summary medians take six pairs, CPU wall ms/query.

All three visible browser cohorts have empty page-error lists, with no concurrent assistant build/test/profiler. Tiny single-square controls and path outliers are shown rather than treated as general gains. Separate cohorts are not additive; no unverified JIT/GC explanation, allocation/heap or GPU/FPS claim.

Each of all three candidates independently passes 2,048 exact public projections, 64 complete paths and seven point-getter trace comparisons against the unchanged baseline. Histories include varying radius/positions, enabled-state revisions, quads, triangles, slopes, stacked floors and retained output snapshots. This numerical agreement does not rescue the CPU regressions.

Six documentation files record the decision, README zh/en/ja synchronized; formatting, relative-file links and historical ACCEPTANCE byte-prefix preservation are checked. All temporary benchmark/proof modules, profiles and browser/server resources are removed before a six-doc-only phase commit. User-owned files remain excluded, no push or version bump.

## P244 — Numeric navmesh tile coordinates (2026-11-17)

### Adopted index and contract

The private spatial index changes from Map<string, polygonIndices> with interpolated x:z keys to Map<number, Map<number, polygonIndices>>. Construction creates/reuses an x column and appends the same polygon indices to its z buckets. Candidate iteration still runs the same x/z coordinate loops, emits the same budget sentinel before each lookup, retrieves tiles.get(x)?.get(z) after that yield, and keeps its per-query Set/deduplication/list order. No column reference is retained across yields. destroy clears the outer map.

This avoids per-query composite string creation/hashing without bit packing, coordinate truncation, a new extent restriction, query caching, shared mutable query state or public API/dependency changes. Safe integer keys preserve negative coordinates and signed-zero equivalence. Column maps add a storage-level tradeoff; neither retained heap nor net allocation/GC reduction was measured or claimed. Existing candidate-generator self samples (44,001 µs in P242's unchanged-P241 baseline profile) motivated this lookup investigation, not a performance claim.

### Complete public-query CPU boundary

Node v26.7.0, TypeScript 6.0.3 ES2022, pinned Playwright Chromium 153.0.8010.12 darwin/arm64 desktop automation. Isolated before/after modules share production dependencies and the same real NavigationMesh3D workload module as P241. Two-unit cells, tileSize 8, geometry setup/destruction outside timing; 4,096 project /128 findPath warm calls per variant/case, six ABBA/BAAB pairs with 4,096 projections /128 complete paths per sample. Pair cells average two samples per variant; summary values are medians of six pairs, CPU wall ms/query.

Cases cover single-square interior, 48×48 zero-/positive-radius quads, exterior border points, a continuous slope, two stacked 24×24 floors, 24×24 split triangles and complete paths on 12×12 quads. All but explicit zero-radius/single cases use radius 0.2, height 1.4, maxDistance 1, maxVerticalDistance 0.5, with 128 deterministic point positions/eight path pairs. All geometry and cache warmup precede timing; no concurrent assistant build/test/profile. Browser document visible, page-error list empty.

### Numerical, temporal and consumer evidence

- Canonical source, production ESM and CJS each match the isolated unchanged baseline for 2,048 exact projections, 64 complete paths and seven point-getter traces. Comparisons include IDs, values, revisions, candidate counts, path costs/visited/waypoints, radius cycling, enabled edits and retained snapshots over quads/triangles/slopes/stacked floors. CJS uses own-value comparison preserving exact Numbers rather than comparing its Vector3 prototype to the separate ESM class; frozen output and clone values are checked.
- Each of the same three variants additionally matches 300 coordinate-domain projections, three active-query lifecycle histories and 192 interleaved-job steps. Domain cases include negative/swapped axes, signed zero, distant valid world coordinates, missing buckets, variable radius and a 0.25-wide square /0.0625 tileSize with tile coordinate 4,294,967,296. No finite-coordinate or tile-span limit is relaxed.
- Lifecycle histories fire an option getter during an active projection, then disable a polygon, destroy the mesh or reenter project; result metadata, getter counts, nested output, revision and slots match. Three simultaneous jobs compare zero/small budgets, exact expansions/results, invalidation, destruction and slot release; each step remains within its primitive budget. This directly covers lookup visibility after yield without a cached column.
- A throwaway 32-bit-truncating numeric-index mutant collides distant buckets and fails the real public candidates assertion (Tile-coordinate collision); the canonical index passes. One permanent regression checks negative, swapped-axis and distant buckets with only its expected polygon and candidate count.
- The first permanent-test fixture used world coordinate 2**35, exceeding the existing 1,000,000,000 extent, and correctly failed constructor validation. It was corrected to 2**28; no engine validation was weakened. Prettier, strict typecheck and targeted eslint passed; the initially successful two navigation test files were not rerun, while the failed mesh file was rerun successfully (20 tests). Across the three files, 26 targeted tests pass; no full-suite claim.
- Public source/dist Chromium roots each compare 1,024 projections, 16 complete paths and 60 budgeted-job steps to the unchanged baseline, with enabled invalidation and slot release. Both consumers are visible and have empty page errors. Vite emits its existing OPM dynamic-import analysis warning; no audio, graphics, Safari, physical-device or backend-parity certification is claimed.
- Full isolated production build from HEAD plus only mesh.ts changes exactly four mesh JavaScript/map outputs (ESM/CJS); declarations stay byte-identical. Only those guarded artifacts are promoted, all eleven user-owned physics2d/world2d source/dist file hashes preserved. No global rebuild overwrites user files.
- README zh/en/ja, PLAN, DESIGN and both technical references synchronized, six-doc format and relative-file links checked, historical ACCEPTANCE prefix preserved byte-for-byte. Temporary workloads/proofs/modules/build tree and browser/server resources removed before the exact twelve-file source/test/four-output/six-doc commit. No push/version bump.

## P245 — Query-local sparse candidate membership words (2026-11-17)

### Adopted state and isolation

Each private candidates generator now uses its own Map<number, number> instead of a Set entry per polygon index. index >>> 5 selects the membership word and 1 << (index & 31) the bit. Nonzero (bits & mask) detects duplicates, including negative sign-bit results; a first visit updates only that word and yields the index. Duplicate visits still yield the same -1 primitive-budget sentinel. Tile iteration, lookup position after yield, list order, metadata, exact projection arithmetic, radius regions and public APIs remain unchanged.

Only bounded internal polygon indices are grouped; spatial/world coordinates retain P244's full numeric x/z maps and are not packed/truncated. The current 262,144-polygon limit is within the bitwise index range. Sparse per-query words avoid a mesh-sized buffer and shared epoch/stamp state, so interleaved jobs and reentrant direct projections remain independent. Fewer membership entries is an implementation fact, not a measured net allocation, heap or GC reduction. No new class fields, pooling, API or dependency.

A fresh unchanged-P244 baseline profile (10,000 warm +50,000 queries, 100 µs sampling) measured 5.53 µs/query including profiling overhead. Self samples ranked nearest 86,883 µs, project 69,174 µs, candidates 40,746 µs, hypot3 32,772 µs and inside 23,120 µs. It motivated investigation, not a speedup claim; no profiler overlaps paired timing.

### Public-query CPU boundary and tradeoff

Node v26.7.0 /TypeScript 6.0.3 ES2022 and pinned Playwright Chromium 153.0.8010.12 darwin/arm64 desktop automation. Both runtimes import the same throwaway real NavigationMesh3D workload. Original P241 cases remain (single interior, zero-/positive-radius 48×48 quads, outside border, slope, two stacked 24×24 floors, split triangles and 12×12 full paths); an empty-space 48×48 case adds zero-candidate coverage. Single/empty controls time 65,536 public calls per sample to reduce timer quantization; other projections retain 4,096 and full paths 128. Each variant/case warms 4,096 project or128 path calls once.

Construction/destruction outside timing, two-unit cells and tileSize 8, 128 deterministic points /eight path pairs; positive-radius cases use radius 0.2, height 1.4, maxDistance 1, maxVerticalDistance 0.5. Empty queries are at [-32,0.1,-32], outside all indexed buckets. Six ABBA/BAAB pairs per case, each pair averaging two samples per variant; summary medians over six pairs, CPU wall ms/query. Browser document visible and page errors empty; no concurrent assistant build/test/profile.

## P246 — Reject cached fixed projection denominator (2026-11-17)

### Candidate and decision

The private Polygon record already stores readonly plane coefficients dx/dz/base. A throwaway candidate adds one readonly projectionDenominator number per polygon, computed once as 1 + dx * dx + dz * dz, then retains the existing division by that exact value in nearest. It does not introduce a reciprocal, change arithmetic order, alter geometry/radius state or add an API/dependency. Existing P245 profile samples locate nearest as a hot path; no fresh profile or allocation/heap claim was needed for this constant-arithmetic probe.

Correctness comparisons agree, but the cache is not adopted: ordinary positive-radius projection changes +0.10% Node /+0.14% Chromium, slope +1.09% /+0.56%, stacked floors +0.20% /+0.86% and triangles +0.46% /+0.58%. Zero-radius projection improves about 2.37% /1.56%, but this does not establish a broad gain worth an additional per-polygon field. The longer single-polygon Node control regresses 5.55% (about ten nanoseconds/query), all six pairs worse. Empty-space code does not use this denominator, so its timing change is not attributed to denominator caching. No speculative JIT/memory-layout/GC cause is asserted. Canonical source/tests/dist remain at P245.

## P247 — Caller-owned lazy nearest projection output (2026-11-17)

### Ownership and clean cutover

The private nearest helper now requires a Vector3 output and returns a borrowed candidate in that storage instead of allocating a candidate vector for each tested polygon. Direct project calls and each incremental createSearch job own independent lazily allocated scratch. Public projection winners clone/freeze their candidate; endpoint winners clone before being retained and later frozen as path waypoints. All two helper callers migrate, the old module-global projectedScratch is removed and the borrowed lifetime is documented beside the helper. No optional compatibility signature, pool/shared buffer, class field, API or dependency.

Original plane/edge arithmetic, robust hypot/component bounds, first-winner ties, coordinate/options getter order, radius/enabled-state handling, candidate counts, budget sentinels and revision capture remain unchanged. Lazy creation avoids adding a candidate vector when no geometry is tested. This is a source-level temporary-lifetime change; VM allocation counts, retained heap and GC were not measured or claimed.

Cells average two samples/variant/pair; summary medians over six pairs, CPU wall ms/query.

## P248 — Reject retained output ownership transfer (2026-11-17)

### Candidate and decision

Vector3.set/clone source confirms plain x/y/z components without observer/version metadata; clone only constructs a fresh copy. A throwaway variant of P247 removes winner clones by retaining the current output vector itself, then clearing the caller's scratch reference so it cannot be reused. Public winners freeze that retired vector; endpoint winners retain it until path publication. Both callers retire their selected scratch, while discarded candidates still reuse private storage. The borrowed-output comment is generalized only in the prototype; no global buffer or runtime/shape special case.

All exact-value/lifetime comparisons pass, but ownership transfer is rejected. Ordinary positive-radius queries regress 3.65% Node (all six pairs worse), with only -0.14% Chromium, inside noise. Node zero-radius/slope/stacked/triangle medians also regress about 1–2%, mostly with six worse pairs. The roughly 6 ns Node /3 ns Chromium single-polygon improvement does not justify this complexity or populated-query regression. Empty-space retention never happens, so its timing change is not attributed to avoiding clones. Source/tests/dist retain P247's simpler explicit clone-on-retention contract. No JIT/GC cause or allocation gain is inferred from source-level copy removal.

### Complete public-query CPU boundary

Node v26.7.0 /TypeScript 6.0.3 ES2022; pinned Playwright Chromium 153.0.8010.12 darwin/arm64 desktop automation. Before is freshly transpiled P247 canonical source and after changes only retention/reset/comment logic, sharing production dependencies and the same real nine-case workload. Geometry setup/destruction outside timing; two-unit cells/tileSize 8, point pool 128 /path pool 8, same query options. Warmup 4,096 projections or 128 paths per variant/case, then six ABBA/BAAB pairs. Controls use 65,536 calls/sample, main projections 4,096 and full paths 128. Pair cells average two samples/variant, summaries take six-pair medians, CPU wall ms/query.

Browser visible with empty page errors, no concurrent assistant build/test/profile. Cases remain single interior, empty48, zero-/positive-radius quads48, outside border, slope48, two stacked floors24, split triangles24 and complete paths12. No renderer/RAF/GPU/FPS, startup, net allocation, retained heap or GC claim.

The isolated prototype matches the unchanged baseline for 2,304 projections, 64 paths and eight getter traces; 300 coordinate-domain projections, three active-query lifecycle histories and 192 interleaved steps; signed-bit/word boundary counts 15 /9; 75 reentrant getter comparisons with 310 retained snapshots; and frozen start [1.2,0,1.2] /goal [9.2,0,7.2] endpoint consumers. ## P249：完整 findPath profile；拒絕 query-local region 索引陣列（2026-11-17）

### 範圍與判定

- 正式基準為 P248（`72f54e8a6`；引擎實作仍是 P247）。本階段**不採用原型，只更新六份文件**；source、tests、dist 與套件版本不變，未推送。
- 原型只把 createSearch 內非零半徑的 query-local `Map<number, Region>` 改為延遲填入的 `(Region | undefined)[]`，保留零半徑分支、cache lifetime、逐 primitive 控制流程與所有算式；沒有預先配置整張 mesh、共享 cache 或密度特判。
- 不因短路徑略快就接受：長路徑不穩定，高 index／少量訪問控制組退步。正式程式保留 query-local Map；未把 profile 排名或較少 Map 呼叫當成已證實的收益。

### 完整路徑 sampling profile

先以目前正式實作量測完整 findPath，不以 projection-only 取代路徑。Node inspector 以 100 µs sampling interval，短路徑暖身 2,048 次、量測 16,384 次；長路徑暖身 128 次、量測 1,024 次。暖身與量測累計 cost／waypoint sink 均有限。

| Case    | 完整查詢數 | region wrapper self time（ms） | 占整份 profile sampled time |
| ------- | ---------- | ------------------------------ | --------------------------- |
| paths12 | 16,384     | 38.552                         | 11.37%                      |
| paths32 | 1,024      | 53.846                         | 16.64%                      |

region wrapper 在兩個 cohort 都是主要 self-time frame，因此選這個最小資料結構原型；sampling 歸屬不等於 Map 的獨立成本，也不作為前後效能數據。長路徑的 heap take／offer 也在主要 frame 中；沒有先假設 hypot3 或 smoothing 是最大熱點。

### 配對 CPU 結果

Node 與 pinned Chromium 153.0.8010.12（darwin/arm64）各六輪 ABBA／BAAB，每格每輪兩次。每個 runtime 66 個配對列、264 個 timed samples；計時時沒有其他助理 build／test／profile 工作。fixture 建立與暖身均不在計時內，瀏覽器頁面 visibility 為 visible、pageerror 為空。

既有八種 projection 控制組保留原輸入；paths12 是 12×12 quads、終點約 (9.2, 7.2)，paths32 是 32×32 quads、終點約 (61.2, 59.2)，皆八組起終點。另建 32,768 polygons 的控制組，前 32,766 個彼此分離，只有最後兩個相連，查詢只訪問 index 32,766／32,767；不是以訪問節點數等於總 mesh 大小的場景代替稀疏行為。每次 sample 分別是：single／empty 65,536 projections，其餘 projection 4,096；短路徑 1,024、長路徑 512、稀疏路徑 2,048 次。

### 原型正確性與限制

- before／after 各對照 2,816 個 seeded projections、192 個完整 paths（三種路徑 cohort 各 64）、10 個 getter histories；比對原始 Number 值、frozen／retained snapshots，無容差掩飾差異。

- bit 31／63 的 duplicate 控制仍得到 15／9 unique candidates；75 次 getter reentry 對照與 310 份保留 snapshots 不變；起終點仍是獨立 frozen retained winners。
- 本階段沒有正式程式改動，因此沒有重跑 build／typecheck／unit／source lint，也沒有建立新的產物或把先前通過紀錄冒稱為本次結果。只檢查本次文件格式、相對檔案連結與歷史驗收位元組前綴。
- 只量測 CPU 查詢時間；未量測 heap／GC、GPU／呈現 fps、Safari、WebGPU／WebGL2／Canvas2D 或實機，不推定陣列的儲存配置或退步原因。完成後刪除自有暫存原型與腳本，瀏覽器與 server 已關閉。

## P250：單次 navmesh expansion 重用固定的 regions（2026-11-17）

### 正式變更與採用依據

- 基準為 P249（`729346f0a`；引擎實作仍是 P247）。依 P249 完整路徑 profile 選擇 region wrapper 的重複讀取，而不是繼續替換容器。檢查既有 indexed heap 與 P167 Floyd sift 拒絕紀錄後，heap 表示保持不變。
- 在每次 polygon expansion 內延遲保存 current Region；每個 edge 的 target Region 只讀取一次，供空 region 檢查及 portal 使用。disabled／height filter 仍先執行，第一次 target／current region 的計算順序不變，沒有為被跳過的 edge 預先做工作。

- portal、hypot3、distance、score、parent 更新順序與算式不變；nearest 的 borrowed output 與 clone-on-retention 契約仍是 P247。公開 API、declarations、套件版本與 runtime 依賴不變。

## P252：保留 Map 並在 query 內回收 indexed-heap entries（2026-11-17）

### 選擇與正式架構

- 基準 P251（`82f1d7d81`；正式 navmesh 仍為 P250）。完整路徑 profile 的 take／offer 是熱點，本次評估 slot 寫入，不重做 P167 Floyd sift，也不把 P249 的 region-read 原型當作同一種 workload。
- 第一個原型將 node→slot Map 改為按需數值陣列，以 slot+1 表示 queued、0／undefined 表示 absent。密集路徑明顯較快，但兩種 caller 的高 index 稀疏控制退步；**拒絕陣列版**，不加密度門檻或特判補丁。
- 正式採用 Map-backed HeapEntry：entry 同時保存 node／score／slot，heap 移動時直接寫 entry.slot，不再為每次 sift 重新 hash node→slot；移除舊 slots Map 與 parallel score array。distance／parent 的公開數值 Maps 與 offer／take 簽章不變，兩個正式 caller 無需替代入口或 shim。
- 移出的 entry 放在該 query 自己的 free list，後續 frontier growth 再用；entry 不傳給 caller，take 先擷取原始 node Number 再回收。不是每個 visited node 都建立新物件，也沒有跨工作共享 pool、完整世界陣列或額外 runtime 依賴。未量測總 heap bytes／GC，不宣稱記憶體改善。
- score→node 排序、decrease-key、distance／parent 更新時機與全部算式保持。Map 的 SameValueZero 合併 ±0 key，但 take 必須保留最後一次 offer 的原始 node 值，所以 lowered re-offer 仍更新 entry.node；query-local 回收不會改寫已回傳的數值。

### 方法與控制

每個表示各跑一次固定矩陣：Node 與 pinned Chromium 153.0.8010.12（darwin/arm64）各六輪 ABBA／BAAB、每 variant 每輪兩次。navmesh 十一組各 runtime 66 paired rows／264 samples；tiled graph 三組各 runtime 18 paired rows／72 samples。fixture 建立及暖身在計時外；計時時無其他助理 build／test／profile。所有 browser 頁面 visible、pageerror 為空，browser／server 均在 finally 關閉。

navmesh 沿 P251：single／empty 每 sample 65,536 projections，其他 projections 4,096，paths12 1,024，paths32 512，32,768-polygons 尾端雙 polygon 路徑 65,536（暖身 4,096）。tiled12／tiled32 是 12²／32² 個 authored nodes 的真實雙向 lattice，有限非整數成本產生 ties 與 lowered offers；每 sample 2,048／512 routes。tiled 稀疏組是八 tile 各 4,096 nodes，只有末端 node 32,766／32,767 相連，每 sample 65,536 routes、暖身 4,096。所有計時路徑均要求找到真實完整結果，不用單獨 Map microbenchmark 代替。

before 的 helper source 在提升產物前即凍結，兩個 before caller 都明確連結該副本，不因 dist 改變而把前後偷偷接到同一份新 helper。以下是完整 source-method modules 搭配正式依賴的 CPU 時間，不是 whole-frame／GPU 時間。前後欄各取六個 pair-mean 的中位數；Δ 每輪先將兩次平均後計算，再取六輪中位數，不能由前後欄相除重建。全部 rounds／離群值保留，不推定原因。

主要長路徑在兩 runtime 六輪皆較快；tiled 短／長也皆六輪較快，tiled 稀疏 Node 五輪、Chromium 六輪較快。**保留代價**：最短 navmesh 稀疏路徑兩 runtime 六輪皆慢，pair-mean 中位數約增加 Node 26 ns／Chromium 13 ns，不宣稱所有路徑皆加速。採用的是主要路徑明確 CPU 收益與避免 per-sift hash writes 的表示，不宣稱未修改 projection 控制組的變化來自 heap。

### 正式 source／ESM／CJS 與公開入口

- source prettier、`tsc -p tsconfig.check.json --noEmit`、scoped eslint 及 navigation／navigation-mesh／navigation-jobs／navigation-scheduler 四檔既有 **40 tests** 通過。既有 lowered-offer／score-then-node 合約與兩 caller 行為保留，不新增 wiring／source-text tests。
- canonical、正式 ESM、正式 CJS 每個版本各通過 heap oracle：三種 ID domain，9,225 offers／7,410 takes，涵蓋 dense、最高真實 private index 262,143、named-number probes 至 MAX_SAFE_INTEGER、lowered scores、清空／reopen、distance／parent 原始 Number Maps 與確定性排序。超過引擎節點上限的直接 helper probe 不是擴大引擎支援範圍。另比對 ±0 同 key re-offer 及回收後 node 值，無精度轉換。
- 每個版本 navmesh 各 2,816 seeded projections、192 完整 paths、10 getter histories；300 座標域 projections、3 active-query lifecycle histories、192 interleaved steps；bit31／63 的 15／9 candidates，75 reentry／310 retained snapshots 與 frozen endpoint consumer 皆一致。
- 每個版本 tiled graph 各 384 完整 path comparisons、552 個 step comparisons，包含不同半徑／exclusions、孤立節點、保留 frozen results、0／1／2／7 primitive 預算、revision invalidation 與八 slots 釋放。Node 比對 own values 與原始 Number，不以 JSON 容差掩飾差異。
- 實際 browser public source／dist root **每個 entry**的 navmesh 各 1,408 projections／48 paths／624 step comparisons，tiled graph 各 48 paths／552 step comparisons，均 visible／無 pageerror。Vite 對既有 OPM adapter dynamic import 的分析 warning 原樣保留，不算 audio 驗證。
- 隔離 HEAD production build 只覆入 partition-search.ts，tsc／minify／vendor copy／CJS 完成；完整 dist 比對只改 helper ESM／CJS runtime 及 maps 四件、helper 私有欄位 metadata 的 d.ts 一件，其他 declarations／公開 API 不變。提升前確認目標未有工作樹改動，十一個使用者自有 source／dist 雜湊前後一致，未覆寫／stage 使用者檔案。
- 六份文件同步，歷史 ACCEPTANCE 位元組前綴保留；提交前刪除自有原型、benchmarks、proofs 與 isolated build，僅此 source／五個 outputs／六份文件按功能提交，不 push／升版。沒有 full suite／完整 backend 矩陣、heap／GC、GPU／呈現 fps、Safari 或實機認證。

## P253：拒絕非負距離剪枝（2026-11-17）

### 範圍、兩個原型與決策

- 基線為 P252 commit `81c9f9d6a`：mesh 保留 P250 的 region 參照重用，PartitionSearch 使用 P252 entry heap。before／after 同時匯入新鮮凍結的 P252 helper，不沿用 P252 實驗當時的舊 helper，避免把 heap 差異誤算為本階段收益。
- 第一個私有原型在 region／portal 前以 known distance ≤ current distance 略過非負 edge。路徑值相同，但 constructor 的 Array.map 可保留自訂 species，凍結後的 vertices／walls 陣列仍可能是帶有可觀察 get trap 的 Proxy；提前略過幾何工作實際改變其讀取歷史。故此案拒絕，未作 CPU 量測。
- 第二個保守原型保留 disabled／height、region／portal 與所有幾何讀取，portal 成功後才讀 known distance 並依下界略過 hypot3。current distance 在單次 expansion 首次需要時延遲讀取且保留零值；需要 norm 時仍使用相同減法、norm、加法及精確 distance 比較，不改 parent／offer 次序。
- 保守案 Node 長路徑有收益，Chromium 長路徑卻六輪皆較慢；短路徑沒有穩定改善，Node 高 index 最短稀疏查詢亦較慢。因此整案不採用，不增加永久 local／分支，不作 runtime／密度特判，也不把較少 norm 直接當成收益或推測 JIT／GC 成因。

### 保留輸入 Array species 的可觀察性 probe

使用原生 Array subclass species 建立帶有 get trap 的 vertices／walls snapshot，建構後確認公開 vertices array 已 frozen。三輪完整 findPath 的所有回傳原始值一致；portal 後版本的完整 Proxy key 讀取序列亦與 baseline 一致，portal 前版本不一致。此處計數為實際 get trap 次數，不是配置量或 CPU 量測。

### 固定完整路徑與控制矩陣

- Node 26 與 pinned Chromium 153.0.8010.12，darwin／arm64；browser 為 desktop automation、分頁 visible、零 pageerror，非 Safari／實機認證。兩 runtime 依序執行，不重疊量測。
- 每個 runtime 一次固定 11 cohorts × 6 rounds，奇偶輪交替 ABBA／BAAB，每輪每側兩樣本，共 66 配對 rows／264 樣本；每側 fixture 獨立建構／暖身，完整 findPath 包含 projection、搜尋、回溯、corridor 與結果發布。
- paths12 每樣本 1,024 queries，paths32 512，paths-sparse32768 65,536；後者 32,768 polygons 中只有最後兩個連通，保留高 index、小 frontier 控制。其餘 projection cohorts 與正式實作相同，不宣稱其波動為本案收益。完整 fixtures／query 座標及 query-local 所有權延續前階段，不新增 API 或認證範圍。
- 下表 before／after 是每輪兩樣本平均的跨輪中位數，單位 µs/query；變化為各輪配對百分比的中位數，非兩個跨輪中位數相除。全部六輪、所有控制與離群值均保留；負值較快，不選擇重測。

### 原型對照與明確未重驗範圍

- out-of-tree 保守原型：2,816 seeded projections、192 完整 paths、10 point-getter histories；原始 Number／狀態／凍結結果與 retained snapshots 一致。
- 座標域／lifecycle：300 projections（含 tile coordinate 4,294,967,296）、3 active lifecycle histories、192 interleaved budget steps（0／1／2／7）；bit 31／63 控制保留 15／9 個唯一 candidates。
- reentry／ownership：75 comparisons、310 retained snapshots；position x／y／z getter 次數 21／17／25，options maxDistance／maxVerticalDistance 為 9／3。凍結 endpoints start [1.2,0,1.2]、goal [9.2,0,7.2] 保持原值。
- 保守案的 Array-species Proxy 讀取完整序列與結果一致；提前案只有路徑值一致，讀取歷史不同，未把它標成正確通過或效能改善。
- 本階段只同步 README 中／英／日、PLAN、DESIGN、英文／繁中 TECHNICAL 與此紀錄。正式 source／tests／dist／declarations、P250 mesh／P252 heap、使用者改動、依賴及 package 版本維持；隔離 build 腳本僅準備、沒有執行或提升產物。未重跑 canonical／production ESM／CJS／public browser root、unit tests、typecheck／lint 或 full suite，不冒用 P252 的 40 tests 作本階段驗證。
- 未量測 constructor cost、JS allocation／retained heap／GC、GPU／RAF／CPU submit／呈現 fps、Safari、其他 browser／backend、OPM unlock／cleanup 或 physical devices。CPU-only 原型 comparison 不擴大圖形／音訊與引擎功能認證；不升版、不 push。
- 文件新段格式與相對檔案連結另行檢查，歷史 ACCEPTANCE bytes 保留；throwaway prototypes、benchmarks 與未執行 build scripts 於提交前刪除，不留永久測試或檔案。

## P254：惰性快取 immutable polygon-center edge distance（2026-11-17）

### 不變量、候選與採用範圍

- baseline 為 P253 commit `2d9239eb9`，正式 mesh 仍是 P250、heap 是 P252。constructor 各自建立 shared-border／正反向 explicit-link Edge，polygon center 只於建構時計算，並未公開或由 runtime setter 修改；既有 region 架構亦以 immutable geometry 為前提。
- 原本每次 portal 成功後，都重算 target.center − current.center 的 hypot3。此三維 norm 只依固定幾何，不依 query radius／height、enabled epoch 或工作；可重用同一個 Number，保留原始減法、縮放補償 norm 與加法順序，不改成 sqrt 近似或 portal 長度。
- 先量測 optional lazy-property 原型，再只改為所有四種 Edge 建立處明確初始化 `centerDistance: undefined`，型別為 `number | undefined`。正式選後者：仍只在 portal 成功後首次計算，以 ??= 保留零值；明確初始化是資料結構選擇，沒有以兩次獨立 run 的百分比互除，亦沒有聲稱它修復冷啟動或證實某項 V8 配置／JIT 原因。
- 每條 directed Edge 增加一個欄位槽，值留存至幾何生命週期結束；不建立額外 collection／完整世界 workspace，不提前替未經過的 edge 計算 norm。這是 metadata 的記憶體代價，不是已量測的 heap／GC 改善。共享的只有固定幾何衍生 scalar，distance／parent、region Map、scratch、輸入與結果仍保持既有 query／job 所有權。
- 不沿用 P253 的提前剪枝或 current-distance local。disabled／height、region／portal 的完整讀取與順序不變，因此保留 Array species／frozen Proxy 的可觀察行為；primitive／revision／cleanup、distance／score 算式、parent／offer 順序、tie 與保留快照亦維持。
- 採用依據是同一 mesh 上重複完整路徑的主要收益，且正式 minified ESM 亦實測成立。新建 mesh 首條路徑與 fixture 建立波動大，部分 Node 配對明顯較慢，不宣稱 cold／startup 加速或所有查詢受益；全部代價與對照如下，不挑選重測。

### 固定量測方法與控制

- Node 26、pinned Chromium 153.0.8010.12，darwin／arm64；browser visible、零 pageerror，desktop automation，非 Safari／實機認證。各 runtime 與 checks 依序進行，CPU 量測期間不併行 build／unit checks。
- 所有矩陣各只執行一次固定六輪，奇偶輪交替 ABBA／BAAB，每側每輪兩樣本，全部 rounds／離群值保留。before／after 都使用同一個新鮮凍結的 P252 helper，不沿用 P252 舊 helper；正式 ESM baseline 於提升前另存原始模組並解析至相同 production dependencies，避免污染 before。
- 暖路徑每 runtime 每版本 11 cohorts、66 rows／264 samples：single-inside／empty48／高 index sparse 各樣本 65,536 queries；其他 projection 4,096，paths12 1,024、paths32 512。fixture 與 start／goal 延續 P252；projection 實作未改，其波動不視為本案收益。
- fresh-world 控制每 runtime／版本 12 rows／48 route samples／48 fixture-build samples，共 576 個新 mesh。每樣本先建立 12 個獨立 fixtures，分開量測完整 fixture 建立（含 quad／Vector3／points 輸入準備，不是純 constructor-only），每個 fresh mesh 再只查一次 path。destroy 不在計時內；build+first-path 為同一批兩次計時的逐樣本和，不是另一次量測。
- 首條路徑與 fixture 建立均有大幅波動，不能從未修改的 constructor 控制推論 cache 的單一因果。正式產物 Node 長首條路徑與 setup 配對仍有代價，沒有用暖路徑數值掩蓋；也不從中位數相除估計攤銷門檻。
- 另加 32×32 sloped 3D grid 控制，y = 0.1x + 0.15z，使 center distances 非整數；source-slot 版本每 runtime 6 rows／24 samples，512 queries/sample，含 16 個 found／JSON 原始值 preflight 比對。此 CPU 控制未擴稱為正式 ESM 的 sloped CPU 認證。
- summary 的 before／after 為每輪兩樣本平均的跨輪中位數（µs/query 或 µs/fresh fixture）；變化為各輪配對百分比的中位數，與兩個跨輪中位數相除可能方向不同。raw 表的六位小數是正規化記錄，不代表時鐘精度。

### 正式驗證、產物與邊界

- 實際執行並通過：source Prettier、`tsc -p tsconfig.check.json --noEmit`、scoped ESLint，與 `navigation-mesh`／`navigation-jobs`／`navigation-scheduler` 3 files／28 既有 tests。無新增永久測試；feature 及不確定邊界以以下 throwaway consumer proofs 驗證。
- 隔離 HEAD build 只覆入本次 mesh.ts，實際執行 tsc／minify-dist／copy-vendor／build-cjs。完整 dist bytes 比對僅四份 mesh runtime／map 輸出改變，所有 declarations、其他 outputs／vendor 保持相同；十一個使用者 source／dist 檔案的 SHA256 在提升前後一致。
- canonical source、production ESM、production CJS 各自通過：2,816 seeded projections、192 完整 paths、10 point-getter histories，300 座標域 projections（含 tile coordinate 4,294,967,296）、3 active lifecycle histories、192 interleaved steps（budgets 0／1／2／7），bit31／63 的 15／9 唯一 candidates。
- 三種 consumer 各通過 75 reentrant comparisons、310 retained snapshots；position x／y／z getter 21／17／25 次、options maxDistance／maxVerticalDistance 9／3，frozen endpoints start [1.2,0,1.2]、goal [9.2,0,7.2] 不變。Array-species／frozen Proxy 三輪讀取序列完全一致，計數 4,385／6,724／4,385，原始路徑值相同。
- 三種 consumer 各通過 24 條 same-center zero-cost／positive-cost explicit-link 查詢，含 directed reverse unreachable、四種狀態組合、radius／enabled epoch 變化、cost=4、retained snapshots 與 slots=8；另各通過 128 條 noninteger sloped paths、4 radii、15 revision toggles、16 retained snapshots，raw Number／狀態／waypoints 一致。
- 實際 browser source root 與 dist root 各 1,408 projections、48 完整 paths、624 budget steps，visible、零 pageerror。OPM adapter 既有 Vite dynamic-import analysis warning 仍出現，未隱藏、未改音訊或冒稱音訊驗證。
- 只提升 `dist/packages/core/src/navigation/mesh.js`／map 與 `dist/cjs/packages/core/src/navigation/mesh.cjs`／map，公開 API、declarations、package 版本、依賴、workspace 隔離與使用者變更保留；README 中／英／日、PLAN、DESIGN、英文／繁中技術文件同步。按功能提交，不 push／升版。
- 未執行 full suite；未量測 JS allocation／retained heap／GC、GPU／RAF／CPU submit／呈現 fps、其他 browser／backend、Safari／physical devices、OPM unlock／cleanup。cache metadata 占用與 cold tradeoff 不以較少計算掩蓋，不把 CPU-only 查詢結果擴大為引擎全域／3D 場景／三 backend 認證。
- 文件相對檔案連結與格式於提交前檢查，歷史 ACCEPTANCE bytes 保留；全部 throwaway modules、profiles、benchmarks 與隔離 build tree 於提交前刪除。

## P255：空 tile 跳過候選迭代，保留既有 Map 與 primitive 順序（2026-11-17）

### 變更、不採用的延遲 Map，以及明列取捨

- baseline 為 P254 commit `8ca291ba9`，包含 P254 center-distance cache 與 P252 heap；兩側 fresh source snapshot／frozen helper 一致，不把前階段收益混入本次比較。P254 完整短路徑 profile 的 candidates frame 入列，source 的每個空 tile 會透過 `?? []` 進入空 for-of，故檢查該資料路徑。
- 原型 A 同時移除空陣列 fallback 並延遲建立 seen-word Map。空 projection／miss paths 有收益，但多個 Node 有候選情境、短稀疏路徑退步，拒絕此 Map 生命週期／型別改動，不由較少 Map 請求推定效能或 JIT／GC 成因。
- 正式採用原型 B 的最小 guard：仍先建立原本的 const seen Map，仍先 yield 每個 tile 的 −1 primitive，再讀 nested Maps；沒有 list 就 continue，有 list 則使用原陣列與原 word／mask／duplicate sentinel 邏輯。不在 yield 前或跨 yield 快取 column，避免 destroy 清除 index 後讀到過期參照。
- tile lookup、動態 position x／z 邊界讀取與順序不變；empty／duplicate budgets、31／63-bit words、enabled／revision／cleanup、query／job 所有權、P254 scalar cache 及原始結果皆維持。只移除語法上的 fallback 陣列請求，不聲稱已量測 JS allocation 數量或 GC。
- 採用範圍是空間查詢／完整 miss 路徑；不是導航全面加速。正式 ESM 的空 projection 與 miss 六輪皆較快，部分一般 projection 有益，但 Node 長路徑六輪皆較慢，single-inside／tri24 亦有小幅代價，其他控制混合；全部矩陣明列，不隱藏代價或用密度／runtime 特判補救。

### 預先宣告的完整 miss cohort 與固定量測

- 在任何量測前，將 paths-empty48 加入既有十一 cohorts：48×48 有效 authored mesh 上，start 的 x／z 都是 −32、goal 都是 −64、y=.1；maxDistance=1、maxVerticalDistance=.5、agentRadius=.2、agentHeight=1.4。兩端都在空 tiles，完整 findPath 必須回傳 unreachable，visited=0；不是非法的空 mesh。
- 每樣本 65,536 次 miss queries，暖身 4,096，run 會檢查 unreachable 並消費 visited。其他 fixtures 延續 P254：single-inside／empty48／sparse 各 65,536 queries/sample，其他 projection 4,096，paths12 1,024、paths32 512。
- Node 26、pinned Chromium 153.0.8010.12、darwin／arm64，browser visible、零 pageerror，desktop automation，非 Safari／實機認證。兩個 source 原型與實際正式 ESM 各獨立一次 12 cohorts × 6 rounds；每輪交替 ABBA／BAAB，每側兩樣本，共每 runtime 每矩陣 72 rows／288 samples。量測不與 build／unit checks 重疊，不重跑挑選 rounds。
- source A／B 與 production C 不直接互除；每個變化只來自同一 row 的 before／after。正式 baseline 是提升前凍結的原始 production module，兩側 static imports 指向相同正式 dependencies，不用 unminified prototype 代替正式產物。
- summary 的 before／after 是每輪兩樣本平均的跨輪中位數（µs/query）；百分比是每輪配對變化的中位數，不是兩個跨輪中位數相除。raw 六位小數為正規化記錄，不代表時鐘精度；全部控制、rounds 與離群值保留。

### 實際驗證與限制

- source A／B 皆通過 3,072 seeded projections、256 完整 paths、11 point-getter histories，300 座標域 projections（含 tile coordinate 4,294,967,296）、3 active lifecycle histories、192 interleaved budget steps（0／1／2／7），31／63-bit 的 15／9 unique candidates，75 reentrant comparisons 與 310 retained snapshots。frozen-array species Proxy 三輪完整讀取歷史相同（4,385／6,724／4,385）。A 另通過 endpoints、zero-center／slope probes；未把它標成正式採用。
- 正式 B 實際執行並通過 source Prettier、`tsc -p tsconfig.check.json --noEmit`、scoped ESLint 與 3 files／28 既有 tests：navigation-mesh、navigation-jobs、navigation-scheduler。無新增永久測試。
- 隔離 HEAD build 只覆入本次 mesh.ts，實際 tsc／minify-dist／copy-vendor／build-cjs；完整 dist byte 比對只有四份 mesh runtime／map 改變，declarations、其他 outputs／vendor 相同。十一個使用者 source／dist 檔案在提升前後 SHA256 一致。
- canonical source、正式 ESM、正式 CJS 各通過上述 3,072 projections／256 paths／11 getters、300 座標域、3 lifecycle、192 budgets、bit31／63、75 reentry／310 retained snapshots 與完整 Proxy 歷史。position x／y／z getter 次數 21／17／25、options maxDistance／maxVerticalDistance 9／3；凍結 endpoints [1.2,0,1.2]／[9.2,0,7.2] 不變。各 probe 的 target selector 皆實際綁定當次 canonical／ESM／CJS module，非只比較未提升原型。
- 三種 consumer 亦各通過 24 條 same-center zero／positive-cost explicit-link paths（directed reverse／disabled epoch／radius／retained snapshots／slots=8）及 128 條 noninteger sloped paths、4 radii、15 revision toggles、16 retained snapshots；P254 cache 與原始 Number／狀態／waypoints 保留。
- 實際 browser source root／dist root 各通過 1,536 projections、64 完整 paths、634 budget steps，含新完整 miss cohort，visible、零 pageerror。這是同一新增矩陣的 before／after 對照，不把與 P254 不同的總步數誤稱預算改變。既有 OPM adapter Vite dynamic-import analysis warning 保留，沒有隱藏或冒稱音訊驗證。
- 正式只修改 private candidate generator 與四份 mesh runtime／map；const seen Map、公開 API／declarations、package 版本、依賴、八 slots／工作隔離、P254／P252 能力與使用者檔案保留。README 中／英／日、PLAN、DESIGN、英文／繁中技術文件同步；按功能提交，不 push／升版。
- 未執行 full suite；未量測 constructor／首條冷查詢、CJS CPU、JS allocation／retained heap／GC、GPU／RAF／CPU submit／呈現 fps、其他 browser／backend、Safari／physical devices、OPM unlock／cleanup。Node 正式長路徑代價不忽略，空查詢收益不擴稱整個引擎／所有導航情境加速。
- 文件格式、相對檔案連結於提交前檢查；歷史 ACCEPTANCE bytes 保留；全部 throwaway modules／benchmarks／隔離 build tree 於提交前刪除。

## P256：endpoint projections 成功後才建立搜尋 workspace（2026-11-17）

### 根據、變更與完整語意

- baseline 為 P255 commit `8ac08ad15`，保留 P254 fixed-center scalar 與 P252 heap。完整 miss／create-cancel 的 baseline profile 包含 createSearch 與 PartitionSearch constructor；source 確認 frontier 與 parentEdges 在任何 projection 前已建立，但首次 offer 僅在兩個 endpoints 都成功之後。
- 正式把 PartitionSearch 與 parentEdges 宣告為 query-local optional state，於兩個 endpoint projections 成功的原 offer primitive 內以 ??= 各初始化一次，再執行原 seed offer。沒有把新的 allocation 或 offer 分拆成額外 primitive，也沒有在第一個 endpoint 失敗時提早跳過第二端。
- search phase 使用已初始化 frontier／edges 的局部參照，不在 relaxation／tile loop 增加 lazy-state checks；backtrack／corridor／smooth 依原 phase 不變量使用同一個 parent workspace，不加入 wrapper、共享狀態或完整世界陣列。
- 未進入 search 的 projection miss 仍真實發布 unreachable／Infinity／visited=0；已進入但不可達的搜尋保留實際 distance.size，不以零值掩蓋搜尋失敗或 invalidation。取消／失效仍保留原 terminal status 與未發布 result，不偽造 unreachable fallback。
- 邏輯 slots 仍由 jobs Set 註冊／刪除管理：createSearch 結尾照常註冊，release callback 照常刪除，未延後 slot 佔用。輸入驗證、point／options snapshot 及 getter 次序保持；不把 native workspace 的延遲建立混成延遲輸入讀取。
- 正式 ESM 的完整 miss 與 create-cancel 兩 runtime 六輪皆較快；Node 正常長路徑與最短高 index 稀疏控制仍有代價，Chrome 正常路徑亦有局部收益。採用目標為 projection 失敗／搜尋前取消，並非所有 Node 路徑或引擎全域加速；全部控制及代價保留。未修改的 project controls 不作本案因果收益宣稱。

### 預先宣告的 create-cancel cohort 與固定方法

- 在任何原型量測前新增 paths-cancel48：48×48 authored mesh，普通有效 start／goal，使用既有 options，65,536 次完整 createSearch→cancel→terminal step／cleanup 每樣本、暖身 4,096。每次建立後驗證 availableSlots=7、pending／expansions=0；cancel 後 step(1) 回 cancelled、expansions=0、result=undefined、slots=8。不是只量測 constructor 或把工作移出計時。
- 其餘十二 cohorts 延續 P255，含完整 paths-empty48（兩端 x／z 分別 −32／−64、y=.1，maxDistance=1、maxVerticalDistance=.5、radius=.2、height=1.4），每樣本 65,536 queries；sparse／single-inside／empty48 同為 65,536，其他 projections 4,096，paths12 1,024、paths32 512。
- Node 26、pinned Chromium 153.0.8010.12、darwin／arm64；browser visible、零 pageerror，desktop automation，非 Safari／實機認證。source 與正式 ESM 各一次固定 13 cohorts × 6 rounds，交替 ABBA／BAAB，每側每輪兩樣本，共每 runtime 每矩陣 78 rows／312 samples；runtime 依序量測，沒有與 build／unit checks 併行，不重測挑選 rounds。
- before／after 使用同一個新鮮凍結的 P252 helper，P255／P254 能力兩側一致。正式 before 於提升前凍結原始 minified module，兩側 imports 皆解析到同一份正式 dependencies；不用 prototype 代替產物，不跨獨立矩陣／階段互除或累加百分比。
- summary before／after 為每輪兩樣本平均的跨輪中位數（µs/op）；變化為各輪配對百分比的中位數，非兩個跨輪中位數相除。raw 六位小數是正規化記錄，不代表時鐘精度；全部 rounds／控制／離群值保留。

### 實際驗證、輸出與未驗證範圍

- source Prettier、`tsc -p tsconfig.check.json --noEmit`、scoped ESLint 與 navigation-mesh／navigation-jobs／navigation-scheduler 3 files／28 既有 tests 實際通過。無新增永久測試，以 throwaway consumer proofs 驗證 feature／不確定邊界。
- 隔離 HEAD build 只覆入本次 mesh.ts，實際 tsc／minify-dist／copy-vendor／build-cjs。完整 dist bytes 比對僅四份 mesh runtime／map 改變，declarations／其他 outputs／vendor 相同；十一個使用者 source／dist 檔案在提升前後 SHA256 一致。
- canonical source、正式 ESM、正式 CJS 各通過新 pre-search 兩個 lifecycle histories：valid／empty endpoints 各建立八個 pending jobs，ninth RangeError；budget=0／1 仍佔 slots，取消不再執行 primitive，替補／revision invalidation／destroy 釋放一致。step 回傳 status、expansions 計數與 result 原始狀態均對照；未用 state 未建立不代表 job 不佔 slot。
- 三種 module 各通過 3,328 seeded projections、320 完整 paths、12 getter histories；300 座標域 projections（含 tile coordinate 4,294,967,296）、3 active lifecycle histories、192 interleaved budget calls（0／1／2／7），bit31／63 的 15／9 unique candidates。各 probe 的 P256_AFTER selector 皆綁定實際 canonical／ESM／CJS module。
- 各 module 另通過 75 reentrant comparisons／310 retained snapshots，position x／y／z getter 次數 21／17／25、options maxDistance／maxVerticalDistance 9／3；frozen endpoints [1.2,0,1.2]／[9.2,0,7.2] 不變。Array-species frozen Proxy 完整序列相同，三輪計數 4,385／6,724／4,385。
- 各 module 通過 24 條 same-center zero／positive-cost explicit-link paths，含 directed reverse unreachable、disabled epoch、radius、retained snapshots 與 slots=8；以及 128 條 noninteger sloped paths、4 radii、15 revision toggles、16 retained snapshots。原始 cost／visited／狀態／waypoints 一致，包含 search 已建立但不可達的真實 visited 值，不只測 projection miss。
- 實際 browser source／dist 公開 root 各通過 1,664 projections、80 完整 paths、694 budget steps，visible、零 pageerror。新增 cohort 的 fixture 也納入該對照，不把與 P255 不同的總量誤稱工作預算改變。正式 browser create-cancel CPU cohort 另實際逐次檢查 pending／cancelled／expansions／result／slots；OPM adapter 既有 Vite dynamic-import analysis warning 保留，未冒稱音訊驗證。
- 只改 private createSearch workspace 生命周期及四份 mesh runtime／map，jobs Set 註冊／release、公開 API／declarations、package 版本、依賴、輸入／結果所有權、P255／P254／P252 能力及使用者改動保留。README 中／英／日、PLAN、DESIGN、英文／繁中技術文件同步；按功能提交，不 push／升版。
- 未執行 full suite；未量測 JS allocation 數／retained heap／GC pause、純 constructor／首條冷路徑、CJS CPU、GPU／RAF／CPU submit／呈現 fps、其他 browser／backend、Safari／physical devices 或 OPM unlock／cleanup。profile 的 GC frame 不等於 GC 量測，延後 native state construction 不冒充已證實記憶體／fps 改善，Node 長／稀疏路徑代價不隱藏。
- 文件格式與相對檔案連結於提交前檢查，歷史 ACCEPTANCE bytes 保留；所有 throwaway modules／profiles／benchmarks 與隔離 build tree 於提交前刪除。

## P257 — Reject ownership-before-freeze path publication (2026-11-17)

### Candidate, contract and decision

The P256 full-miss profile ranked publish as a large self-sample frame (36,534 µs at 100 µs sampling); this ranks investigation, not a WeakSet root cause or unprofiled cost. The isolated candidate changes only publication ordering: construct the identical complete path, add that identity to the private paths WeakSet, then Object.freeze it before returning. All field evaluation, nested freezing, job phases, geometry and numeric operations remain unchanged. No freeze is removed and no brand, wrapper, public API or weakened ownership is introduced. P242 instead deferred winning projection-record materialization, so that already-rejected candidate was not repeated.

Reject this candidate. Node full projection-miss paths regress 2.150914% and long paths regress 1.556566%, each worse in five of six pairs. Chromium improves these targets by only 1.736629% and 1.177068%, each faster in four of six pairs, not a stable target benefit. Short and sparse route results are also mixed. Pre-search cancellation never executes publish yet moves -5.417632% in Node and +4.370580% in Chromium (all six pairs); project controls are unchanged too. These controls do not establish a causal WeakSet/freezing gain, and no JIT/GC explanation is invented. The Chromium triangle control's -50.685921% pair is preserved, not trimmed or selectively rerun.

Canonical source, tests and dist remain at P256 / 56aff69e9. This is evidence-only documentation, not an adopted optimization. Dependencies, public types, vendor, package version 1.23.0 and user-owned work are untouched; no push.

### Reproducible CPU boundary and every paired sample

Current canonical P256 mesh source was independently snapshotted, TypeScript 6.0.3 ES2022-transpiled, with the same freshly snapshotted current PartitionSearch helper and production dependencies on both sides. Candidate files live only in the temporary tree. Node v26.7.0 and pinned Playwright Chromium 153.0.8010.12 darwin/arm64 desktop automation run sequentially, no concurrent build/benchmark. Chromium's document is visible with zero page errors. These are source-slot public-method consumers, not production minified-ESM or CJS CPU measurements.

The fixed thirteen cohorts are single-square inside, empty tile projection, 48×48 quads at radius 0/0.2, outside points, sloped quads, two stacked 24×24 floors, 24×24 split triangles, complete 12×12/32×32 routes, a 32,768-polygon sparse route, full empty-tile projection-miss paths and complete create/cancel lifecycle. Construction/destruction stay outside timing. Warm calls per side are 4,096 projections or empty/sparse/cancel paths and 128 ordinary complete paths. Each of six alternating ABBA/BAAB rounds has two samples/side: 65,536 calls for single/empty/sparse/miss/cancel, 4,096 for other projections, 1,024 short complete paths or 512 long complete paths. Each runtime has 78 cohort-round rows and 312 samples. No selected rerun.

Times below are CPU wall µs/query or complete lifecycle operation, not RAF, GPU, CPU-submit or presentation time. Before/after summaries are medians of six two-sample pair means; changes are medians of six paired percentages (not percentages recomputed from independent medians). Negative is faster. All four raw normalized sample values and outliers follow.

### Executed consumer verification

- Existing temporary source-slot comparison probes passed against the candidate: 3,341 seeded projections, 325 complete paths and twelve getter histories; 300 coordinate-domain projections including tile coordinate 4,294,967,296, three lifecycle histories and 192 interleaved budget calls; bit-31/63 membership with fifteen/nine unique candidates; seventy-five reentrant comparisons with 310 retained snapshots and identical property-read counts; owned/frozen endpoint values.
- Frozen-array species Proxy histories match exactly at radii 0/0.2/0 (4,385 / 6,724 / 4,385 reads each side). Twenty-four explicit-link paths cover zero and positive center costs, directed reverse unreachability, radius and epoch changes. Another 128 sloped paths cover four radii, fifteen revision changes and sixteen retained snapshots.
- Pre-search proof preserves two empty/valid histories, eight simultaneous pending jobs, ninth-job rejection, zero/one budgets, unchanged cancellation expansion counts, replacement and invalidation cleanup. Logical slot ownership remains independent of deferred search workspace.
- A new throwaway real consumer probe compares synchronous and incrementally stepped found, projection-miss and actual search-unreachable results. Across both variants it checks twelve owned paths, twenty-four rejected forged objects, twelve retained snapshots and two lifecycle histories. Every published object in those path trees is frozen; Reflect mutation/deletion attempts fail without altering values; foreign-mesh ownership fails; both kinds of unreachable paths are legitimately owned; the search-phase unreachable path retains visited > 0, while projection misses retain zero. Revision changes and destroy invalidate current-path checks, and snapshots remain unchanged. Own fields, descriptors, complete values and incremental expansion counts match baseline. No mocked result or private-field interception is used.
- Formal tests/typecheck/lint/build and production source/dist public-root browser probes were not rerun because no implementation is adopted. Prior P256 results retain their historical scope, not re-certified here. No CJS CPU, heap/allocation count, GC pause, frame-rate, Safari, physical-device, three-backend or audio certification is claimed.
- Documentation-only finishing checks: Prettier for six documents, relative file links (not anchor certification), exact historical ACCEPTANCE prefix preservation, temporary-tree cleanup and an empty-index/exact six-document commit allowlist.

## P258 — Reuse the current region within one smoothing primitive (2026-11-17)

### Adopted dataflow and precise scope

Baseline commit 4ab6cf8da contains the P257 evidence-only rejection and unchanged P256 implementation. A fresh complete-path profile identifies query-local region reads among long-route hotspots. This phase removes duplicate current-region reads specifically in smoothing, not the P170 zero-radius shortcut, the rejected P249 index-array cache, or P250 search-expansion reuse.

The original first region(polygonIndex) acquisition remains directly before clipSegment. A local currentRegion reference feeds the same clipping call and, when reached, both incoming/outgoing portal calls. This eliminates up to two duplicate private reader/Map lookups in that primitive. Existing positive-radius query-cache entries are not replaced after initialization; zero-radius calls return the same immutable geometry surface. No new cross-primitive state, global cache, metadata, wrapper, scratch object, input normalization or allocation-bearing abstraction is introduced.

All actual vertices/Proxy reads, portal order, crossing/height arithmetic, link barriers and primitive budgets remain unchanged. Other jobs may change radius or revision in the mesh-level cache, but the existing query-local Map retains its region identity; this change neither replaces that isolation nor extends reference reuse to later primitives. Public shape, ownership, frozen output and slot accounting remain unchanged.

Adopt for the explicit removal of redundant private lookups and the repeated short-route consumer evidence, not universal speed. Source-slot short routes improve in all six pairs in both Node (-1.229325%) and Chromium (-0.736771%). Actual minified-ESM short routes improve -0.462424% in Node (five faster pairs) and -3.235406% in Chromium (six). Long routes are not a stable universal gain: source Node +0.646798% (four slower), source Chromium -2.207060% (six faster), production Node +0.517547% (all six slower) and production Chromium -0.597087% (only four faster, including a +19.025522% slower pair). Production Node full misses are +2.017597% slower in all six pairs; production sparse routes are +1.069753% (five slower). These costs are retained, not hidden or represented as a total-navigation speedup.

Projection and pre-search-cancel controls do not execute the changed smoothing code; their timing changes are not credited as causal gains. In particular broad production Chromium projection-control improvements cannot establish a smoothing mechanism. Node cancel outliers reach +257.668701% in the source slot and +263.859632% in production; all samples remain present, with no trimmed outliers, favorable rerun or speculative JIT/GC explanation.

### Fixed CPU boundary: source-slot and actual published ESM

Node and pinned Playwright Chromium 153.0.8010.12 darwin/arm64 desktop automation run sequentially for each matrix, with no concurrent build/benchmark. Browser documents are visible, with zero page errors. Both sides use independently initialized real public-method fixtures; the source baseline/helper is freshly frozen from the current canonical code. The second matrix uses the actual old/new minified mesh output, with unchanged production dependencies, not a hand-minified approximation. CJS semantics are verified below, but CJS CPU is not measured.

Thirteen cohorts are fixed before measurement: single-square inside, empty tile projection, 48×48 quads at radius 0/0.2, outside points, sloped quads, two stacked 24×24 floors, 24×24 split triangles, complete 12×12/32×32 routes, a 32,768-polygon sparse route, full empty-tile projection-miss paths and complete create/cancel lifecycle. Construction/destruction stays outside samples. Warm calls/side are 4,096 for projection/empty/sparse/cancel and 128 ordinary complete paths. Each of six alternating ABBA/BAAB rounds records two samples/side: 65,536 operations for single/empty/sparse/miss/cancel, 4,096 for other projections, 1,024 short paths or 512 long paths. Each runtime/slot has 78 rows and 312 timings; all 1,248 timings are preserved.

Units are CPU wall µs/query or complete lifecycle operation. Summary before/after cells are medians of six two-sample pair means; signed changes are medians of six paired percentages, not percentages recalculated from independent medians. Negative is faster. No RAF/GPU/CPU-submit/presentation FPS, heap, allocation count or GC-pause claim follows.
