### Executed verification, protected build and delivery

- Source Prettier, strict tsc -p tsconfig.check.json --noEmit and scoped ESLint passed. Three existing files navigation-mesh / navigation-jobs / navigation-scheduler pass all 28 tests. No new permanent test or dependency is added and no full-suite result is claimed.
- The isolated HEAD export receives only mesh.ts and runs actual tsc/minify/vendor/CJS build steps. Its initial temporary hash guard failed before compilation/promotion because phase-ID substitution had mistyped sha256 as sha257. The typo was corrected to sha256; the already-prepared tree resumed at the hash/build boundary without repeating successful strict/lint/tests or setup. Full output-byte comparison confirms exactly four changed mesh runtime/map files; declarations, all other outputs and vendor are unchanged. Eleven pre-existing user-owned narrowphase/world2d source/distribution files retain their SHA256 values and are not promoted or staged.
- The measured prototype equals the formatted canonical source. All ten real comparison probes run against canonical source, actual ESM and actual CJS targets, each explicitly bound through P258_AFTER (plus the earlier isolated source-slot run). Each target preserves 3,341 seeded projections, 325 complete paths, twelve getter histories; 300 coordinate-domain projections including tile coordinate 4,294,967,296; three lifecycle histories and 192 interleaved budget steps; bit-31/63 membership with fifteen/nine unique candidates; seventy-five reentrant comparisons and 310 retained snapshots with exact property-read counts; frozen owned endpoint values.
- Each target's frozen-array species Proxy histories remain identical at radii 0 / 0.2 / 0 (4,385 / 6,724 / 4,385 reads). Twenty-four explicit-link paths preserve zero/positive center costs, directed reverse unreachability, radius/revision and retained snapshots; 128 noninteger sloped paths preserve four radii, fifteen revision toggles and sixteen retained snapshots.
- Each target retains two pre-search histories, eight pending slots, ninth rejection, zero/one budgets, unchanged cancellation expansions and replacement/invalidation cleanup. Publication consumer checks compare synchronous/incremental found, projection-miss and search-unreachable results: twelve owned paths, twenty-four rejected forgeries, twelve retained snapshots, two lifecycle histories, deep freezing, failed Reflect mutation attempts, foreign ownership rejection, visited=0 only for true projection misses, visited>0 for search-unreachable, and revision/destroy invalidation. Full fields/descriptors/values and expansion counts agree.
- Actual browser root consumers run through source and dist entry points separately: each preserves 1,664 projections, eighty paths and 694 incremental job steps, visible document and zero page errors. The existing Vite OPM-adapter dynamic-import analysis warning remains; this is not an audio/backend certification.
- Six documentation files and the changed source receive final Prettier checks; relative file links are checked (not anchor certification), original ACCEPTANCE bytes are preserved, temporary trees are removed and an empty-index/exact eleven-file allowlist protects the feature commit. No push, version change, Safari/physical-device certification, three-backend benchmark or heap/GC/FPS assertion.

## P259 — Reject no-movement heap-store guards (2026-11-17)

### Candidate family and conservative decision

Baseline bd384ba71 / P258. Shared PartitionSearch is called directly by NavigationMesh3D and NavigationTiledGraph3D; its current offer/take already use early-exit hole movement. The previously rejected P167 leaf-first Floyd sift is not retried. The P258 baseline profile's offer/take frames motivate inspection only, not a measured field-store root cause.

A newly pushed entry or an active entry obtained from the private entries Map already occupies entry.slot. If upward sifting never moves it, the unconditional final heap[slot]=entry and entry.slot=slot repeat existing state. Variant A guards those stores with slot !== entry.slot, adding a final field read. Variant B captures originalSlot at the initial read, sifts with a separate local slot and guards against the original scalar, avoiding that additional field read. Neither changes score/node comparisons, Map writes, raw node values, free-list recycling, hole movement, allocations or caller algorithms. Private numeric heap state has no public callback in these operations; both variants are different implementations, not repeated clocks of the same code.

Reject both rather than selecting their favorable cases. Variant A is mixed: source-slot mesh long routes improve only -0.141939% in Node (four faster pairs) and -0.728746% in Chromium (six), while Node short routes are +0.310064% and sparse mesh +1.189205% (five slower pairs). Tiled dense cases are mixed; sparse tiled gains of -4.276404% Node (six faster) / -0.837710% Chromium (four) are not a stable benefit for both complete callers.

Variant B avoids the guard's extra field read but regresses browser mesh: short +0.151515% (one faster, three slower, two equal) and long +0.268164% (five slower pairs), sparse +1.842997% (five slower, one equal). Node short/long gains are only -0.538807% / -0.298569%, and both dense tiled cases remain mixed. Sparse tiled again improves -4.251467% Node (five faster) / -0.840565% Chromium (five), insufficient to justify shared-helper browser mesh costs. A source-store reduction is not evidence of end-to-end acceleration. No speculative JIT, store-barrier or GC mechanism is asserted.

All first-variant clocks were retained before the second implementation ran; no favorable-round selection, outlier trimming or rerun of the same implementation. Empty projection/miss and pre-search cancellation do not execute offer, so their timing variation is not credited as causal gains. Source/dist, public types, dependencies, vendor, package version 1.23.0 and user-owned files remain at P258; no runtime adoption or push.

### Fixed public-consumer CPU boundary

Node v26.7.0 / TypeScript 6.0.3 ES2022, freshly snapshotted canonical helper and both current callers. Before/after source-slot mesh and tiled classes differ only in their selected frozen-before/candidate helper modules; all other production dependencies are shared. Pinned Playwright Chromium 153.0.8010.12 darwin/arm64 desktop automation uses visible documents with zero page errors. Each Node mesh, Node tiled, Chromium mesh and Chromium tiled matrix runs sequentially, without concurrent builds/benchmarks. These are real complete findPath/lifecycle consumers, not an isolated heap-loop CPU score, production minified ESM/CJS, or public-root browser certification.

Each variant has sixteen fixed cohorts: thirteen existing mesh cases (single inside, empty projection, 48×48 quad radius 0/0.2, outside, slope, stacked 24×24 floors, split triangles, short/long complete paths, 32,768-polygon sparse route, complete projection-miss paths and full create/cancel) plus three tiled cases (12×12 / 32×32 weighted grids and a 32,768-node sparse world). Tiled weights are noninteger; sparse worlds traverse only their actual short connected component. Set-up/destruction stays outside samples.

Six alternating ABBA/BAAB rounds have two samples/side. Mesh warms 4,096 projections/empty/sparse/cancel or 128 ordinary complete paths; measured calls are 65,536 single/empty/sparse/miss/cancel, 4,096 other projections, 1,024 short or 512 long paths. Tiled warms 128 dense or 4,096 sparse paths; measured calls are 2,048 / 512 / 65,536 for tiled12 / tiled32 / tiled-sparse32768. Each runtime/variant has 96 rows and 384 samples; both runtimes/variants total 1,536 timings, all retained below.

Times are CPU wall µs/query or complete lifecycle. Before/after summary cells are medians of six two-sample pair means; changes are medians of six paired percentages, not recomputed from independent medians. Negative is faster. Unchanged controls and all outliers remain; no allocation/heap/GC-pause, rendering/GPU/RAF/CPU-submit/FPS, Safari or physical-device benefit is claimed.

### Executed verification and non-claims

Both isolated variants pass the same thirteen real comparison scripts before their fixed CPU clocks:

- Heap differential: three sparse numeric domains, 9,225 offers and 7,416 takes; finite fractional/negative lowered priorities and stable score-then-node ordering; exact numeric distance/parent Maps; zero-slot reopens and recycled entries; private probe domain includes Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER without truncating keys. Separate signed-zero checks retain Map SameValueZero coalescing but the last-offered raw ±0 from take, including recycled root values. No NaN/invalid-priority ordering certification is implied.
- Tiled graph: 384 complete paths, 552 interleaved incremental job steps, raw own values, frozen retained results, exclusions/radius/revision handling and full slot release. These exercise actual Dijkstra/backtrack/forward/publish, not fake search results.
- Mesh numeric/getter proof: 3,341 seeded projections, 325 complete paths, twelve getter histories; 300 coordinate projections including tile coordinate 4,294,967,296; three lifecycle histories and 192 interleaved budget steps; signed bit-31/63 membership with fifteen/nine unique candidates; seventy-five reentrant comparisons with 310 retained snapshots and unchanged property-read counts; owned/frozen endpoint values.
- Frozen-array species Proxy histories remain exact at radii 0/0.2/0 (4,385 / 6,724 / 4,385 reads). Twenty-four explicit-link paths cover zero/positive center costs, directed unreachability and radius/revision retention. Another 128 sloped paths preserve four radii, fifteen revisions and sixteen retained snapshots.
- Pre-search histories retain eight pending slots, ninth rejection, zero/one budgets, cancellation expansion counts, replacement and invalidation cleanup. Publication comparisons preserve twelve owned paths, twenty-four rejected forgeries, twelve retained snapshots, two lifecycle histories, complete frozen trees, failed Reflect mutations, foreign ownership rejection, true projection-miss versus actual search-unreachable visited counts and revision/destroy invalidation.

No canonical implementation is adopted, so formal tests, strict/scoped lint, build, production ESM/CJS CPU and actual source/dist public-root browser probes are not rerun. P258 verification retains its historical scope; merely locating the existing sparse-frontier test does not claim it ran again. No new permanent test, dependency, capability or runtime artifact is added. Documentation finishing checks cover Prettier on six files, relative file links (not anchors), original ACCEPTANCE-prefix bytes, cleanup of owned temporary files and an empty-index/exact six-document commit allowlist.

## P260 — Reject target-particle reuse and per-tick specialization (2026-11-17)

### Baseline, native resource boundary and decision

Baseline 8c2141ec3 / P259. Existing pooled Sprite integration, target-layer generation/source validation and prior P151/P176 appearance/empty-pool work were inspected, along with the actual particles2d benchmark and backend/showcase runners. This phase uses genuine browser ImageBitmap objects created from ImageData and actual engine Texture objects; no fake Node bitmap, search/update stub, validation suppression or borrowed-resource fallback is used.

Fresh source-root profiles identify target advance and writeTargetAppearance as prominent frames. Candidate A carries the already-confirmed borrowed slot and the integrated x/y values through advance, removing a private targetAppearance wrapper and one duplicate slot lookup while retaining generation/source/numeric checks. Generic Sprite fallback still reads lifetime after the public vector setter, preserving that ordering.

Candidate B starts independently from the canonical baseline, not from A. It follows the existing advanceSprites convention with a specialized active-target loop holding immutable start/end spans and existing buffer/scratch references only for that tick. It preserves the original generic advance/appearance path for rate-born particles, the source-key width/height memo and its per-tick reset, generation checks, swap-remove retirement, full transform/tint validation, world birth axes and exact arithmetic expressions. No instance span cache is introduced, unlike P151; no extra per-particle/per-tick objects or per-instance fields are introduced.

Reject both. A makes large world targets +1.058535% and churn +0.573325% slower in all six pairs; large local +0.293040%, small local +0.590164% and small world +0.563379% are each slower in five pairs. The unchanged populated Sprite-world control moves -9.523008% in all six pairs and is not credited as a target-path gain.

B regresses large target local/world +31.868886% / +31.169572% (all six slower), small local +31.447431% (all six), small world +30.601477% (five slower, one faster) and churn +36.791634% (all six). Its unchanged populated Sprite controls also move +1.942332% / +2.054956% (all six slower), not proof of a target mechanism. Empty controls are only a few nanoseconds/frame with very wide percentage ranges and cannot support meaningful speed claims. All values/outliers are preserved; no speculative JIT/inline/register/GC root cause is asserted.

Canonical source/dist, private declarations, public API, user-owned work, dependencies, vendor and package version 1.23.0 remain unchanged. This is evidence-only documentation, not an adopted runtime optimization or backend certification.

### Executed exact consumer proof and limits

Each candidate first passes the same real-resource differential: eight modes covering local/world Sprite and target layers, manual bursts and positive-rate churn; 256 ticks/mode, 2,048 state comparisons, 632 lifecycle/source/generation mutations and 48 invalid-delta checks across both sides. Comparisons recursively use Object.is, not a numeric tolerance or JSON serialization that loses signed zero.

Observed state includes active/emitting counts, all Sprite positions/scales/tint/visibility and world matrices; target insertion order, active count/topology version, borrowed slot generation, all affine/tint/anchor values, transform/tint/source/anchor versions, source identity/crop and world matrices. Parent movement/rotation/nonuniform scale, mixed dt=0 / 1/240 / 1/60 / 0.08 / 0.25, stop/start, clear/re-emit, external remove/reuse with different native texture, per-slot crop/source changes, expiry and rate-born particles are exercised. Retained borrowed slot objects continue to match. Invalid negative/NaN/Infinity dt produces the same error class/message; destroyed-target cleanup keeps its existing precedence even with NaN dt.

Owning Group destruction releases emitters/target children but does not destroy borrowed textures; resources are explicitly destroyed after all fixtures. Visible browser documents have no page errors. The existing Vite OPM dynamic-import analysis warning is retained and does not constitute an audio test.

No implementation is adopted, so formal particle tests, strict/scoped checks, build, canonical/production emitter or CJS CPU, actual three-backend/showcase pixels, full-frame/RAF/CPU-submit, allocation/heap/GC-pause, Safari or physical-device certification are not rerun. Reading the existing tests/examples/runners is not recorded as their execution. Documentation finishing checks cover six-file Prettier, relative file links (not anchors), exact original ACCEPTANCE-prefix bytes, cleanup of owned temporary resources and empty-index/exact six-document commit allowlisting. No push or version change.

## P261：完整 Game profile 與跨 Scene presentation cache 身份修正（2026-11-17）

### 範圍、證據與採用結果

- 沿用小語持續優化／依功能自動提交的授權；本輪先 profile 實際 Game frame，再修正擴大 presentation reuse 前發現的身份碰撞。採用的功能只有跨 Scene 唯一的 pass nonce，不將未實作的 ParticleSprite／renderer 改動算成成果。
- Scene membership 已由 global update stamp 凍結，preupdate／animation／action empty-pass gates 與 command uniform-key sorting 已存在；不重做已有快路徑。實際 local ParticleSprite override 呼叫 super，但不滿足 base-only cache identity guard；world override 也未使用該 cache，僅作後續熱點線索。
- 查證矩陣快取會隨 GameObject／Object3D 跨 Scene 保留，原 Scene 卻各自從相同 counter 配發 pass ID。真實 Game／Sprite／原生 bitmap 的 WebGL2 repro：Sprite 先在 x=-32 離屏 render 一幀，移至新 Scene 的 x=64 後首幀仍取舊 matrix/bounds，被錯誤 cull；次幀才回到 x=64。這不是合成 getter 計數或 source-text 測試。
- 將 beginPresentation／beginMatrixPass 都改成使用同一個 module-global lastPresentation，移除每 Scene 的 private presentationCount。非 pass 仍為零、已開 pass 的 beginMatrixPass guard 不變；不新增 per-object 欄位、Map、第二套 cache、protected API 或 override cache，不改數值運算式與公開選項。
- 這是既有效能快取的 correctness prerequisite，不宣稱本 commit 有 paired CPU、GPU 或 fps 改善；ParticleSprite 及 renderer 本輪保持原實作。沒有新增依賴、push 或 package version 變更。

### 實際 Game RAF profile 方法與原始摘要

- pinned Chromium 153.0.8010.12，darwin/arm64，desktop automation；每組均為 visible page、actual /src/index.ts、強制 WebGL2 且驗證 WebGL2RenderingContext、native ImageBitmap(4×4 RGBA255) 與實際 Texture。不是 Node 假 bitmap，也不是直接反覆呼叫單粒子函式。
- Game.create 1280×720、pixelRatio=1、autoResize=false、frameWorkBudgetMs=1000/60；以 Scene.update 的 counter 觀察已完成的同步 RAF callback，實際 Game 執行 input／scene／ECS／simulation／presentation／beginFrame-render-endFrame。各組四個 emitter × capacity8192，初始 emit8192、rate0、life1e6、speed[1,3]、angle[-π,π]、acceleration[.25,-.5]、size[8,4]→[16,12]、color[1,.2,.3,1]→[.1,.8,.9,0]、seed17+i；位置[160+320i,360]、rotation.3、scale[1.3,.7]。Sprite／targetLayer 與 local／world 四組逐一執行，無 paired CPU jobs 重疊。
- 每組先 90 warm frames，再 CDP Profiler.requested interval100µs，觀察180個完整 Game callbacks 後 pause。dt 是實際 Game clock，不是固定 simulation dt；四組 activeCount 均維持4×8192。下表 frameWork 數字只取停止前最後一幀，保留原 floating-point 值，不是平均、percentile 或可歸因 speedup；不以RAF wall time除frame數當CPU時間。

## P262：以 affine ownership 分型重用 local presentation composition（2026-11-17）

### 採用結果與不能省略的成本

- 延續小語的持續效能優化／依功能自動提交授權。採用 private local／world Sprite ownership 分型，直接使用既有 base cache，不增加一般使用者 API。判準是正式 minified 的實際 Game，而非只看 simulation 小函式。
- 正式 WebGL2、4×8192 主粒子的大型 local／world，四個具名 Game work categories 合計配對中位數為 -7.630795959627756%／-21.463717218978516%，兩者六輪皆較快；submit 分別 -7.508330038921246%／-10.974764342563315%，六輪皆較快。這是本輪保留依據，不是矩陣 cache 單獨貢獻或 fps 宣稱。
- 正式 mixed 合計 -0.16197955824373556%、small -1.9629390351758036%，均3快3慢，未確立穩定收益；source-slot small 合計 +5.194904920057642%（1快5慢）也保留。正式 mixed after-update +19.227271886724104%、world simulation category +19.000275560380263%，均六輪較慢；empty submit +18.73640811800209%（1快5慢）。不以合計改善隱藏這些分項成本。
- 未修改的 target 模擬／draw body control 方向不歸因為功能收益；empty 的矩陣未使用、instance layout 卻改變，不能把它的合計方向算成 matrix reuse 證據。source／production 是不同 scope，不跨絕對數字比較；不臆測 JIT／heap／GC 根因，也不宣稱所有 workload 都改善。

### 真正 Game CPU 配對方法

- pinned Chromium153.0.8010.12、darwin/arm64、desktop automation、visible page；強制 WebGL2。每 scope 六 cohorts，固定順序 mixed-large、local-large、world-large、local-small、target-layer-local、empty-Sprite。mixed 先 warm，讓 local／world class shapes 都被使用，不只測單一 local shape。
- before／after 各用完整一致的 module universe：同一份實際 dist 除 emitter slot 外 bytes 不變；source-slot emitter 兩側均以同一 TypeScript ES2022/ESM 方式轉譯，production slot 則是實際 frozen-before 與目前 minified 發佈檔。所有相對 import 保留 URL 前綴，Game／Scene／Emitter／Sprite 的 instanceof 相容，不混入不會被 Scene 自動推進的外來 emitter。
- 每側用實際 Game.create／Scene、native ImageBitmap(4×4 RGBA255) 與 Texture，兩個 visible canvas1280×720、整頁1280×1440、pixelRatio1、autoResizefalse、frameWorkBudgetMs=1000/60；任一時刻只啟動一個 Game，另一側 pause。不是用獨立 numeric loop 代替 Game 或只呼叫 renderer。
- 每側四個主 emitter，各capacity8192（small128），rate0、life1e6、speed[0,0]、angle[-π,π]、acceleration[0,0]、size[8,4]→[8,4]、color[.7,.2,.4,.8]→相同、seed17+i、rectangle512×256、position[160+320i,360]、rotation.3、scale[1.3,.7]。mixed 前兩個local／後兩個world；target用正式ParticleLayer2D；empty維持完整pool但不emit。靜態運動避免跨時鐘不等的pose／overflow，仍執行正式simulation與全部submit。
- 每側另加1個capacity1／life.001／rate0 sentinel，以正式 Scene 自然過期證明 automatic emitter simulation。每fixture先64warm+1probe frames，assert sentinel.activeCount0與主粒子數；不是手動呼叫其update。每sample再8warm後取48個完整RAF callback的frameWork平均值，Scene.update只queue同一個microtask observer，在Game完成render與counter.finish後讀取既有stats、pause。
- 六輪交替ABBA／BAAB，每輪兩個before／兩個after；每scope36rows／144samples／6912個sampled Game frames（不含warm）。source／production共288samples，沒有同時跑別的CPU benchmark／profiler、build／test／formatter。下面每側µs是六個round-mean的中位數；paired Δ是六個「after mean/before mean-1」的中位數，不是兩個獨立中位數之比，ties／outliers全部保留。
- submitUs 是現有Game.frameWork.renderSubmitMs×1000的同步wall-clock span（包含native driver呼叫，不等待GPU completion）；categorySumUs只加simulation／navigation／afterUpdate／submit四段，不包含未計測tail／observer，不能當完整RAF wall time、process CPU usage、GPU時間或呈現fps。公開stats含量測負擔。
- Initial full-Game fixture stopped before timing samples: expiry sentinel omitted required angle/startSize/endSize/startColor/endColor options; corrected the sentinel from the actual constructor contract and restarted the fixed matrix. 沒有產生可保留的timing，未剔除任何有效sample；只是補齊真實constructor要求的fixture options，未改引擎驗證、lifetime或負載來隱藏錯誤。

### Simulation-only controls：不要冒充matrix／完整frame收益

沿用P260的八cohort固定steps／warm／seed／source-slot依賴與真實bitmap fixture，不加入presentation；每案六輪兩側各兩個samples，全部192timings。大型Sprite／target每sample512updates，小型target16384、empty65536、churn8192；相關warm與lifecycle方法沿用P260。staticfixture保持零speed／acceleration、長life及seeded rectangle，churn保留positive rate／expiry。純simulation不測新的presentation cache，local方向也不單獨歸因為矩陣重用；極短empty控制受timer granularity影響，不做收益宣稱。

### 功能與保留契約

- local pool sprite 不再經過僅轉呼叫 super 的 updateWorldMatrix override；直接繼承 Sprite／GameObject 的既有 base composition，因而符合原本的 base-only presentation cache guard。沒有新增 cache flag、Map、Matrix3、protected API 或放寬自訂 override 判斷；renderer 仍走原正式 collection／draw 路徑。
- world births 的四個 affine axes 與 updateWorldMatrix 移至 private WorldParticleSprite；pool constructor 依 immutable simulationSpace 選定型別，target layer 不建 Sprite pool。local 不再保存四個無用途 axes 與 per-particle simulationSpace，world 也不再重複保存該字串；shared position／scale／tint aliases 與全部模擬運算式不變。這是 source 欄位結構變更，不當作已量測 heap／GC 或配置量。
- 唯一 world retainAxes caller 依既有 world-pool invariant 遷移；公開 ordinary Sprite／ParticleEmitter／ParticleLayer2D 型別與 entry 不變，沒有 shim、新 runtime 依賴、GPU handle 或裸 ECS 入口。P261 跨 Scene nonce 是現有 cache 身份前提，不另改 Scene／GameObject。

### 原生 lifecycle 與實際 Game 的 consumer proof

- 原生 ImageBitmap／Texture 的既有八模式 differential fixture：2,048 組 Object.is（含 signed zero）state／matrix／slot version comparisons、632 次 lifecycle／source／generation mutations、48 個 invalid delta cases，保留 source／generation／retire／expiry／borrowed ownership 契約。
- 每一 scope 在 Canvas2D／WebGL2／WebGPU 都跑 local、world、local-custom、local-screen、local-transfer 五種真正 Game scenario；32 個 live Sprites、12 matched frames／case、移動／旋轉／非等比縮放父階與 emitter、camera zoom／position、parent tint／opacity、parent／individual Sprite matrix override 與第七幀轉移 Scene。不是直接呼叫 simulation 來假冒 Game 更新。
- snapshot 在真實 render 結束後讀取既有 worldMatrix.elements，沒有額外 updateWorldMatrix 掩蓋 stale cache；同頁以 Object.is 比數字（不經 JSON 丟失 -0）。每案 6,552 個精確數字、nonuniform before/after native PNG bytes 一致；每 scope 共15 cases／98,280 numbers，三 scope共294,840 numbers。Texture 在 Game.destroy 後仍 borrowed-alive，顯式 destroy 關閉真實 bitmap；全部 pageerrors=0。
- source-slot 是 before/candidate emitter TS 同方式轉譯，其餘 dependency 使用實際 dist；actual-dev-root 的 after 真正 import /src/index.ts，actual-production-root 使用 frozen before 與目前發佈 minified bytes 的完整相容 module graphs。前綴只改供檔 URL，未替換 Game／Scene／renderer 實作或用 instance hack；Frame proof 的 class identity 與自然 simulation 一致。

### 檢查、產物與邊界

- 新增一個 consumer-visible particle regression：個別 Sprite 的 matrix override 不會在同 presentation 重複累加，下一 presentation 父階位移即時生效；不是 call-count／source-text／wiring 測試。既有 tests/particles2d.test.ts 與 tests/gameplay2d-core.test.ts 共36 tests 通過，strict tsc --noEmit 與兩檔 scoped ESLint 通過。
- 隔離 HEAD tree 只覆蓋本輪 emitter source，tsc／minify／vendor copy／CJS build 完成；完整 byte guard 僅四個 emitter .js／.map／.cjs／.map 變更後才提升，公開 declaration 不變。11 個 user-owned physics2d/narrowphase／data/world2d source／dist 的前後 SHA256 一致。

- 既有正式 dist-alias gallery smoke：particles2d auto／webgpu／webgl2／canvas2d 4/4 PASS，showcase 同四種4/4 PASS，全部 non-blank／errors空；已目視實際 production local-transfer frame。這不認證所有 graphics／audio 功能。
- 既有 OPM dynamic-import Vite warning 保留；未改 vendor／DSP、未做 audio unlock／聽測、Node/CJS graphics CPU、full suite／完整 browser regression、heap／allocation／GC、GPU timestamp／呈現 fps、Safari／實機認證。

### 交付與未重跑項目

## P263：拒絕集中式 slot affine-copy helper（2026-11-17）

### 決策與範圍

- 沿用小語持續優化與依功能自動提交的授權。P261 的實際 frame profile 顯示 layer matrix／bounds 成本；目前共同 command culling 透過 getWorldBounds→getSlotWorldMatrix→slotMatrix，Canvas2D draw 也呼叫 getSlotWorldMatrix，因此不是只優化不會被真正consumer使用的helper。GPU upload既有slot getters則不改。
- 唯一候選：在private Slot中以copyMatrix集中讀取同一既有#values subarray，layer.slotMatrix只delegate；原本六個getter仍保留給borrowed ParticleSlot2D。沒有新增whole-buffer retention、array／Map／matrix配置、cache／flag、公開raw-array出口、模擬／renderer分支、依賴或lifetime state。
- requireSlot／alive／index／occupied validation、local/world分支、parent updateWorldMatrix callback後才查this.slots[index]與數值、既有九個element stores、所有浮點算式與source／generation／resource validation均保留。這個原型沒有因為callback而捕獲過時的numeric snapshot，也不在destroyedLayer保留額外backing。
- **拒絕採用**：source-slot真實Game mixed categorySum +2.0029559094904337%，六輪皆慢；local-large -0.22248367752707998%只有3快3慢，world-large -0.7578735126144986%只有4快2慢，small +4.866505376902874%（2快4慢）。無穩定大型收益而有mixed退步，不因正確性通過就當成performance通過。
- 未走該helper的Sprite control合計 -6.094785273872466%六輪快，after-update卻 +40.09533596021534%六輪慢；不將未修改路徑的方向當成候選因果收益，不挑選較好分項、不刪離群值、不臆測JIT／GC。empty方向與量測粒度也全保留。未以額外調參／縮小負載追逐一次理想結果。
- 正式source／dist從未套用候選，因此不需要revert使用者檔案，也不跑或冒稱新的formal tests／build／production CPU結果。本階段只交付六份證據文件，不push／升版。

### 可重現的候選片段

基準是目前 [ParticleLayer2D](./packages/core/src/particles2d/particle-layer2d.ts) 的六個getter版本。下列僅為隔離原型，不是已套用的功能：

```ts
// Inside the existing private Slot class:
copyMatrix(out: Matrix3): Matrix3 {
    const e = out.elements, values = this.#values;
    e[0] = values[0];
    e[1] = values[1];
    e[2] = 0;
    e[3] = values[2];
    e[4] = values[3];
    e[5] = 0;
    e[6] = values[4];
    e[7] = values[5];
    e[8] = 1;
    return out;
  }

// Inside ParticleLayer2D:
private slotMatrix(index: number): Matrix3 {
  return this.slots[index].copyMatrix(this.affine);
}
```

### 固定真實 Game 配對方法

- pinned Chromium153.0.8010.12、darwin/arm64、desktop-automation、visible page；不作實機／Safari認證。一次只跑此CPU矩陣，沒有其他CPU benchmark／profile、test／build／formatter job併行。三backend native proof先完成，callback edge probe在CPU矩陣結束後另跑。
- 六cohorts固定順序：layer-mixed-large、layer-local-large、layer-world-large、layer-local-small、sprite-local-control、layer-empty-control。前四個／empty使用正式target ParticleLayer2D，Sprite control使用P262目前的pool；mixed先warm兩種space。
- before／after各完整一致prefix module graph，由實際dist public root進入，只有ParticleLayer2D slot替換為兩側用同一TS ES2022／ESM轉譯的raw source；其餘minified Game／Scene／Emitter／Sprite／graphics bytes一致。相對imports保留prefix，避免混class使Scene略過自動simulation。不是direct-source-root或實際新minified layer的認證。
- 實際Game.create forced WebGL2、Scene、native ImageBitmap4×4RGBA255與Texture；兩個canvas各1280×720、viewport1280×1440、pixelRatio1、autoResizefalse、frameWorkBudgetMs1000/60，兩個Game從不一起start。每側四個主emitter，capacity8192（small128），rate0、life1e6、zero speed／acceleration、angle[-π,π]、start=end size[8,4]、start=end color[.7,.2,.4,.8]、seed17+i、rectangle512×256、position[160+320i,360]、rotation.3、scale[1.3,.7]。mixed前二local／後二world；empty完整capacity但不emit。
- 各側另有1個capacity1／life.001／rate0 sentinel，在64warm+1probe frame後自然消失，assert主emitter active count及sentinel0，證明真實Scene自動推進，不以手動simulation偽裝。static主粒子避免不同真實clock delta造成pose差或overflow，但完整simulation／bounds／submit仍執行。
- 每sample8warm+48measured realRAF frames；Scene.update queue同一個microtask observer，於同步render與frameWork finish後讀取既有simulationMs／navigationMs／afterUpdateMs／renderSubmitMs再pause。每輪ABBA／BAAB交替、兩個before兩個after，各六輪、36rows／144samples／6912sampledframes，warm／probe不列timings。
- 每欄before／after µs為六個round-mean之中位數；paired Δ是各round兩側mean比值減1的六數中位數，不是兩個獨立median之比。lower=faster，全部outliers／ties／sample順序保留。renderSubmit是同步native-driver wall span，不等待GPU完成；categorySum只是simulation／navigation／afterUpdate／submit四段之和，不含未計測tail或observer，不是整段RAF、process CPU time、GPU timestamps或呈現fps。

### 真實三 backend 動態 Game 差異對照

- 命令為逐一設定P263_BACKEND=canvas2d／webgl2／webgpu執行隔離dynamic.mjs，接著才執行game-bench.mjs；source-only slotGraph如上。沒有mock Texture、bitmap、renderer、RAF或替換Game／Scene引擎實作；PosedScene只使用既有public update hook驅動fixture pose。
- 每backend五modes：local／world／local-custom／local-screen／local-transfer。每側32個live target slots、12個真實Game frames；Shaken parent override加2，deterministic變動parent／emitter的translation／rotation／nonuniformscale、root tint／opacity與camera position／zoom，local-custom在target的public matrix override加3，transfer於第7frame前移到新Scene。
- 主粒子保持zero velocity／acceleration、start=endsize／color與life1e6，避免不同真實clock改變預期pose。snapshot在實際render後呼叫公開bounds／slot-matrix helper並讀取slot affine、space、tint、anchor、generation與各version；這不是P262的raw Sprite.worldMatrix只讀探針，也不掩飾呼叫helper的動作。另有實際nonblankPNG對照驗證真正renderer結果。
- 每case10500個數字、12個matched snapshots；同page遞迴Object.is於JSON序列化之前比對，包含signed zero。共15cases、157500個exactnumbers；沒有以JSON stringify抹平-0。下表PNG只比較同backend兩側，不宣稱跨backend像素parity。各Game與Texture／nativebitmap cleanup成功，pageerrors0；已實際開啟source-webgl2-local-after.png觀察粉紅粒子surface。

### Parent callback／generation／destroy consumer 邊界

在同一個真實browser以native bitmap／Texture、Group2D→ParticleLayer2D(capacity1)及公開getSlotWorldMatrix做四組before／candidate對照。parent.updateWorldMatrix在已requireSlot之後觸發transform、remove/reuse、remove或destroy；不在callback前hoist數值。比較out identity、matrix、retained frozen borrowed slot／generation、active與destroyed flags、invalid index拒絕及cleanup。共68個數字用Object.is精確相同；比較exception class與發生階段，不宣稱error message文字相等。

| Parent callback action | Result/error class | Active afterwards | Layer destroyed | Borrowed generation | Frozen record | Invalid probes                                             |
| ---------------------- | ------------------ | ----------------- | --------------- | ------------------- | ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| transform              | same output matrix | 1                 | false           | 1                   | true          | RangeError, RangeError, RangeError, RangeError, RangeError |
| reuse                  | same output matrix | 1                 | false           | 2                   | true          | RangeError, RangeError, RangeError, RangeError, RangeError |
| remove                 | same output matrix | 0                 | false           | 1                   | true          | RangeError, RangeError, RangeError, RangeError, RangeError |
| destroy                | TypeError          | 0                 | true            | 1                   | true          | Error, Error, Error, Error, Error                          |

remove後本次已borrowed slot的數值仍可完成，reuse反映同index的新generation2；destroy在本次parent composition後以TypeError失敗，既有out內容相同，之後invalid probes按原alive優先規則為Error。每組invalid probes為-1／NaN／Infinity／.5／1。Layer／parent destroy皆不摧毀borrowed Texture，顯式Texture.destroy關閉nativebitmap，pageerrors0。

## P264：拒絕額外的 world-particle presentation-pass cache（2026-11-17）

### 決策與本輪調查

- 延續小語持續優化／依功能自動提交授權。先讀目前Sprite source／size／anchor bounds、GameObject composition與共用affine products、partition／culling／sort／release、native quad／appearance與相關歷史；未重做已完成的local base cache／uniform-key sort，也未將只佔極少self samples的member-release loop當成主要熱點。
- 更新P262後的實際source root Game profile：四組Sprite／target × local／world，各4×8192 live particles、90warm／180profiledframes、pinned Chromium153.0.8010.12 darwin/arm64 desktop automation、visible、forcedWebGL2、nativebitmap與Texture。沿用P261的public pipeline fixture（speed[1,3]、acceleration[.25,-.5]、life1e6、point births、變化size／tint），CDP100µs interval。與下方static CPU paired fixture不同，不混稱同一負載。
- 這些instrumented sampling與last-frame stats只定位成本，不與P261絕對樣本相減當speedup、不是paired CPU／GPU／fps／heap證據。world private updateWorldMatrix仍有46518µs sampledself/180frames；collection／partition、simulation與native submit也有成本，完整top30各組全部保留。
- 唯一候選只在 [WorldParticleSprite](./packages/core/src/particles2d/index.ts) 加一個numeric worldPass。nonzero Scene.presentationPass且method identity仍是該privateworld implementation才可命中；nonreusable呼叫清stamp以免custom改過matrix後恢復原method沿用錯值，retainAxes在新出生時清stamp。globalSceneID沿用P261，不動base-only guard或新增protected hook。
- local／target／renderer未改，原九個矩陣stores、出生axesownership、simulation公式、source／generation／resource validation不改；不是把world附到新parent的localTransform。這是候選新增的per-world state，未量heap／allocation，不能按一個source欄位推算實際RAM／GC。
- **拒絕採用**：mixed submit -2.7990916698264035%、四段categorySum -3.196508226899625%，各六輪快；但targetworld submit +2.538431940584507%、sum +2.2685746893060244%，各只有2快4慢。不能為mixed單一方向接受額外cache與guard。
- 沒走worldmethod的local-large submit +11.731626909977866%、sum +13.918733331983768%，六輪皆慢；small sum +6.5252321214475%五輪慢，target control +1.8287537580500834%五輪慢，empty sum -31.392675611699026%六輪快。全部保留，未修改control方向不認定是helper收益／根因，不臆測JIT／GC；不靠重跑、改sample順序／閾值或減負載追逐正面結果。
- 正式source／dist從未套用候選，沒有revert任何使用者檔案；只提交六份證據文件，不push／升版。

### 隔離候選的精確邊界

只在privateWorld類別加`private worldPass = 0`，retainAxes入口加`this.worldPass = 0`；原worldmethod改如下，正式source仍保留未加cache版本：

```ts
override updateWorldMatrix(): Matrix3 {
    const pass = this.scene?.presentationPass ?? 0;
    const reusable =
      pass !== 0 &&
      this.updateWorldMatrix === WorldParticleSprite.prototype.updateWorldMatrix;
    if (reusable && this.worldPass === pass) return this.worldMatrix;
    const e = this.worldMatrix.elements,
      scale = this.extent,
      position = this.place;
    e[0] = this.axisXX * scale.x;
    e[1] = this.axisXY * scale.x;
    e[2] = 0;
    e[3] = this.axisYX * scale.y;
    e[4] = this.axisYY * scale.y;
    e[5] = 0;
    e[6] = position.x;
    e[7] = position.y;
    e[8] = 1;
    this.worldPass = reusable ? pass : 0;
    return this.worldMatrix;
  }
```

### 固定 source-slot 真實 Game CPU 矩陣

- 沿用P262已通過constructor與automatic-simulation guards的完整Game fixture，僅phaseID改P264、before／candidate emitter slot取目前source；兩側都用同一TypeScript ES2022／ESM轉譯，其餘actualminified dist bytes相同。相對imports保留各側整個prefix graph，Game／Scene／Emitter／Sprite identity一致；不是以foreign emitter或directupdate替代正式Scene。
- pinnedChrome與平台同上、visiblepage，兩個canvas1280×720／viewport1280×1440、pixelRatio1、autoResizefalse、frameWorkBudgetMs1000/60，forcedWebGL2；兩側Game從不一起start，另一側pause。此次CPU矩陣沒有同時跑其他CPU benchmark／profile、build／test／formatter；上述profile與三backend動態probe先完成，edgeprobe在CPU矩陣結束後執行。
- cohorts固定mixed-large、local-large、world-large、local-small、layer-local-control、empty-Sprite-control；mixed先warm兩種Spriteclass。每側四emitter，capacity8192（small128），各emit滿（empty0）；target control使用正式ParticleLayer2D。每側32768主粒子（small512），empty保留32768pool但不emit；另有capacity1/life.001 sentinel自然過期。
- static主粒子rate0／life1e6／speed[0,0]／angle[-π,π]／acceleration[0,0]／start=end size[8,4]／color[.7,.2,.4,.8]、seed17+i、rectangle512×256、position[160+320i,360]／rotation.3／scale[1.3,.7]，native4×4RGBA255 ImageBitmap與Texture。靜態主粒子防不同realclock delta造成pose／overflow差，但全部正式simulation與submit仍執行。
- 每fixture側64warm+1probeframes，assert main active與sentinel0，證明Scene自動模擬。每sample8warm+48measuredrealRAFframes；Scene.update僅queue同一microtask observer，在同步Game framework finish後讀simulationMs／navigationMs／afterUpdateMs／renderSubmitMs、平均µs/frame再pause。
- 六輪ABBA／BAAB交替，每輪兩before／兩after，六cohorts共36rows／144samples／6912sampledframes；warm與probe不計timings。before／after欄各為六roundmean之median，paired Δ則是六個roundmean比值減1的median，不是獨立median之比。lower=faster，所有samples／orders／ties／outliers保留。
- renderSubmit是同步native-driver wall span，不等待GPUcompletion；categorySum只加simulation／navigation／afterUpdate／submit四段，不含未計測tail／observer，不是wholeRAF、processCPU usage、GPUtimestamps或presentedfps。instrumentation負擔存在；不將微小control的timer粒度差當效能機制。

### 三 forced backend 的動態 consumer proof

- 依序以P264_BACKEND=canvas2d／webgl2／webgpu執行dynamic.mjs，然後才跑game-bench.mjs；均source-slot graph，非actualdirect-source或newproduction slot認證。nativebitmap／Texture／renderer／RAF均真實，未替換Game／Scene引擎；PosedScene只以publicupdatehook驅動pose。
- local／world各normal、custom、screen、transfer，共每backend8modes／24cases；每側32liveSprites／12realGameframes。moving／rotating／nonuniformscaled Shakenparent override加2，變動rootopacity／tint與camera position／zoom；custom在一個liveSprite的originalmatrix呼叫後加3；transfer於第7frame前把root移至新Scene。
- zero velocity／acceleration、constantstart=endappearance、life1e6避免跨clock非決定性。render後只讀既有Sprite.worldMatrix.elements、place／scale／tint／space，不額外updateWorldMatrix來掩飾stalecache。遞迴Object.is在JSONserialize前比對signedzero等全部數字，每case6552，共157248；rawsnapshot12組/case一致。
- 每case同backend before／after final nativePNGbytes一致且nonblank，不跨backend宣稱parity；borrowedTexture與nativebitmap cleanup成功，pageerrors0。已實際開啟source-webgl2-world-after.png觀察粉紅world粒子surface。

### 同 pass 重生／override 還原／外部讀取／跨 Scene

在同一nativebrowser與一致prefix graph，使用一個worldSpritepool、nativeTexture、rotatedmirrorednonuniform Group2D，依unscoped／beginPresentation／beginMatrixPass三histories逐一對照。每個history先base／repeat，安裝original+5的instanceoverride連呼兩次不重複累加，再restoreoriginal應回base；clear／emit同pass的新seededrectangle birth必須在新位置，不復用舊matrix；pass外連續移動兩次即時反映，轉Scene首讀與重讀也一致。

每次確認回傳identity仍為同一worldMatrix，expectedcustom x透過同樣matrixstorage的publiccopy與+5建立，不假設Float64的加法直接等於儲存後值。三histories共300個Object.is精確數字；同pass重生的點確實不同，未以相同birthpose假通過。三個trace與所有matrix如下，borrowedTexture ownership與nativebitmap.close通過，pageerrors0。

### 交付、未跑驗證與限制

- 僅同步README中英日、PLAN、DESIGN、英中技術文件與本節；append前6798696bytes的歷史保留，P262／P263的測試與production紀錄不改寫。所有source／dist與十一個使用者修改檔未被寫入，原型／fixture／未執行builder在保留證據後清理。
- 未跑formaltests／strict／lint／build、newactualminified／directsource root proof、Node／CJS CPU、simulation-onlymicrobenchmark、gallery／showcase、audio unlock／cleanup、fullbrowserregression、heap／GC／allocation／GPU／fps或實機／Safari認證。24cases與300數字只認證本source-slot原型的實際執行情境，不泛稱所有render-time mutation／public getter／瀏覽器行為相容。
- 文件格式、relative-file links與historicalprefix作scoped檢查，僅stage六份證據文件依功能提交，不push／升版。

## P265：拒絕 private WebGL2 UV scalar／重複 sum 共用（2026-11-17）

### 問題、候選與結果

- 沿用小語持續優化／依功能自動提交授權。P264目前真實frame profile的Sprite local packQuad有58057µs sampledself/180frames，作熱點方向而非本輪paired baseline。檢查已否決的P191固定參數與P192 memberArray.fill／P167 trig案，不重測同一候選。
- [WebGLRender2D.packQuad](./packages/graphics/src/webgl2-render2d.ts) 兩caller是batchSprite的getSpriteQuad2D與target sourceDirty的getTextureQuad2D；q來自renderer持有的createTextureQuad2D普通numeric record，不是publictexture／view／Sprite的getter物件。本候選只共用q的六個UV scalars與兩次重複的u0+ux／v0+vx。
- 不新增cache、Map／array／matrix、lifetime state、public API或依賴，不快取publicmetadata，也不以0／90°的atlas representation把通用four-corner min特例化。保留每個store、Math.min參數順序、((u0+ux)+uy)結合、abs span、Float32落點與所有validation／source／material／render ownership。
- **拒絕採用**：固定follow-on真正Game中world submit -2.510742477378841%（5快1慢）、四段合計 -4.595266063575981%（6快0慢）；但mixed sum +1.1001897528424176%、local-large sum +2.6127368468029655%，各1快5慢。local submit +1.3318959885199821%也是五輪慢，mixed after-update +23.38085690169438%六輪慢。不能用world單一收益接受通用packing改動。
- small sum -1.5553507153654555%只3快3慢，target control sum -1.11723759856448%五輪快；empty sum -46.27100313992577%六輪快卻沒有主粒子packing，不算UV因果收益。world simulation category -16.38727726566725%六輪快，body根本未改，亦不算privateUV單獨貢獻。完整分項／離群值／ties都保留，不臆測register spill／JIT／GC或fps。
- 初批有下述工具干擾限制，方向與follow-on不同也照錄；不把初批local／world較慢直接當成候選根因，不將follow-on挑好看數字採用。正式source／dist從未套用此案，本輪只提交六份證據文件，不push／升版。

### 候選精確程式（僅隔離原型，未套用）

```ts
private packQuad(data: Float32Array, offset: number, q: TextureQuad2D): void {
    data[offset + 12] = q.x;
    data[offset + 13] = q.y;
    data[offset + 14] = q.width;
    data[offset + 15] = q.height;
    const u0 = q.u0,
      v0 = q.v0,
      ux = q.ux,
      vx = q.vx,
      uy = q.uy,
      vy = q.vy;
    data[offset + 16] = u0;
    data[offset + 17] = v0;
    data[offset + 20] = ux;
    data[offset + 21] = vx;
    data[offset + 22] = uy;
    data[offset + 23] = vy;
    const u1 = u0 + ux, v1 = v0 + vx;
    data[offset + 24] = Math.min(u0, u1, u0 + uy, u1 + uy);
    data[offset + 25] = Math.min(v0, v1, v0 + vy, v1 + vy);
    data[offset + 26] = Math.abs(ux) + Math.abs(uy);
    data[offset + 27] = Math.abs(vx) + Math.abs(vy);
  }
```

### 純數值等價探針（不是CPU／renderer基線）

- Bun1.4.4中以原與候選private method body建立兩個獨立numeric functions，65536組q、offset31、64-lane Float32Array先填123.5，對全部64個lanes做Object.is共4194304次，連未寫lanes也相等。這只驗證scalar與store行為，不使用fake GPU receiver當效能或native認證。
- 前512cases輪替0／-0／±MIN_VALUE／±MAX_VALUE／±Infinity／NaN／±1／±.5／1+EPSILON；後續固定seed17 LCG在廣泛exponents產生finite值。每個q的x／y／width／height／u0／v0／ux／vx／uy／vy都為numeric plainfields，符合privateownedrecord邊界。不是public getter／Proxy呼叫數契約的測試，不宣稱NaN payload bytes相等；數值以Object.is判準，未用JSON stringify抹平-0／NaN。
- 未將這個throwaway function加進正式程式／tests，沒有新增runtimeallocation。Native差異驗證如下另走真正Game／Scene／renderer。

### 初批工具干擾與一次固定 follow-on

- 初批先執行全部48個nativecoloredproof，再跑六cohortCPU矩陣。但在enclosing job尚未結束期間，我另以Bun執行一次原型Prettier.format（只存/tmp，不改正式source），完成mtime落在最後nativeproof與CPU結果之間。未記錄其精確開始時間或落在哪一個sample，不能將初批稱作無工具干擾。錯誤由量測協調造成，不隱藏、不丟原始資料，也不把差異全歸因於這次formatter。
- 原144samples／PNG hashes先保留，僅補跑一次相同固定matrix。沒有改任何cohort、warm、frames、ABBA／BAAB、sourcebytes、lifetime、seed、fixture負載或判準；只在sample外加matrixStartedAt／matrixCompletedAt metadata與分開輸出名稱。follow-on期間沒有其他CPUbenchmark／formatter／build／test／profiler，未再重跑找理想結果。
- 保留初批與follow-on各全部144samples、共288timings。這不是OS／其他程序完全隔離的保證；不將兩次不同run的絕對時鐘相減當改善，亦不合併兩批使干擾看不見。

### 兩批共同的真實 Game CPU 方法

- pinned Chromium153.0.8010.12 darwin/arm64 desktop-automation，visible page、forcedWebGL2、nativeImageBitmap4×4RGBA255與Texture。Game.create／Scene走正式publicroot，各側完整prefixmodule graph保留相對imports與classidentity；僅WebGL2 render2d slot替換為兩側同TS ES2022／ESM轉譯的source，其他actualminifieddistbytes相同，不混foreignEmitter／Scene。
- 每側canvas1280×720、viewport1280×1440、pixelRatio1、autoResizefalse、frameWorkBudgetMs1000/60，兩Game從不同時start，一側sample時另一側pause。四個主emitter各capacity8192（small128），rate0／life1e6／speed[0,0]／angle[-π,π]／acceleration[0,0]／start=end size[8,4]／color[.7,.2,.4,.8]，seed17+i、rectangle512×256、position[160+320i,360]／rotation.3／scale[1.3,.7]。
- cohorts固定mixed-large（前2local後2world）、local-large、world-large、local-small、layer-local-control、empty-Sprite-control，mixed先warm兩種Sprite shapes。各側32768 active主粒子（small512／empty0），empty仍保留32768pool；target用正式ParticleLayer2D。static主粒子避免跨realclock delta的pose差／overflow，仍執行完整simulation／bounds／submit。
- 各側另有capacity1／life.001／rate0 sentinel，自然過期證明Scene會自動推進。每fixture64warm+1probe後assert mainactive／sentinel0；不是直接updateSimulation假冒Game。每sample8warm+48measuredrealRAFframes，Scene.update只queue重用microtaskobserver，在同步render與frameWork finish後讀既有simulationMs／navigationMs／afterUpdateMs／renderSubmitMs、取µs/frame平均、pause。
- 每cohort六輪交替ABBA／BAAB、每輪兩before／兩after；每批36rows／144samples／6912sampledframes，warm／probe不計clock。before／after欄是六roundmean之median；pairedΔ是六個各輪aftermean/beforemean-1之median，不是兩獨立median之比。lower=faster，ties／outliers／order不剔除。
- renderSubmit是同步native-driver wall span，不等待GPUcompletion；categorySum只加simulation／navigation／afterUpdate／submit四段，不含未計測tail／observer，不是完整RAF、process CPUusage、GPUtimestamps或presentedfps，instrumentation負擔存在。
- 此target control在warm前會sourceDirty並用到packQuad，數值與pixelproof覆蓋；timedstaticloop的source未變，sourceDirty已清，不能將它的時間方向當成大量UVpacking收益。empty沒有active主粒子，Sprite local／world才每frame走batchpacking。

### 彩色 atlas／trim／source 真正三 backend Game proof

- 兩fixtures：普通Spritepool與targetParticleLayer2D；各在Canvas2D／WebGL2／WebGPU跑八modes，共48cases。只有WebGL2slot改動，另外兩backend是未改邏輯的功能控制，不假稱它們也得到packing收益。
- 每側native16×16ImageBitmap由逐pixel R=x×17／G=y×17／B=(x xor y)×17／A255產生，不是白色texture掩飾UV錯誤。Mode為local／world／local-custom／local-screen／local-transfer／local-rotated／local-trimmed／local-source。
- rotated使用TextureView2D frame(4,2,6,4)／rotation90；trimmed使用frame(2,4,6,4)／original(12,10)／trim(3,2,6,4)／resolution2；sourceRect為(-0,-0,7,5)。直接走已閱讀的正式TextureView2D constructor／validation，不手造rawquad或shaderreceiver；resource仍borrowed。
- 每case每側32liveparticles、12realGameframes，parent ShakenGroup矩陣override+2，deterministic移動／旋轉／nonuniformscale、root tint／opacity與camera position／zoom；custom在一個Sprite或targetlayer的原matrix呼叫後+3，transfer於第7frame前移root至新Scene。Scene只overridepublicupdatehook驅動fixture pose，不替換Game／Scene引擎。
- zero velocity／acceleration、constantstart=endappearance、life1e6消除不同clock造成的pose差。Sprite在render後讀raw既有worldMatrix，不多呼matrixhelper掩飾stale；target在render後讀slot／version／bounds並呼公開slotmatrixhelper，明示這個差異。
- 每Spritecase6552數字、targetcase10500，24case各一種共409248個Object.is exactnumbers，包含signedzero，JSONserialize前比較；每case12matchedsnapshots。實際同backend兩側nativePNGbytes一致且nonblank，不宣稱跨backendparity；所有Game／borrowedTexture／nativebitmapcleanup通過，pageerrors0。實際開啟WebGL2 rotatedSprite與trimmedLayer screenshots觀察彩色particle surface。

### 交付與未驗證邊界

- 只同步README中／英／日、PLAN、DESIGN、英中技術文件與本節；append前6862851bytes的歷史保留，不覆寫P262–P264的結果。正式source／dist與十一個使用者修改檔未被寫入，原型／proof／未執行builder在保留完整證據後刪除。
- 本輪沒有formal tests／strict／lint／build、actual direct-source-root或新minifiedslot驗證、Node／CJS CPU、newprofile／heap／GC／allocation／GPUtime／fps、gallery／showcase、audio unlock／cleanup、fullbrowserregression或實機／Safari認證。已閱讀Sprite quad／TextureView既有tests，但未冒稱本輪重跑。數值functionproof不等於CJS或nativeGPU私有method benchmark。
- 文件格式、relative-file links與historicalprefix作scoped檢查，只stage六份證據文件依功能提交，不push／升版；不為局部正面方向擴大API或新增狀態。

## P266：parent-link traversal 未採用，先揭露 world-affine group bounds 缺陷（2026-11-17）

### 本階段結論

- 延續小語持續優化／依功能提交授權。候選僅改private partitionBoundaries2D的loop形狀，不改culling／sorting／renderer／bounds／cache。沿用P264的collection／partition sampling方向，未重試P192 Array.fill或P265 UV案。
- **不採用此traversal，先以獨立功能處理已實測的正確性前提。CPU矩陣沒有開始，沒有效能數字或快／慢宣稱。** 原定八cohorts／192samples只是預備fixture，不記成執行；本階段source／dist從未修改。
- strict nativepreflight在Sprite Canvas2D、world-isolated的beforePNG就因blank失敗，shell以原exit1中止，後續兩GPUbackends、targetnativefixture及CPUjob均未執行。沒有把blank當pass、移除case或切換只測可過分支。
- 下一獨立功能先修Group2D world-owned child coverage；不把bounds改動塞入這個traversal evidence commit、不當作原型效能已過。持續目標不在此停止。

### 隔離候選與parent ownership契約

[Render-command collector](./packages/graphics/src/render2d-contract.ts) 原loop在起始object略過boundarytest、每個ancestor再判current!==object；候選把下一parent的boundarytest放在parentlink，只省掉這個identity判斷。GameObject.add既有acyclic parent ownership、initial instanceof/root exclusion、disabled Sprite／mesh skip、tint/visible/opacity短路、nearest isolation/root、Scene registrationorder、memberlist release及例外finally全保留；不快取public getters或新增state／allocation／API。不是通用可循環graph的改版。

```ts
for (let current: GameObject = object; ;) {
  // Read without `tint`, which would create the channels of every untinted object.
  const tint = current.existingTint;
  if (
    !current.visible ||
    current.opacity <= 0 ||
    (tint !== undefined && tint[3] <= 0)
  ) {
    visible = false;
    break;
  }
  const parent = current.parent;
  if (!parent) break;
  if (
    parent instanceof IsolatedGroup2D &&
    (parent === root || parent.isolationEnabled)
  ) {
    boundary = parent;
    break;
  }
  current = parent;
}
```

### 真正 collector 的 public observer／command-tree 對照

- 使用完整prefixgraph的實際publicroot與實際RenderCommandBuffer2D／collectRenderCommands2D，不fake Scene或buffer。nativeImageBitmap／Texture與GameObject／Sprite／IsolatedGroup2D的實際parent-tree；collectorprobe不是完整Game CPUbenchmark，沒有拿它的執行時鐘作收益。
- 六histories各12frames：flat、nested、explicitroot、detachedroot、visibilitygetter內reparent、parent/bounds exception；逐frame切換plainvisible、outeropacity／tintalpha、inner／outerisolate、skipCulling。記錄實際commandkind/objectlabel/screen/z/children、Scene會員順序、releasedstorage與完整公開existingTint／visible／opacity／parent／isolationEnabled／bounds trace。
- callbacks讀取順序以完整stringtrace逐項比對，所有numeric用Object.is；nativeborrowedTexture未被Scene／tree摧毀、顯式destroy關閉bitmap。每frame包含成功／失敗都檢查boundaryMembers.size0、retainedmemberlists.count0且沒有actorreferences；錯誤時commands.items必須清空，自己parent的add必須被既有cycleguard拒絕。
- 初版thrower位於isolation內，skipCulling在nestedcollection正確略過其Sprite.getWorldBounds，故只有三個parenterror；不能宣稱boundsfailure已驗。保留初版，另以獨立校正版把thrower改成Scene-root Sprite6，確實得到tick0/4/8的bounds RangeError與tick3/7/11的parent RangeError。這是fixture coverage修正，不改引擎、不縮小error契約。

### Strict native preflight 失敗，不是已通過的三backend矩陣

- 原指令先collectorproof，再Sprite／target × Canvas2D／WebGL2／WebGPU，最後才GameCPU。strictdynamicSprite在Canvas2D world-isolatedbefore PNG因`Blank native dynamic canvas`失敗；lastartifact確為before側。正式原型未套用，失敗前沒有source-game-results或CPU數字。
- 不重複不變的失敗check猜原因；另建diagnostic-sprite，保留strictfixture不動。diagnostic記錄每側nonuniform、featurePixelPass以及group／childbounds、matrices，允許收集失敗狀態但明確標false，不能當featuregate通過。
- native resources為彩色16×16ImageBitmap／Texture；32liveSprite、每側12realGameframes、life1e6／zero velocity與acceleration、constantappearance，Shakenparent矩陣+2及deterministic translation／rotation／nonuniformscale／tint／opacity／camera變動。沿用P265的rotated(4,2,6,4,90°)、trimmed(2,4,6,4; original12×10; trim3,2,6,4; resolution2)、source(-0,-0,7,5)、custom／screen／Scene transfer，新增local/world isolated與localnested。
- local/worldisolated以真正IsolatedGroup2D.isolate=true啟用，nested再多一個正式isolationchild；不是獨立shaderdemo或rawbounds特殊fallback。diagnostic仍assert before／candidate數字及PNGbytes一致，但兩側一起blank的case仍featurePixelPass=false。
- diagnostic的11個Canvas2Dmodes各6552個Object.is數字／12matchedsnapshots，共72072個數字；十個nonblank、一個world-isolated兩側blank。沒有Layer／WebGL2／WebGPU／direct-source-root／production認證。這是baseline診斷scope，不能用P265舊有三backend認證補足新增isolation。

### 根因：group local bounds 再次套用 world-owned child 的 transform

[Group2D.getLocalBounds](./packages/core/src/gameplay/group2d.ts) 對每個child取得localbounds後，無條件使用child.transform.updateMatrix；[WorldParticleSprite](./packages/core/src/particles2d/index.ts) 的position與四個出生axes則由其updateWorldMatrix獨立管理，並不等於當前ancestor乘以childlocaltransform。genericgroup把worldposition當local，又加emitter／root變換，所以coverage離開真正內容。一般worldmode仍畫得出，因non-drawingGroup不作一個獨立cullslot；isolation使用groupworldbounds與localtarget後才變成blank。

診斷在相同256×192視窗得到：

| Side   | Root world bounds x/y/w/h                                                  | Root intersects viewport | Visible child bounds | First actual child x/y/w/h                 | Isolation PNG nonblank |
| ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ | -------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ---------------------- |
| before | 138.86059378385227, 248.8360081648534, 43.1505836120694, 35.37395512188243 | false                    | 32                   | 112.2516098022461, 93.31188201904297, 8, 6 | false                  |
| after  | 138.86059378385227, 248.8360081648534, 43.1505836120694, 35.37395512188243 | false                    | 32                   | 112.2516098022461, 93.31188201904297, 8, 6 | false                  |

兩側root localbounds皆為x137.71160399091514／y196.1741708198333／w33.72675891398103／h26.128694021026604；rootmatrix=[1.0878984928131104,0.26622694730758667,0,-0.24721072614192963,1.0101914405822754,0,44,14,1]，emitterworldmatrix=[0.9310747385025024,0.6050253510475159,0,-0.6146023273468018,0.851650059223175,0,117.36689758300781,113.75467681884766,1]，firstworldparticlematrix=[.5,0,0,0,.375,0,116.2516098022461,96.31188201904297,1]。相同world非isolationmode也有錯的groupbounds，但實際particlePNGnonblank，進一步定位不是粒子source／lifetime／UV消失。

已實際開啟baseline world-isolated PNG觀察全空白。診斷的root/child-intersection欄是rawworldbounds對viewport的數值檢查；實際renderer仍用正式camera-adjustedculling，沒有在測試中關閉或替換。上述差異與正式PNG共同指出coverage根因，不以像素相等掩蓋blank。

## P267：修正 world-owned／custom child 的 group coverage（2026-11-17）

### 根因與採用範圍

承接 P266：Group2D 原先一律套 child.transform.updateMatrix，會把 world 粒子已保存的 world position／出生 axes 再施加目前 emitter／ancestor transform。非 drawing group 的錯誤 bounds 在 isolation 的 culling／target coverage 成為空白畫面。本階段獨立修正 bounds，沒有混入 traversal 候選。

普通 base-composed child 保留原 authored-local matrix／corner expression。world/custom override 或 active、非 static／sleeping body 的 physics presentation 改以 inverse(group world) × child world。child rectangle 在公開 matrix callback 前保存，防止同 group bounds scratch 重入；callback 完成後才寫入 lazy group-owned Matrix3。沒有跨 pass cache、particle class 特判、renderer 修改、停用 culling、依賴或新公開 API。world→local 需要可逆 group world matrix，既有 Matrix3.invert RangeError 不被吞掉；普通 local-only bounds 不要求 group matrix 可逆。

### 定向與建置證據

- 新增兩項 consumer-visible regression：world 粒子出生後移動／重新縮放 isolation ancestor，及自訂 child world pose 的 group coverage。最終 tests/particles2d.test.ts + tests/gameplay2d-core.test.ts：2 files／38 tests passed。不是完整 test suite。
- tsc -p tsconfig.check.json 及 scoped ESLint（三個變更 source/test 檔）成功。初次38測試成功後，strict 檢查發現 test cleanup 的 settings.texture 可為 undefined；改為 optional cleanup 後 strict／lint成功，最終38測試再通過。
- 隔離 HEAD build 覆蓋唯一 canonical source，執行 tsc／minify-dist／copy-vendor／build-cjs。全輸出比較只容許以下五檔，才帶回工作樹；Group2D declaration 只增加 private scratch 欄位。11個既有使用者檔案（narrowphase／world2d source及其dist）前後hash不變；未複製其他輸出，未整體重建工作樹 dist。

### 真實 Game／原生畫面

固定 Chromium 153.0.8010.12，darwin/arm64，desktop-automation，pinned Playwright managed；不代表 Safari、physical device 或其他 browser 認證。三個入口：一致 dist-prefix graph 中只替換 Group2D 的 source-slot、真正 /src/index.ts dev、minified production。各 Canvas2D／WebGL2／WebGPU，11 modes × 9 entry/backend 組合 = 99 cases。每側實際 Game 12個自動 RAF frames，256×192，pixelRatio1；32個真實 Sprite-pool 粒子、彩色16×16原生 ImageBitmap、公開 TextureView rotation／trim／source、動態 parent/camera/tint，另有 custom matrix、screen、Scene transfer、local/nested isolation。不是裸 Sprite draw 或替代 render loop。

每 case 6,552個 Object.is 數字（含 signed zero），合計648,648個；矩陣採 rendering 後的公開 updateWorldMatrix 查詢，並非 raw renderer matrix-cache equality，不與 P266 raw-snapshot certification 混稱。九組 world-isolated 的預期契約明確是 before blank／after nonblank 且 PNG不同；不要求修正前錯誤像素繼續一致，其餘90組必須兩側 nonblank 且 PNG相同。每組 after group bounds 均含32個實際 child world bounds（1e-3 邊界容差），借用 Texture 在 Game.destroy 後仍存活、顯式 destroy 關閉 ImageBitmap、所有 Game 到 destroyed，page/runtime errors 為0。

### 正式 CJS 與重入 edge

實際 dist/cjs/src/index.cjs 入口，以 deterministic Node Texture image record（不是原生 ImageBitmap，原生證據如上）查驗16個 scalar、同 group bounds callback 重入一次、4個借用 texture cleanup。第二個 child 的 rectangle 不同，會覆寫 group scratch，可驗第一 child snapshot 未被 callback 破壞；另保留普通零 scale local bounds。

```json
{
  "entry": "actual dist/cjs/src/index.cjs",
  "worldLocal": [-22, 19, 4, 6],
  "worldCoverage": [112, -10, 16, 12],
  "reentrantUnion": [4, -4, 102, 8],
  "ordinarySingularLocal": [-2, -2, 4, 4],
  "checkedScalarValues": 16,
  "reentries": 1,
  "closed": 4,
  "realNativeImageBitmap": false
}
```

首次 CJS throwaway fixture 漏了必填 startColor／endColor，constructor 正確拒絕；只補齊 fixture，未修改引擎 validation，以上為修正後結果。前置腳本另曾把 fs/promises 當 fs 同步 API 使用，在任何 build／runtime proof 前失敗，改用同步 fs namespace；不計成功證據。

### 交付與限制

同步 README 中英日、PLAN、DESIGN、兩份技術文件及本紀錄；歷史前綴原樣保留。只提交本功能三個 source/test、五個 Group2D 產物、六份文件，不含11個使用者變更。沒有 CPU timing、fps、GPU呈現時間、heap／GC、完整suite、gallery、音訊或新增 physics interpolation scenario 認證；不可把修正前剔除掉內容的便宜成本當成速度基線。traversal 性能候選仍需另一期完整評估。無 push／升版。

## P268：修正 baseline 後不採用 parent-link traversal（2026-11-17）

### 原型與採用決定

承接 P266 的 parent-link候選，以 P267 已修正的 world-affine group bounds 為真正基線。本階段沒有將 P266 的空白畫面當成功，也沒有混入新的 bounds／renderer 修改。只把 boundary 檢查從 current iteration 起點移到 parent link，消除 current!==object 分支，保持 visible／opacity／tint短路、parent getter次序、nearest isolation／explicit root、Scene registration、排序與清理。沒有cache／state／API變更；只存在於 throwaway module。

不採用。固定 source-slot 矩陣中 world／nested 的category sum下降，但一般local沒有穩定合計收益，小量local與offscreen submit多數退步，不能只選較漂亮的分項。尤其 empty simulation等沒有直接修改的control分項，也有大幅一致方向差異；這是觀測而非已確認根因，不將其當成traversal因果效果。兩側完整且分離的module graph能維持各side class ownership，卻沒有排除不同graph／實例／JIT狀態的所有差異。後續應改善隔離，不以同條件重跑尋找好看方向；正式source／dist完全不變。

### 固定八cohort source-slot Game CPU矩陣

實際Game正式simulation／after-update／renderer pipeline，WebGL2，兩側各一個可見1280×720 canvas、viewport1280×1440、pixelRatio1、autoResize=false、frameWorkBudgetMs=1000/60。每側四emitter，各capacity8192（large active總32768），small各128（總512），empty active0但仍有pool，offscreen保持32768 active。target layer control不冒充Sprite pool；深層local增加四個identity Group2D ancestors；offscreen位置在視窗外，因此empty/offscreen的blank是預先指定的control，不是放寬world-isolated gate。

各cohort每側先64 warm＋一個probe，會自然到期的sentinel證明由真正Scene自動推進；每sample再8 warm＋48記錄frames，六輪交替ABBA／BAAB，每輪兩before＋兩after，八cohort共192samples／9,216量測frames。只暫停另一Game，讀取既有frameWork四個具名wall-clock span，沒有修改計時點或自己呼叫emitter simulation。categorySum是這四段相加，不是完整RAF CPU、GPU時間或fps。matrixStartedAt=1794914683581，matrixCompletedAt=1794914882110，elapsed=198529ms。所有fixture及候選都在量測前格式化，期間未跑formatter／tests／build／profile，亦無其他自啟動工作；這一期只有這一批固定timing，無挑sample／outlier／tie或補跑尋方向。

統計先將每輪兩個同side取mean，再取六個paired百分比的median，不是兩個median的ratio。百分比分母為0時明列n/a，不以Infinity／NaN表示改善、不丟掉該輪；absolute paired delta與三方向計數仍包含全部六輪。以下每個分項與cohort全部保留：

### 失敗與限制、交付

分析時首次傳給歷史summary helper的span名稱是total／renderSubmit，不存在於raw sample，輸出NaN；沒有使用該表、沒有重跑runtime，改用實際欄位categorySumUs／submitUs。navigation原始0分母也在本紀錄明確使用n/a。這些是分析表處理，不把無效表列為通過證據。

沒有正式source／dist改動、沒有新permanent test、未執行formal typecheck／lint／build／fullsuite、production／CJS CPU或gallery／音訊／physical browser認證。66個native cases只是本隔離source-slot候選的記錄範圍；CPU數字不代表全瀏覽器、GPU、heap／GC或presented fps，control差異不臆測原因。只提交README中英日、PLAN、DESIGN、兩份技術文件與本證據，保留全部歷史前綴；刪除本期throwaway scripts，不推送、不升版。

## P269：同 Game／同 buffer 的 A/A＋A/B calibration（2026-11-17）

### 範圍與決定

承接 P268 的control不確定性，改在同一份collector module中保留原partitionBoundaries2D與候選partitionAfter269，其他collector／RenderCommandBuffer2D實作只有一份。兩函式依然只差 P266／P268 的parent-link loop。以暫存function binding取代collect入口的固定private call，sample開始前設定選擇，沒有新增per-frame計數器、per-actorcallback或正式API；core classes全部由canonical /dist graph載入。這只是throwaway source-slot fixture，不改正式source／dist。

每timed cohort只有一個真正Game／Scene／renderer／canvas／command buffer／particle pool，在所有samples間重用，沒有以兩套core graph或不同Game實例作A/B。可變binding的唯一call仍位於原partition呼叫點；selector與觀察選擇的getter在sample warm前／最後frame span取完後呼叫，沒有加入量測span內。sample回報實際selected partition而非只依label推定。

```typescript
// In the throwaway common module only; the real collector body and buffer are shared.
let selectedPartition269 = partitionBoundaries2D;
export function setPartitionVariant269(variant: 'before' | 'after'): void {
  selectedPartition269 =
    variant === 'after' ? partitionAfter269 : partitionBoundaries2D;
}
// collectRenderCommands2D calls selectedPartition269 at its existing private call site.
```

不採用traversal。A/B大型mixed／local／world／nested的paired方向不穩定，原有world／nested的大幅下降沒有重現，沒有可依賴的速度收益。A/A也仍有噪聲；不扣除A/A median、不挑sample、不依這次絕對時間比較前期。舊方向消失不證明其唯一原因是module graph：canvas／實例數、可變callsite、warmup也同時不同。可變target會影響inlining／tiering，時間序列與不同函式warmup也未完全隔離，不能當成正式production直接binding的速度證明。後續轉查其他熱路徑，不再重跑相同traversal尋找好看結果。

### Shared-graph 正確性

Sprite／target各11 modes × Canvas2D／WebGL2／WebGPU，共66個真實Game cases、562,716個Object.is數字（含signed zero）、所有before/after nonblank且PNG相同。原生彩色16×16 ImageBitmap、32粒子、256×192、pixelRatio1、每側12個自動Game RAF frames；動態ancestor／camera／opacity／tint、custom matrix、screen、Scene transfer、TextureView rotation／trim／source、local/world/nested isolation均走真正Game架構。這組correctness driver仍有兩個Game，兩者共享同一api namespace與core classes，在各自frame開始前切換private partition；與CPU的一個Game／buffer重用範圍明確區分。Sprite採raw post-render matrix，target另有公開slot matrix查詢。借用Texture在Game.destroy後仍存活，顯式destroy關閉bitmap，所有Game到destroyed，page/runtime errors=0。

Collector六組各12-frame histories的完整report與 P268／P266 corrected逐byte JSON相同，含624數字、12,056 observations、10,028 getter entries、六次bounds／parent RangeError cleanup、cycle拒絕與native bitmap cleanup。完整歷史trace見 P266 corrected；SHA256(JSON.stringify(report))=2fad17a2f881be4eec0a2aa05408dfa781c587fcd59134f8be02b44e8387dd33。

### 固定 A/A 與 A/B 方法

相同八cohort與 P268 的config（large／nested／offscreen active32768、small512、target control32768、empty0但仍有pool），WebGL2，單canvas1280×720、viewport1280×720、pixelRatio1、autoResize=false、frameWorkBudgetMs=1000/60。四emitter各capacity8192（small128），native4×4白Texture，life1e6、rate0、speed／acceleration0、固定size／color、seed17+i、rectangle512×256、rotation.3、scale1.3/.7。深層加四個identity Group2D；offscreen仍active但在視窗外，只有事先指定的empty/offscreen允許blank。

每cohort先以原函式跑64 warm＋1 probe，sentinel自然到期證明真正Scene自動推進；再對兩個sample labels各跑8 warm＋1真正render probe，暫停後立即截該次畫面，確認before/after選擇的nonblank／blank契約與SHA相同。A/A兩label都確實選原函式，A/B才是兩個不同函式；不是在所有timing結束後連拍同一畫面冒充對照。這些probe不列timing samples。原函式與候選在進入timing前的warmup次數並非完全對稱，故不宣稱穩態JIT已被證明。

每sample8 warm＋48記錄frames，六輪ABBA／BAAB交替，每輪各兩個before／after-label；A/A八cohort192 samples，接著A/B同八cohort192 samples，合計384samples／18,432量測frames。每個mode重新啟動browser，但mode內每cohort始終同一Game、Scene、renderer、pool與buffer。所有scripts在CPU開始前格式化；兩批完整job期間未執行其他formatter／tests／build／profile或自啟工作，未重跑挑方向。

既有frameWork四個wall-clock spans取樣，categorySum只相加四段，不是完整RAF CPU、GPU、fps或heap。每輪兩個同label mean再算paired delta，報六輪median／range／全部快慢平手；不是median ratio。零分母percent明列n/a，仍保留所有absolute delta與counts。A/A只作同方法校準，不作扣除或數值補正。

### 準備失敗、metadata／警告與限制

- 準備CPU fixture的guarded文字替換最初假設兩個換行，實際模板只有一個，因此在寫檔／CPU前停止；讀取實際boundary後只修正該步，再通過node --check。沒有重做已成功步驟、沒有在CPU中修改script。
- 文件format:check最初因新增TypeScript fence採用Prettier預設double quotes而失敗，倉庫設定是singleQuote=true。只用實際repo options重排本期suffix，保留完整歷史prefix；沒有重寫歷史或修改runtime。
- native correctness report的entryAfter仍沿用未使用的舊prefix /p269-after/dist/src/index.js；真正script已改為import('/dist/src/index.js')並assert同api namespace。afterEntry舊參數沒有被使用，不把這個header當成實際入口證據，不悄悄重寫原JSON。這一期證明的是shared canonical dist graph＋一個source-slot common module，並非完整dev root或獨立after graph。
- canonical dist import使Vite顯示既有opm-adapter動態import無法靜態分析的warning，兩次都在module載入／matrix開始前；原警告保留。沒有修改vendor／validation或抑制warning，這輪未測音訊unlock或Audio runtime。runtime/page errors仍為0。
- 沒有正式code／dist變更、沒有新增permanent tests，未跑formal build／typecheck／lint／fullsuite、production／CJS CPU、gallery、GPU／heap／GC或其他browser認證。不能由source branch減少或這些帶可變callsite的數字宣稱正式速度提升。

## P270 — observer guard 否決與 Proxy lifecycle regression（2026-11-17）

### 結論與正式交付

- 不採用兩個 observer 原型；正式 SceneObject／event-observers／Scene、dist、公開入口、vendor、package 版本 1.23.0 均不變。此輪只新增消費端 Proxy late-postupdate regression test 並同步六份文件；沒有 push。
- 原型一直接用既有 target-keyed WeakMap 查 update observer：普通事件與三 backend 畫面 gate 曾通過，但合法 EventTarget-bound Proxy façade 的 postupdate 在原版為 11 次、候選為 0 次，立即否決，沒有為它量測 CPU。不能把普通 fixture 通過當完整語義證明。
- 原型二保留 receiver 私有 Set，只加全域「該類型從未被觀察」的負向 guard，沿用既有單調 Set，沒有新增 object 欄位、per-frame 配置、依賴或公開 API。它通過 revised lifecycle／三 backend gate，固定 A/A＋A/B 卻顯示常見負載 simulation 代價，因此仍不加入 runtime。
- 新測試位於 [scene-lazy.test.ts](tests/scene-lazy.test.ts)：先推進無 listener 的 façade，再由 façade 綁定的 addEventListener 加入 listener，推進、remove/re-add 後驗證真實 postupdate dt 及原生 event target/currentTarget。正式原版單檔 7 tests 通過，該檔 ESLint 與格式通過。額外獨立 Vitest process 用真實原型一 delegate 替換觀察方法，只有新測試失敗（空陣列對預期兩次 dt），其餘 6 tests 通過；throwaway probe 已刪除，不隨 commit 交付。不是文字／wiring 測試。

### 正式 Game qualitative profile：沒有確定先前空 pool 根因

未 override source 的 canonical /dist/src/index.js、實際 Game／Scene／WebGL2、原生 4×4 ImageBitmap、visible 分頁；四個 cohort 各 90 warm＋180 CDP profiled frames，100µs requested sampling interval。Sprite pool 為四組各8192，empty pool 仍已註冊／初始化32772物件且無 post observer；layer control 只有8個已初始化物件。完整 setup、top-30 sampled self-time、最後單幀 counter、資源 cleanup 與 raw-profile SHA256 保留如下。最後 frameWork 只是最後一幀，不能當分布；CDP self time 是整段採樣，不是每幀 latency。

empty 的 advanceObjects sampled self time 僅18179µs／180幀；這次 profile 沒有重現先前多毫秒 simulation，不能宣稱找到根因、已修復或直接把其他 fixture 的 timing 代入。active local/world 的 collector、matrix、draw 等仍有採樣成本。

[INFERENCE] receiver／callsite／JIT 與 instrumentation 執行歷史可能影響差異，但此輪沒有證明任何單一機制，更沒有證實 megamorphic cause。後續原型只以消費端行為與當輪配對結果判斷，不靠這項假說宣稱收益。

### 第一候選的實際失敗

只把 observesUpdate 改為 hasObjectEventObservers(this,type)，WeakMap 的 key 是 listener 註冊時的實際 target，而 Scene 可以用 proxy identity 呼叫觀察方法。Proxy 只綁定 addEventListener/removeEventListener/dispatchEvent，其餘屬性 Reflect.get 轉送；原版已有的 postupdate 不可在優化後消失。失敗時 browser/server 的 finally cleanup 執行，但 assertion 後面的 Game/Texture 明示 cleanup 未走到，不能冒稱該失敗路徑已逐資源驗證。

### 修正版原型與 native gates

新增的 helper 僅回傳既有 observedEventTypes.has(type)；原 reader 的同一條件也委派它。SceneObject.observesUpdate 保留原 receiver 私有 Set 的 .has 與虛擬呼叫，不改 Scene 迭代／初始化順序；remove／once／abort 後的曾觀察狀態仍保守、不縮減。下列是未採用的原型正式檔文字，不是目前 runtime：

```typescript
const objectEventObservers = new WeakMap<object, Set<string>>();
/** Every type any object has observed; a superset of each per-object Set, never shrinking. */
const observedEventTypes = new Set<string>();

/** @internal Share the existing listener Set without expanding scene facade declarations. */
export function observeObjectEventTypes(
  object: object,
  types: Set<string>,
): void {
  objectEventObservers.set(object, types);
}

/** @internal Record each type added to a shared Set; unobserved types skip the object lookup. */
export function observeEventType(type: string): void {
  observedEventTypes.add(type);
}

/** @internal Negative guard only; receiver-owned Sets also support proxied facades. */
export function hasObservedEventType(type: string): boolean {
  return observedEventTypes.has(type);
}

/** @internal Observation stays conservative after remove, once, and signal abort. */
export function hasObjectEventObservers(object: object, type: string): boolean {
  return (
    hasObservedEventType(type) &&
    (objectEventObservers.get(object)?.has(type) ?? false)
  );
}
```

```typescript
import type { Scene } from './scene.js';
import {
  hasObservedEventType,
  observeEventType,
  observeObjectEventTypes,
} from './event-observers.js';

/** Base facade for scene-owned objects, independent of 2D or 3D transforms. */
export abstract class SceneObject extends EventTarget {
  private owningScene: Scene | undefined;
  private disposed = false;
  private observedEventTypes: Set<string> | undefined;
  private ownershipGeneration = 0;
  /** @internal Invalidates callback continuations on remove/re-add within the same Scene. */
  get registrationGeneration(): number {
    return this.ownershipGeneration;
  }

  override addEventListener(
    type: string,
    callback: EventListenerOrEventListenerObject | null,
    options?: boolean | AddEventListenerOptions,
  ): void {
    super.addEventListener(type, callback, options);
    if (callback && !(typeof options === 'object' && options.signal?.aborted)) {
      if (!this.observedEventTypes)
        observeObjectEventTypes(this, (this.observedEventTypes = new Set()));
      this.observedEventTypes.add(type);
      observeEventType(type);
      if (type === 'preupdate') this.owningScene?.trackObjectPasses(this);
    }
  }

  /** @internal Untouched pooled sprites need no lifecycle Event allocations. */
  dispatchObjectEvent(type: string, detail?: unknown): void {
    if (this.observedEventTypes?.has(type))
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(type, { detail }));
  }
  /** @internal Whether `emitUpdate(type)` would dispatch. */
  observesUpdate(type: 'preupdate' | 'postupdate'): boolean {
    return (
      hasObservedEventType(type) && this.observedEventTypes?.has(type) === true
    );
  }
  /** @internal Update payloads are allocated only for objects observing lifecycle events. */
  emitUpdate(type: 'preupdate' | 'postupdate', dt: number): void {
    if (this.observedEventTypes?.has(type))
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(type, { detail: { dt } }));
  }

  get scene(): Scene | undefined {
    return this.owningScene;
  }

  get destroyed(): boolean {
    return this.disposed;
  }

  /** @internal Called only by Scene during registration. */
  attach(scene: Scene): void {
    if (this.disposed) throw new Error('Cannot add a destroyed scene object.');
    if (this.owningScene)
      throw new Error('Scene object already belongs to a scene.');
    this.owningScene = scene;
    this.ownershipGeneration++;
  }

  /** @internal Called only by Scene during removal. */
  detach(scene: Scene): void {
    if (this.owningScene === scene) {
      this.owningScene = undefined;
      this.ownershipGeneration++;
    }
  }

  destroy(): void {
    if (this.disposed) return;
    this.disposed = true;
    this.owningScene?.remove(this);
    try {
      this.onDestroy();
    } finally {
      this.dispatchObjectEvent('destroy');
    }
  }

  protected onDestroy(): void {}
}
```

初始 WeakMap 與 revised guard 的兩批 native proof 分開保留，不能互相冒充。每批皆為 Sprite／ParticleLayer、WebGPU／WebGL2／Canvas2D、十一模式，共66 cases、562716個 Object.is 數字與完全相同的非空白 PNG。模式包括 local/world/custom/screen/Scene transfer/rotated/trimmed/source/local-isolated/world-isolated/local-nested；每側每case12個 automatic Game snapshots，Sprite 矩陣在 render 後收集，layer 經公開 slot 查詢。ImageBitmap 由 Game 借用，Game.destroy 不應銷毀外借 Texture，顯式 Texture.destroy 關閉 bitmap；成功路徑逐一驗證、errors為空。這只覆蓋該 pinned Chromium automation，不是三種瀏覽器或實體裝置認證。

### 固定 A/A＋A/B CPU 方法與控制

修正版 native gates 完成後才開始 CPU。A/A 288 samples 完成後，獨立新 browser 的 A/B 288 samples；每模式十二個預先固定 cohort，各六輪 alternating ABBA/BAAB、每 sample 8 warm＋48 measured frames，共576 averaged samples／27648 measured frames。所有值、ties、outliers及原始 selector 均保留，沒有重跑挑方向、剔值或用 A/A median 扣除 A/B。兩模式 elapsed 分別287812ms、287724ms；期間沒有啟動 formatter、build、test 或其他 profiler。

一個 canonical core graph，只 override SceneObject 與 event-observers 的原型模組，沒有公開控制 API。每 cohort 同一個真實 Game／Scene／renderer／canvas／command buffer／particle pool；只在 sample warm 前切換 prototype method，且記錄實際 function identity。A/A 的兩個 label 都是 before（288次），A/B before/after 各144次。65幀初始 setup 明示選回 before；兩種選擇各自先跑8 warm＋1 probe 再真正 render/截圖。不是在最後狀態截兩次。

1280×720、pixelRatio1、autoResize false、visible、原生白4×4 ImageBitmap、WebGL2、四 emitter各8192（small各128；empty保持容量但0活粒子）、rate0、life1000000、speed/acceleration0、固定非均勻縮放與旋轉；sentinel 粒子依真實 Game dt 自然到期，確認不是只手動呼叫 renderer。沿用既有 frameWork 四個 span；Scene.update 只以 microtask 在 onFrame 結束後讀當幀 counter，沒有改寫 clock/counter。category sum 是四個 JS span 相加，不是完整 frame time、CPU-only instruction time、GPU elapsed 或 presented FPS。

十二個 cohort 在量測前固定：mixed/local/world large、local nested(depth4)、small、layer、empty、offscreen、512個真實 post listener、post type曾觀察後的 empty、混合／巢狀／多 actor shape且512 pre＋512 post listener 的 lifecycle-history、兩種類型都曾觀察後的 empty。global observed Set 在單一 mode 內不清空，所以最後兩個 empty 不享有「從未觀察」前提。history control 先為獨立 actor 註冊、移除 pre/post 後 destroy，再放入真實多種 actor；沒有假 callback。listeners 驗證 dt 有效，每 sample 精確檢查 (warm+measured)×listenerCount，既不吞事件也不把 callback allocations 從 timing 移走。每模式 sample 的 warm＋measured callback 合計 post1376256、pre688128（不包含 setup/probe）。

所有 cohort 的兩種選擇 PNG相同；empty與offscreen預期為空白，其他非空白；每 cohort Game destroyed、外借 Texture 顯式destroy並關閉bitmap。逐 sample zero errors。模式／初始selector／listener數／image proof：

### 採用判斷與限制

- mixed/local simulation 分別增加9.508%／9.785%，均六輪變慢；post-listener control增加5.952%、mixed lifecycle history增加8.463%，也各六輪變慢。category sum 中 mixed/local/nested 沒有穩定總收益；layer control多數總成本增加。
- cold-type empty 的 category-sum median下降7.159%，但已觀察post類型的 empty反而增加7.627%；兩類型history empty方向3/3。A/A本身兩個history empty已有明顯漂移、也有large outlier，不能用局部下降抵銷實際常見負載的simulation成本或宣稱穩定空pool修復。
- 原型以可變 prototype method 控制選擇，可能影響 inlining／deoptimization／callsite；before有65幀初始warm，而兩種probe各9幀，不能視為完全對稱的JIT訓練或獨立靜態production bundle認證。原型二的全域Set查詢增加工作，但這批資料不單獨證明每一差異只由該查詢造成。
- 因不採用，沒有 promotion／build／CJS adoption proof、全套typecheck/test/lint、production CPU benchmark、audio unlock/cleanup、Safari或實體裝置認證。不得把原型native等價或正式7個單檔測試說成全套驗收。沒有聲稱allocation、GPU或FPS改善。

### P269 初始 warm-up selector 的更正（保留歷史原文）

P269的初始 fixture.sample(1,64) 是直接呼叫，不經 sampleGame269 的 selector。當時文字聲稱每cohort這段warm都是original，過於強烈：A/A始終original，但A/B後續cohort可沿用上一cohort最後的candidate。正式timed samples仍逐sample先選擇、再warm，且192個實際selection有紀錄；不改寫或重新跑原始384個值。P270已在每個setup warm前明示選回before，並記錄initialObserverVariant；仍公開上述warm／prototype控制限制，不能藉此追認P269穩定JIT或單因果證明。

### 準備失敗與工具界線

- 最初 lifecycle script template 把 errors.join 的 newline 變成字面換行，Prettier在執行前拒絕解析；僅修正script尾端使用String.fromCharCode(10)，沒有改引擎。
- route refresh 曾只接受 const server=，driver格式化後是const server =；guarded失敗後改成允許空白的boundary，沒有假裝前一步的fixture setup沒有發生，也沒有重跑成功階段。
- 原型一 Proxy assertion 的bash結果未帶出log，已另讀實際失敗log並回報工具QA；沒有以空輸出宣稱通過。
- 文件分析 helper 曾使用不存在的cohorts欄位，拋TypeError；確認實際cohortProof schema後只重做分析，沒有重跑CPU或改數字。
- 新測試的固定三個native method table採Record而非Map；throwaway efficacy probe改用static import，因測試是在module收集完成後才執行，不需要dynamic import。
- Vite原有OPM dynamic-import analysis warning仍完整輸出，未改vendor、音訊adapter、validation或加入ignore以壓制它。此warning不是本輪新增的音訊測試結果。

### 重現用隔離 fixture（非正式引擎API）

下列保留當時root／port與pinned runtime；需在該repo既有dist與Playwright環境執行，不是可攜式公開benchmark套件。driver的原型模組路由只存在於throwaway Vite middleware。原型一另將觀察方法委派hasObjectEventObservers；之後使用以下修正版模組。所有CPU矩陣在source gates完成後單獨執行，不能和formatter或profiler重疊。

    const before = await page.evaluate(() => {
      if (globalThis.runtimeError270) throw Error(globalThis.runtimeError270);
      const f = globalThis.fixture270;
      globalThis.state270 = {
        registered: f.scene.objects.size,
        initialized: [...f.scene.objects].filter(
          (o) => o.eventsInitialized === true,
        ).length,
        uninitialized: [...f.scene.objects].filter(
          (o) => o.eventsInitialized === false,
        ).length,
        postObservers: [...f.scene.objects].filter(
          (o) =>
            typeof o.observesUpdate === 'function' &&
            o.observesUpdate('postupdate'),
        ).length,
      };
      return f.scene.frames;
    });
    await cdp.send('Profiler.start');
    await page.waitForFunction(
      (target) =>
        globalThis.runtimeError270 ||
        globalThis.fixture270.scene.frames >= target,
      before + 180,
      { timeout: 60000 },
    );
    const measurement = await page.evaluate(() => {
      if (globalThis.runtimeError270) throw Error(globalThis.runtimeError270);
      const f = globalThis.fixture270;
      f.game.pause();
      return {
        completedFrames: f.scene.frames,
        lastCompleteFrameWorkMs: {
          simulation: f.game.frameWork.simulationMs,
          navigation: f.game.frameWork.navigationMs,
          afterUpdate: f.game.frameWork.afterUpdateMs,
          renderSubmit: f.game.frameWork.renderSubmitMs,
        },
        activeParticles: f.emitters.map((e) => e.activeCount),
        visibility: document.visibilityState,
      };
    });
    const { profile } = await cdp.send('Profiler.stop');
    fs.writeFileSync(
      '/tmp/xyz-p270/' + mode + '.cpuprofile',
      JSON.stringify(profile),
    );
    const nodes = new Map(profile.nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n])),
      self = new Map();
    for (let i = 0; i < profile.samples.length; i++) {
      const frame = nodes.get(profile.samples[i]).callFrame,
        key =
          (frame.functionName || '(anonymous)') +
          ' ' +
          frame.url +
          ':' +
          (frame.lineNumber + 1);
      self.set(key, (self.get(key) ?? 0) + profile.timeDeltas[i]);
    }
    await page.screenshot({ path: '/tmp/xyz-p270/' + mode + '.png' });
    const cleanup = await page.evaluate(() => {
      const f = globalThis.fixture270;
      f.game.destroy();
      if (f.texture.destroyed) throw Error('Game destroyed borrowed texture');
      f.texture.destroy();
      return {
        gameDestroyed: f.game.state,
        textureDestroyed: f.texture.destroyed,
        nativeBitmapClosed: f.bitmap.width === 0,
      };
    });
    if (!cleanup.nativeBitmapClosed)
      throw Error('Native bitmap cleanup failed');
    reports.push({
      setup,
      warmFrames: before,
      profiledFrames: measurement.completedFrames - before,
      objectState: await page.evaluate(() => globalThis.state270),
      ...measurement,
      topSelfMicroseconds: [...self].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 30),
      cleanup,
    });
  }
  const report = {
    browser: browserIdentity('chromium', browser, launch),
    reports,
    errors,
  };
  fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/xyz-p270/profiles.json', JSON.stringify(report));
  console.log(JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
  if (errors.length) throw Error(errors.join('\n'));
} finally {
  await browser?.close();
  await server.close();
}

          ordinary: 0,
          once: 0,
          aborted: 0,
          abortAfter: 0,
          removed: 0,
          late: 0,
          initialized: 0,
          override: 0,
          hook: 0,
          victim: 0,
          proxied: 0,
        };
      let game,
        tick = 0,
        currentDelta = 0,
        preDelta,
        complete,
        runtimeError,
        late;
      root.add(new api.Sprite({ texture, position: [20, 20] }));
      const make = (id) => {
        const node = root.add(new api.GameObject());
        return node;
      };
      const post = (id, node) => (event) => {
        if (
          event.target !== node ||
          event.currentTarget !== node ||
          !Object.is(event.detail.dt, currentDelta) ||
          !Number.isFinite(event.detail.dt) ||
          event.detail.dt < 0

          throw Error('Bad postupdate payload/target ' + id);
        counts[id]++;
        log.push(['post', id, tick]);
      };
      const pre = make('pre');
      pre.addEventListener('preupdate', (event) => {
        if (!Number.isFinite(event.detail.dt) || event.detail.dt < 0)
          throw Error('Bad preupdate delta');
        preDelta = event.detail.dt;
        counts.pre++;
        log.push(['pre', tick]);
      });
      const ordinary = make('ordinary');
      ordinary.addEventListener('postupdate', post('ordinary', ordinary));
      const once = make('once');
      once.addEventListener('postupdate', post('once', once), { once: true });
      const aborted = make('aborted'),
        abortedSignal = new AbortController();
      abortedSignal.abort();
      aborted.addEventListener('postupdate', post('aborted', aborted), {
        signal: abortedSignal.signal,
      });
      const abortAfter = make('abortAfter'),
        abortSignal = new AbortController();
      abortAfter.addEventListener(
        'postupdate',
        post('abortAfter', abortAfter),
        { signal: abortSignal.signal },
      );
      const removed = make('removed'),
        removedCallback = post('removed', removed);
      removed.addEventListener('postupdate', removedCallback);
      const initialized = make('initialized');
      initialized.addEventListener('initialize', () => {
        log.push(['initialize', tick]);
        initialized.addEventListener(
          'postupdate',
          post('initialized', initialized),
        );
      });
      const override = make('override');
      override.addEventListener('postupdate', post('override', override));
      override.observesUpdate = (type) => {
        log.push(['observer-override', type, tick]);
        return false;
      };
      const hook = make('hook');
      hook.update = () => {
        counts.hook++;
        log.push(['hook', tick]);
        if (tick === 4) late.addEventListener('postupdate', post('late', late));
        if (tick === 5) victim.destroy();
      };
      late = make('late');
      const victim = make('victim');
      victim.addEventListener('postupdate', post('victim', victim));
      victim.addEventListener('destroy', () =>
        log.push(['destroy-victim', tick]),
      );
      const proxyTarget = new api.GameObject(),
        boundNative = new Map();
      const proxied = new Proxy(proxyTarget, {
        get(target, key, receiver) {
          if (
            key === 'addEventListener' ||
            key === 'removeEventListener' ||
            key === 'dispatchEvent'

            if (!boundNative.has(key))

                key,
                Reflect.get(target, key, target).bind(target),

            return boundNative.get(key);
          }
          return Reflect.get(target, key, receiver);
        },
      });
      root.add(proxied);
      proxied.addEventListener('postupdate', post('proxied', proxyTarget));
      const finish = () => {
        game.pause();
        const c = complete;
        complete = undefined;
        runtimeError ? c.reject(Error(runtimeError)) : c.resolve();
      };
      class EventScene extends api.Scene {
        update(delta) {
          tick++;
          currentDelta = delta;
          if (!Object.is(preDelta, delta))
            throw Error(
              'Preupdate delta does not match the same actual Game tick',
            );
          if (tick === 3)
            removed.removeEventListener('postupdate', removedCallback);
          if (tick === 5) abortSignal.abort();
          if (tick === 7) {
            this.remove(root);
            this.add(root);
          }
          if (tick === 8) hook.update = api.GameObject.prototype.update;
          queueMicrotask(finish);
        }
      }
      const scene = new EventScene();
      scene.add(root);
      game = await api.Game.create({
        canvas,
        renderer: 'webgl2',
        width: 64,
        height: 64,
