```javascript
              return scene;
            },
            rootGroup,
            emitter,
            texture,
            bitmap,
            frame,
            snapshot,
            transfer: async () => {
              scene.remove(rootGroup);
              const next = new PosedScene();
              next.add(rootGroup);
              await game.setScene(next);
              scene = next;
            },
          });
        }
        return {
          mode,
          backend,
          visible: document.visibilityState,
          nativeBitmaps: fixtures.every((f) => f.bitmap instanceof ImageBitmap),
        };
      };

        const snapshots = { before: [], after: [] };
        for (const f of fixtures)
          for (let frame = 0; frame < 12; frame++) {
            if (mode === 'local-transfer' && frame === 6) await f.transfer();
            await f.frame();
            snapshots[f.side].push(f.snapshot());
          }
        let numbers = 0;
        function equal(a, b, where) {
          if (typeof a === 'number' && typeof b === 'number') {
            numbers++;
            if (!Object.is(a, b))
              throw Error(
                'Numeric mismatch at ' + where + ': ' + a + ' / ' + b,
              );
            return;
          }
          if (Array.isArray(a) && Array.isArray(b)) {
            if (a.length !== b.length)
              throw Error('Array mismatch at ' + where);
            a.forEach((value, index) =>
              equal(value, b[index], where + '/' + index),
            );
            return;

            for (const key of keys) equal(a[key], b[key], where + '/' + key);
            return;
          }
          if (a !== b) throw Error('Value mismatch at ' + where);
        }

          snapshots: 12,
          exactNumbers: numbers,
          signedZeroCompared: true,
          automaticGameFrames: true,
        };

        const rows = [];
        for (const f of fixtures) {
          f.game.destroy();
          if (f.texture.destroyed) throw Error('Borrowed Texture destroyed');
          f.texture.destroy();
          if (f.bitmap.width !== 0) throw Error('Native bitmap not closed');
          rows.push({
            side: f.side,
            gameState: f.game.state,
            bitmapClosed: true,
          });
        }
        fixtures = [];
        return rows;
      };
    },
    {
      afterEntry:
        process.env.P270_AFTER_ENTRY ?? '/p270-after/dist/src/index.js',
    },
  );
  const reports = [];
  for (const mode of [
    'local',
    'world',
    'local-custom',
    'local-screen',
    'local-transfer',
    'local-rotated',
    'local-trimmed',
    'local-source',
    'local-isolated',
    'world-isolated',
    'local-nested',
  ]) {
    const setup = await page.evaluate(
        (args) => globalThis.setupDynamic270(args),
        { backend, mode },
      ),
      proof = await page.evaluate(
        (mode) => globalThis.runDynamic270(mode),
        mode,
      ),
      hashes = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      const bytes = await page.screenshot({
        clip: { x: 0, y: i * 192, width: 256, height: 192 },
        path:
          directory +
          '/' +
          tag +
          '-' +
          backend +
          '-' +
          mode +
          '-' +
          (i === 0 ? 'before' : 'after') +
          '.png',
      });
      if (!pngPixels(bytes).nonuniform)
        throw Error('Blank native dynamic canvas');
      hashes.push(crypto.createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex'));
    }
    if (hashes[0] !== hashes[1])
      throw Error('Dynamic Game pixels differ for ' + mode);
    const cleanup = await page.evaluate(() => globalThis.cleanupDynamic270());
    reports.push({ setup, proof, matchingPngSha256: hashes[0], cleanup });
  }
  const result = {
    phase,
    tag,
    entryAfter: '/dist/src/index.js',
    observerPrototypeSelection: true,
    backend,
    browser: browserIdentity('chromium', browser, launch),
    reports,
    errors,
  };
  fs.writeFileSync(
    directory + '/' + tag + '-' + backend + '-dynamic.json',
    JSON.stringify(result),
  );
  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
```
```javascript
  if (errors.length) throw Error(errors.join('\n'));
} finally {
  await browser?.close();
  await server.close();
}
```

#### shared-scene-object.mjs

```javascript
import {
  hasObservedEventType,
  observeEventType,
  observeObjectEventTypes,
} from './event-observers.js';
/** Base facade for scene-owned objects, independent of 2D or 3D transforms. */
export class SceneObject extends EventTarget {
  owningScene;
  disposed = false;
  observedEventTypes;
  ownershipGeneration = 0;
  /** @internal Invalidates callback continuations on remove/re-add within the same Scene. */
  get registrationGeneration() {
    return this.ownershipGeneration;
  }
  addEventListener(type, callback, options) {
    super.addEventListener(type, callback, options);
    if (callback && !(typeof options === 'object' && options.signal?.aborted)) {
      if (!this.observedEventTypes)
        observeObjectEventTypes(this, (this.observedEventTypes = new Set()));
      this.observedEventTypes.add(type);
      observeEventType(type);
      if (type === 'preupdate') this.owningScene?.trackObjectPasses(this);
    }
  }
  /** @internal Untouched pooled sprites need no lifecycle Event allocations. */
  dispatchObjectEvent(type, detail) {
    if (this.observedEventTypes?.has(type))
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(type, { detail }));
  }
  /** @internal Whether `emitUpdate(type)` would dispatch. */
  observesUpdate(type) {
    return this.observedEventTypes?.has(type) === true;
  }
  /** @internal Update payloads are allocated only for objects observing lifecycle events. */
  emitUpdate(type, dt) {
    if (this.observedEventTypes?.has(type))
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(type, { detail: { dt } }));
  }
  get scene() {
    return this.owningScene;
  }
  get destroyed() {
    return this.disposed;
  }
  /** @internal Called only by Scene during registration. */
  attach(scene) {
    if (this.disposed) throw new Error('Cannot add a destroyed scene object.');
    if (this.owningScene)
      throw new Error('Scene object already belongs to a scene.');
    this.owningScene = scene;
    this.ownershipGeneration++;
  }
  /** @internal Called only by Scene during removal. */
  detach(scene) {
    if (this.owningScene === scene) {
      this.owningScene = undefined;
      this.ownershipGeneration++;
    }
  }
  destroy() {
    if (this.disposed) return;
    this.disposed = true;
    this.owningScene?.remove(this);
    try {
      this.onDestroy();
    } finally {
      this.dispatchObjectEvent('destroy');
    }
  }
  onDestroy() {}
}
function observesUpdateAfter270(type) {
  return (
    hasObservedEventType(type) && this.observedEventTypes?.has(type) === true
  );
}
const observerBefore270 = SceneObject.prototype.observesUpdate;
export function setObserverVariant270(variant) {
  SceneObject.prototype.observesUpdate =
    variant === 'after' ? observesUpdateAfter270 : observerBefore270;
}
export function getObserverVariant270() {
  const current = SceneObject.prototype.observesUpdate;
  return current === observesUpdateAfter270
    ? 'after'
    : current === observerBefore270
      ? 'before'
      : 'other';
}
```

#### shared-event-observers.mjs

```javascript
const objectEventObservers = new WeakMap();
/** Every type any object has observed; a superset of each per-object Set, never shrinking. */
const observedEventTypes = new Set();
/** @internal Share the existing listener Set without expanding scene facade declarations. */
export function observeObjectEventTypes(object, types) {
  objectEventObservers.set(object, types);
}
/** @internal Record each type added to a shared Set; unobserved types skip the object lookup. */
export function observeEventType(type) {
  observedEventTypes.add(type);
}
/** @internal Negative guard only; receiver-owned Sets also support proxied facades. */
export function hasObservedEventType(type) {
  return observedEventTypes.has(type);
}
/** @internal Observation stays conservative after remove, once, and signal abort. */
export function hasObjectEventObservers(object, type) {
  return (
    hasObservedEventType(type) &&
    (objectEventObservers.get(object)?.has(type) ?? false)
  );
}
```

- 六份文件與該測試檔的 Prettier check 全部通過；398個相對檔案連結存在，沒有認證 anchor。
- ACCEPTANCE append 前的8009868 bytes逐 byte保留，不重寫歷史。完整source timing與fixture已記錄；只清除本輪自己的temporary fixture目錄，沒有變動使用者檔案或正式產物。

## P271 — boolean observer guard 的完整 tradeoff，兩版皆不採用（2026-11-17）

### 正式交付與結論

本輪只有六份證據文件。沒有修改正式 SceneObject／event-observers／Scene、產物、公開入口、vendor、使用者檔案或 package 1.23.0，也沒有 build、promotion 或 push。P270 的永久 Proxy regression test 原樣保留，P271沒有重跑或新增永久unit tests；不得把歷史7 tests說成本輪全套驗收。

兩個原型都保留 receiver Set 與虛擬方法，將全域已觀察類型的熱路徑改用兩個單調 boolean，避免重複全域Set.has。第一版global-first在其他listener的active場景有simulation收益，但普通／history controls有成本；根據這項資料，第二版先讀receiver Set，absent就立即返回，避免對原本無Set的物件加全域查詢。這是實作順序的明確修正，沒有重跑同一實作尋找方向，也沒有捨棄第一版任何資料。

receiver-first 的 mixed/world active listener category sum均六輪較低，但empty listener category sum六輪較高；此全域狀態又會在任何post/pre listener曾出現後永久轉入history情況，不能只把冷啟動收益套用到所有Game。兩版均不採用，不擴張observer guard的新狀態。只記錄可確認的source-slot結果，不宣稱allocation、heap、GPU或呈現FPS改善。

canonical /dist/src/index.js，pinned Chromium 153.0.8010.12／darwin arm64／desktop automation；WebGL2與原生4×4ImageBitmap，visible，四emitter各8192。每個pool Sprite都實際註冊destroy listener；layer control則每個target一個。90 warm＋180 profiled frames、requested CDP sampling interval100µs。註冊／初始化狀態、0 post observer、live時0 destroy callback、Game.destroy後全部真實callback、borrowed Texture/bitmap cleanup均有驗證。profile的最後frameWork只是一幀，top-30是採樣self time，不能當逐幀分布或根因證明。

[INFERENCE] 其他event Set的存在提供省略逐物件has查詢的機會；這是可由原本判定式確認的候選成本，不等於已把所有採樣差異歸因到該操作。尤其這份正式profile仍不能證實先前empty pool的多毫秒simulation根因。

### 兩版未採用的原型

共用helper由原本唯一observeEventType writer維護pre/post兩個boolean，初始false，註冊後只會變true；remove／once／abort或Game teardown不縮減。generic observedEventTypes Set與WeakMap reader原本行為不變。沒有per-object新欄位、per-frame配置、依賴或公開index export。新增的內部helper／controller僅存在隔離原型，並未交付正式API。

共用helper：

```typescript
const objectEventObservers = new WeakMap<object, Set<string>>();
/** Every type any object has observed; a superset of each per-object Set, never shrinking. */
const observedEventTypes = new Set<string>();
let preupdateObserved = false;
let postupdateObserved = false;

/** @internal Share the existing listener Set without expanding scene facade declarations. */
export function observeObjectEventTypes(
  object: object,
  types: Set<string>,
): void {
  objectEventObservers.set(object, types);
}

/** @internal Record each type added to a shared Set; unobserved types skip the object lookup. */
export function observeEventType(type: string): void {
  observedEventTypes.add(type);
  if (type === 'preupdate') preupdateObserved = true;
  else if (type === 'postupdate') postupdateObserved = true;
}

/** @internal Observation stays conservative after remove, once, and signal abort. */
export function hasObjectEventObservers(object: object, type: string): boolean {
  return (
    observedEventTypes.has(type) &&
    (objectEventObservers.get(object)?.has(type) ?? false)
  );
}

/** @internal Negative-only flags share the generic index writer and never shrink. */
export function hasObservedUpdateType(
  type: 'preupdate' | 'postupdate',
): boolean {
  return type === 'preupdate' ? preupdateObserved : postupdateObserved;
}
```

第一版SceneObject文字（global-first）：

```typescript
import type { Scene } from './scene.js';
import {
  hasObservedUpdateType,
  observeEventType,
  observeObjectEventTypes,
} from './event-observers.js';

/** Base facade for scene-owned objects, independent of 2D or 3D transforms. */
export abstract class SceneObject extends EventTarget {
  private owningScene: Scene | undefined;
  private disposed = false;
  private observedEventTypes: Set<string> | undefined;
  private ownershipGeneration = 0;
  /** @internal Invalidates callback continuations on remove/re-add within the same Scene. */
  get registrationGeneration(): number {
    return this.ownershipGeneration;
  }

  override addEventListener(
    type: string,
    callback: EventListenerOrEventListenerObject | null,
    options?: boolean | AddEventListenerOptions,
  ): void {
    super.addEventListener(type, callback, options);
    if (callback && !(typeof options === 'object' && options.signal?.aborted)) {
      if (!this.observedEventTypes)
        observeObjectEventTypes(this, (this.observedEventTypes = new Set()));
      this.observedEventTypes.add(type);
      observeEventType(type);
      if (type === 'preupdate') this.owningScene?.trackObjectPasses(this);
    }
  }

  /** @internal Untouched pooled sprites need no lifecycle Event allocations. */
  dispatchObjectEvent(type: string, detail?: unknown): void {
    if (this.observedEventTypes?.has(type))
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(type, { detail }));
  }
  /** @internal Whether `emitUpdate(type)` would dispatch. */
  observesUpdate(type: 'preupdate' | 'postupdate'): boolean {
    return (
      hasObservedUpdateType(type) && this.observedEventTypes?.has(type) === true
    );
  }
  /** @internal Update payloads are allocated only for objects observing lifecycle events. */
  emitUpdate(type: 'preupdate' | 'postupdate', dt: number): void {
    if (this.observedEventTypes?.has(type))
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(type, { detail: { dt } }));
  }

  get scene(): Scene | undefined {
    return this.owningScene;
  }

  get destroyed(): boolean {
    return this.disposed;
  }

  /** @internal Called only by Scene during registration. */
  attach(scene: Scene): void {
    if (this.disposed) throw new Error('Cannot add a destroyed scene object.');
    if (this.owningScene)
      throw new Error('Scene object already belongs to a scene.');
    this.owningScene = scene;
    this.ownershipGeneration++;
  }

  /** @internal Called only by Scene during removal. */
  detach(scene: Scene): void {
    if (this.owningScene === scene) {
      this.owningScene = undefined;
      this.ownershipGeneration++;
    }
  }

  destroy(): void {
    if (this.disposed) return;
    this.disposed = true;
    this.owningScene?.remove(this);
    try {
      this.onDestroy();
    } finally {
      this.dispatchObjectEvent('destroy');
    }
  }

  protected onDestroy(): void {}
}
```

第二版SceneObject文字（receiver-first，只讀receiver field一次）：

```typescript
import type { Scene } from './scene.js';
import {
  hasObservedUpdateType,
  observeEventType,
  observeObjectEventTypes,
} from './event-observers.js';

/** Base facade for scene-owned objects, independent of 2D or 3D transforms. */
export abstract class SceneObject extends EventTarget {
  private owningScene: Scene | undefined;
  private disposed = false;
  private observedEventTypes: Set<string> | undefined;
  private ownershipGeneration = 0;
  /** @internal Invalidates callback continuations on remove/re-add within the same Scene. */
  get registrationGeneration(): number {
    return this.ownershipGeneration;
  }

  override addEventListener(
    type: string,
    callback: EventListenerOrEventListenerObject | null,
    options?: boolean | AddEventListenerOptions,
  ): void {
    super.addEventListener(type, callback, options);
    if (callback && !(typeof options === 'object' && options.signal?.aborted)) {
      if (!this.observedEventTypes)
        observeObjectEventTypes(this, (this.observedEventTypes = new Set()));
      this.observedEventTypes.add(type);
      observeEventType(type);
      if (type === 'preupdate') this.owningScene?.trackObjectPasses(this);
    }
  }

  /** @internal Untouched pooled sprites need no lifecycle Event allocations. */
  dispatchObjectEvent(type: string, detail?: unknown): void {
    if (this.observedEventTypes?.has(type))
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(type, { detail }));
  }
  /** @internal Whether `emitUpdate(type)` would dispatch. */
  observesUpdate(type: 'preupdate' | 'postupdate'): boolean {
    const observers = this.observedEventTypes;
    if (!observers) return false;
    return hasObservedUpdateType(type) && observers.has(type) === true;
  }
  /** @internal Update payloads are allocated only for objects observing lifecycle events. */
  emitUpdate(type: 'preupdate' | 'postupdate', dt: number): void {
    if (this.observedEventTypes?.has(type))
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(type, { detail: { dt } }));
  }

  get scene(): Scene | undefined {
    return this.owningScene;
  }

  get destroyed(): boolean {
    return this.disposed;
  }

  /** @internal Called only by Scene during registration. */
  attach(scene: Scene): void {
    if (this.disposed) throw new Error('Cannot add a destroyed scene object.');
    if (this.owningScene)
      throw new Error('Scene object already belongs to a scene.');
    this.owningScene = scene;
    this.ownershipGeneration++;
  }

  /** @internal Called only by Scene during removal. */
  detach(scene: Scene): void {
    if (this.owningScene === scene) {
      this.owningScene = undefined;
      this.ownershipGeneration++;
    }
  }

  destroy(): void {
    if (this.disposed) return;
    this.disposed = true;
    this.owningScene?.remove(this);
    try {
      this.onDestroy();
    } finally {
      this.dispatchObjectEvent('destroy');
    }
  }

  protected onDestroy(): void {}
}
```

### 兩版各自的原生消費端 gate

每版Sprite／ParticleLayer、WebGPU／WebGL2／Canvas2D、十一模式各66 cases／562716個Object.is數字，完全相同非空白PNG；signed zero也比較。模式為local/world/custom/screen/Scene transfer/rotated/trimmed/source/local-isolated/world-isolated/local-nested，每側12個automatic Game snapshots，Sprite矩陣於render後收集，layer經公開slot查詢。所有pool Sprite（layer則target）真的掛destroy listener，兩側Game.destroy後逐fixture核對數量，非once listener也能抓重送；每版共2178個這類native cleanup callbacks，borrowed Texture保留至顯式destroy、bitmap關閉、errors空。以下兩批不能混作單一候選的驗收：

### 固定 CPU 方法與所有控制

每版都先跑完整A/A，再以獨立新browser跑A/B；每模式十八cohort、各六輪alternating ABBA/BAAB、每label兩個samples，每sample8 warm＋48 measured frames。每模式432 averaged samples／20736 measured frames；兩版共1728 averaged samples／82944 measured frames。沒有刪ties／outliers、沒有以A/A median校正A/B，也沒有將跨版absolute時間拿來當paired收益。兩次CPU job期間均未啟動其他formatter、tests、build、profile或host工作。

每cohort只有同一個Game／Scene／renderer／canvas／command buffer／particle pool，只有一份canonical core graph，middleware僅override兩個observer模組；在sample warm前改private prototype method並記錄實際pointeridentity。A/A每mode432次都original，A/B各216次original／candidate。每cohort的65幀setup warm前明示選回original，兩種選擇各8 warm＋1probe後實際render再截圖；不是同一末狀態截兩次。

1280×720、pixelRatio1、autoResize false、visible、強制WebGL2、原生白4×4bitmap，四emitter各8192（small各128；empty保持容量而0活粒子）；固定rate0、life1000000、speed/acceleration0、8×4尺寸、固定color與nonuniform pose。sentinel依真實Scene simulation自然到期。既有frameWork四span不改clock／counter，Scene.update queueMicrotask在onFrame完成後讀當幀值；sum只是simulation＋navigation＋afterUpdate＋submit，不是完整frame latency、CPU指令計時、GPU elapsed或呈現FPS。

十八cohort在第一版開始前固定，修正版完全沿用：四個destroy-listener mixed/local/world/empty目標；原來八個mixed/local/world/nested/small/layer/empty/offscreen；512個真實post listener、post type已見過的empty、post已見後的local destroy-listener control、512 pre＋512 post且nested/mixed/diverse actors的history control、兩type都見過的empty、兩type都見過的empty destroy-listener control。

六個destroy-listener cohort各32768個listener；前四個assert全域pre/post皆false，後兩個分別assertpost=true與兩者=true。module狀態不會因destroy／移除listener而重設，不能把mature controls冒充冷啟動。每sample驗證live destroy callbacks為0，Game.destroy逐一送達全部，合計每mode196608次。pre/post callbacks則每sample精確檢查(8+48)×listenerCount、實際dt有效；sample warm＋measured合計每modepre688128／post1376256，不含setup/probe。沒有把正常callback配置移出量測或假造callback。

empty／offscreen probe預期空白，其餘非空白；所有cohort的兩側PNG相同、Game destroyed／外借Texture顯式destroy關閉bitmap。完整setup flags、selector、PNG與cleanup metadata：

### 採用判斷：保留收益，不掩蓋回退

- 第一版cold mixed/local/world destroy-listener simulation各六輪下降；mixed category sum也六輪下降。但small、普通actor及mature/history simulation仍有回退，尤其mixed lifecycle simulation六輪增加。這些不是可靜默忽略的controls，故不直接採用。
- 第二版mixed/world destroy-listener category sum paired median分別下降2.574%／3.945%、均六輪下降；simulation也六輪下降。local方向較弱，未以強項取代它。empty destroy-listener category sum反而增加4.952%、六輪都較高；simulation median增加3.166%、五輪較高。普通mixed總成本多數增加，mature destroy-listener simulation也多數增加；全部分項仍逐一保留。
- A/A自己也出現全部同向的cohort與大outlier，例如receiver-first A/A兩type-history empty總成本六輪較高；不能只憑六輪同向就證實單一因果，更不能把A/A值扣掉後宣稱修正後收益。沒有把未變動submit／afterUpdate的漂移算成已確認observer效果。
- [INFERENCE] mutable prototype selection可能影響inlining／deoptimization／prototype validity、warm-up與執行歷史；本輪沒有證明任何一項就是原因。初始original有65幀setup warm、兩probe各9幀，且call target可變，不是完全對稱JIT訓練或獨立靜態production bundle。
- 兩版都不進runtime；沒有把條件性收益包裝成所有Game的普遍改善。沒有production／CJS CPU、build／typecheck／全套tests、音訊unlock/cleanup、Safari或實體裝置認證。當輪native證據只覆蓋該pinned Chromium automation的三個backend，不是三種瀏覽器認證。

### 準備／分析失敗與工具界線

- 最初guarded source-template插入使用了錯誤的comment字串，直接拒絕替換；前兩個成功的temporary字串變更保留，只將新helper加在EOF，沒有重做成功setup、沒有碰正式source。
- native fixture初稿一度使用未驗證的children.length，執行前改成在實際iterable註冊時累計listener數，避免依未驗證collection型別取值；這不是runtime錯誤後放寬gate。
- receiver-first結果分析helper曾括號層數錯誤，整cell parse失敗、沒有執行；改用flatMap展平reports/cleanup後再計算，沒有重跑native或CPU，也沒有改原始資料。
- 移除舊native driver未使用的afterEntry參數與不存在的prefix預設值；實際入口一直是canonical /dist/src/index.js，兩版metadata與script一致，未加相容alias或fallback。
- Vite原有OPM dynamic-import analysis warning仍輸出；未改vendor／adapter、未加ignore壓制、未放寬任何engine validation。

### 重現 fixture 與兩版差異

以下保留當時root／port、Node環境與pinned browser前提，非新公開API或可攜式benchmark套件。第一版source metadata為source；receiver-first使用source-field-first。第二版除shared-scene-object外，其四個driver只將temporary directory改為field-first子目錄，helper完全相同；此重建關係已逐字驗證。兩版都要完整執行同一十八cohort矩陣，不可和其他host工作重疊。

```javascript
import {
  hasObservedUpdateType,
  observeEventType,
  observeObjectEventTypes,
} from './event-observers.js';
/** Base facade for scene-owned objects, independent of 2D or 3D transforms. */
export class SceneObject extends EventTarget {
  owningScene;
  disposed = false;
  observedEventTypes;
  ownershipGeneration = 0;
  /** @internal Invalidates callback continuations on remove/re-add within the same Scene. */
  get registrationGeneration() {
    return this.ownershipGeneration;
  }
  addEventListener(type, callback, options) {
    super.addEventListener(type, callback, options);
    if (callback && !(typeof options === 'object' && options.signal?.aborted)) {
      if (!this.observedEventTypes)
        observeObjectEventTypes(this, (this.observedEventTypes = new Set()));
      this.observedEventTypes.add(type);
      observeEventType(type);
      if (type === 'preupdate') this.owningScene?.trackObjectPasses(this);
    }
  }
  /** @internal Untouched pooled sprites need no lifecycle Event allocations. */
  dispatchObjectEvent(type, detail) {
    if (this.observedEventTypes?.has(type))
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(type, { detail }));
  }
  /** @internal Whether `emitUpdate(type)` would dispatch. */
  observesUpdate(type) {
    return this.observedEventTypes?.has(type) === true;
  }
  /** @internal Update payloads are allocated only for objects observing lifecycle events. */
  emitUpdate(type, dt) {
    if (this.observedEventTypes?.has(type))
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(type, { detail: { dt } }));
  }
  get scene() {
    return this.owningScene;
  }
  get destroyed() {
    return this.disposed;
  }
  /** @internal Called only by Scene during registration. */
  attach(scene) {
    if (this.disposed) throw new Error('Cannot add a destroyed scene object.');
    if (this.owningScene)
      throw new Error('Scene object already belongs to a scene.');
    this.owningScene = scene;
    this.ownershipGeneration++;
  }
  /** @internal Called only by Scene during removal. */
  detach(scene) {
    if (this.owningScene === scene) {
      this.owningScene = undefined;
      this.ownershipGeneration++;
    }
  }
  destroy() {
    if (this.disposed) return;
    this.disposed = true;
    this.owningScene?.remove(this);
    try {
      this.onDestroy();
    } finally {
      this.dispatchObjectEvent('destroy');
    }
  }
  onDestroy() {}
}
function observesUpdateAfter271(type) {
  return (
    hasObservedUpdateType(type) && this.observedEventTypes?.has(type) === true
```

```javascript
const objectEventObservers = new WeakMap();
/** Every type any object has observed; a superset of each per-object Set, never shrinking. */
const observedEventTypes = new Set();
let preupdateObserved = false;
let postupdateObserved = false;
/** @internal Share the existing listener Set without expanding scene facade declarations. */
export function observeObjectEventTypes(object, types) {
  objectEventObservers.set(object, types);
}
/** @internal Record each type added to a shared Set; unobserved types skip the object lookup. */
export function observeEventType(type) {
  observedEventTypes.add(type);
  if (type === 'preupdate') preupdateObserved = true;
  else if (type === 'postupdate') postupdateObserved = true;
}
/** @internal Observation stays conservative after remove, once, and signal abort. */
export function hasObjectEventObservers(object, type) {
  return (
    observedEventTypes.has(type) &&
    (objectEventObservers.get(object)?.has(type) ?? false)
  );
}
/** @internal Negative-only flags share the generic index writer and never shrink. */
export function hasObservedUpdateType(type) {
  return type === 'preupdate' ? preupdateObserved : postupdateObserved;
}
```

```javascript
          fixtures.push({
            side,
            game,
            scene,
            emitters,
            sentinel,
            texture,
            bitmap,
            sample,
            listenerCount,
            preListenerCount,
            destroyListenerCount,
            get destroyCalls() {
              return destroyCalls;
            },
          });
        }
        const updateTypes = contractShared.getObservedUpdateTypes271();
        if (config.expectedUpdates) {
          const expectedPre = config.expectedUpdates === 'both',
            expectedPost = config.expectedUpdates !== 'none';
          if (
            updateTypes.pre !== expectedPre ||
            updateTypes.post !== expectedPost
          )
            throw Error(
              'Unexpected update-type history ' + JSON.stringify(updateTypes),
            );
        }
        for (const fixture of fixtures) {
          await fixture.sample(1, 64);
          if (fixture.sentinel.activeCount !== 0)
            throw Error(
              'Foreign emitter class: actual Scene did not advance sentinel',
            );
          for (const emitter of fixture.emitters)
            if (emitter.activeCount !== (config.empty ? 0 : config.capacity))
              throw Error('Main fixture active count changed');
        }
        return {
          visibility: document.visibilityState,
          nativeBitmaps: fixtures.every((f) => f.bitmap instanceof ImageBitmap),
          automaticSceneSimulation: true,
          initialUpdateTypes: contractShared.getObservedUpdateTypes271(),
          destroyListenerCount: fixtures.reduce(
            (n, f) => n + f.destroyListenerCount,
            0,
          ),
          initialObserverVariant: contractShared.getObserverVariant271(),
          postListenerCount: fixtures.reduce((n, f) => n + f.listenerCount, 0),
          preListenerCount: fixtures.reduce(
            (n, f) => n + f.preListenerCount,
            0,
          ),
          activeParticlesPerSide: config.empty ? 0 : config.capacity * 4,
        };
      };
      globalThis.sampleGame271 = async ({ side, frames }) => {
        const fixture = fixtures[0];
        if (fixtures.length !== 1) throw Error('Expected one shared Game');
        contractShared.setObserverVariant271(
          controlMode === 'aa' ? 'before' : side,
        );
        return fixture.sample(frames);
      };
      globalThis.cleanupGame271 = () => {
        const result = [];
        for (const f of fixtures) {
          f.game.destroy();
          if (f.destroyCalls !== f.destroyListenerCount)
            throw Error(
              'Actual destroy callback mismatch ' +
                f.destroyCalls +
                '/' +
                f.destroyListenerCount,
            );
          if (f.texture.destroyed)
            throw Error('Game destroyed borrowed Texture');
          f.texture.destroy();
          if (f.bitmap.width !== 0) throw Error('Native bitmap not closed');
          result.push({
            side: f.side,
            gameDestroyed: f.game.state,
            bitmapClosed: true,
            destroyListeners: f.destroyListenerCount,
            destroyCallbacks: f.destroyCalls,
          });
        }
        fixtures = [];
        return result;
      };
    },
    { controlMode: process.env.P271_MODE ?? 'ab' },
  );
  const matrixStartedAt = Date.now();
  const mode = process.env.P271_MODE ?? 'ab',
    cohorts = [
      {
        name: 'sprite-mixed-destroy-listeners',
        space: 'mixed',
        capacity: 8192,
        destroyListeners: true,
        expectedUpdates: 'none',
      },
      {
        name: 'sprite-local-destroy-listeners',
        space: 'local',
        capacity: 8192,
        destroyListeners: true,
        expectedUpdates: 'none',
      },
      {
        name: 'sprite-world-destroy-listeners',
        space: 'world',
        capacity: 8192,
        destroyListeners: true,
        expectedUpdates: 'none',
      },
      {
        name: 'sprite-empty-destroy-listeners',
        space: 'local',
        capacity: 8192,
        empty: true,
        destroyListeners: true,
        expectedUpdates: 'none',
      },
      { name: 'sprite-mixed-large', space: 'mixed', capacity: 8192 },
      { name: 'sprite-local-large', space: 'local', capacity: 8192 },
      { name: 'sprite-world-large', space: 'world', capacity: 8192 },
      { name: 'sprite-local-nested', space: 'local', capacity: 8192, depth: 4 },
      { name: 'sprite-local-small', space: 'local', capacity: 128 },
      {
        name: 'layer-local-control',
        space: 'local',
        capacity: 8192,
        target: true,
      },
      {
        name: 'sprite-empty-control',
        space: 'local',
        capacity: 8192,
        empty: true,
      },
      {
        name: 'sprite-offscreen-large',
        space: 'local',
        capacity: 8192,
        offscreen: true,
      },
      {
        name: 'sprite-local-listeners-control',
        space: 'local',
        capacity: 8192,
        listenersPerEmitter: 128,
      },
      {
        name: 'sprite-empty-observed-type-control',
        space: 'local',
        capacity: 8192,
        empty: true,
      },
      {
        name: 'sprite-local-destroy-after-post-control',
        space: 'local',
        capacity: 8192,
        destroyListeners: true,
        expectedUpdates: 'post',
      },
      {
        name: 'sprite-mixed-lifecycle-history-control',
        space: 'mixed',
        capacity: 8192,
        depth: 4,
        listenersPerEmitter: 128,
        bothTypesSeen: true,
        diversity: true,
        preListenersPerEmitter: 128,
      },
      {
        name: 'sprite-empty-both-types-history-control',
        space: 'local',
        capacity: 8192,
        empty: true,
      },
      {
        name: 'sprite-empty-destroy-after-both-control',
        space: 'local',
        capacity: 8192,
        empty: true,
        destroyListeners: true,
        expectedUpdates: 'both',
      },
    ],
    rows = [],
    cohortProof = [];
  for (const config of cohorts) {
    const setup = await page.evaluate(
      (config) => globalThis.setupGame271(config),
      config,
    );
    const hashes = [],
      nonuniform = [];
    for (const side of ['before', 'after']) {
      const probe = await page.evaluate(
        (args) => globalThis.sampleGame271(args),
        { side, frames: 1 },
      );
      if (probe.observerVariant !== (mode === 'aa' ? 'before' : side))
        throw Error('Wrong actual observer method');
      const bytes = await page.screenshot({
        clip: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 1280, height: 720 },
        path: directory + '/' + mode + '-' + config.name + '-' + side + '.png',
      });
      const pixel = pngPixels(bytes);
      nonuniform.push(pixel.nonuniform);
      if (
        config.empty || config.offscreen ? pixel.nonuniform : !pixel.nonuniform
      )
        throw Error('Unexpected probe pixels for ' + config.name);
      hashes.push(crypto.createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex'));
    }
    if (hashes[0] !== hashes[1]) throw Error('Shared Game probe pixels differ');
    for (let round = 0; round < 6; round++) {
      const order =
          round % 2 === 0
            ? ['before', 'after', 'after', 'before']
            : ['after', 'before', 'before', 'after'],
        samples = [];
      for (const side of order) {
        const sample = await page.evaluate(
          (args) => globalThis.sampleGame271(args),
          { side, frames: 48 },
        );
        if (sample.observerVariant !== (mode === 'aa' ? 'before' : side))
          throw Error('Wrong timed observer method');
        samples.push({ side, ...sample });
      }
      rows.push({ name: config.name, round, order: order.join(','), samples });
    }
    const cleanup = await page.evaluate(() => globalThis.cleanupGame271());
    if (cleanup.length !== 1) throw Error('Not one shared Game');
    cohortProof.push({
      config,
      setup,
      oneSharedGame: true,
      oneSharedCanvas: true,
      preTimingNativeProbe: true,
      matchingPngSha256: hashes[0],
      nonuniform,
      cleanup,
    });
  }
  const result = {
    phase,
    mode,
    observerPrototypeSelection: true,
    sameCoreGraph: true,
    matrixStartedAt,
    matrixCompletedAt: Date.now(),
    browser: browserIdentity('chromium', browser, launch),
    cohortProof,
    rows,
    errors,
  };
  fs.writeFileSync(
    directory + '/' + mode + '-game-results.json',
    JSON.stringify(result),
  );
  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(
      {
        phase,
        browser: result.browser,
        cohorts: cohortProof,
        rows: rows.length,
        samples: rows.length * 4,
        errors,
      },
      null,
      2,
    ),
  );
  if (errors.length) throw Error(errors.join('\n'));
} finally {
  await browser?.close();
  await server.close();
}
```

#### receiver-first / shared-scene-object.mjs

```javascript
import {
  hasObservedUpdateType,
  observeEventType,
  observeObjectEventTypes,
} from './event-observers.js';
/** Base facade for scene-owned objects, independent of 2D or 3D transforms. */
export class SceneObject extends EventTarget {
  owningScene;
  disposed = false;
  observedEventTypes;
  ownershipGeneration = 0;
  /** @internal Invalidates callback continuations on remove/re-add within the same Scene. */
  get registrationGeneration() {
    return this.ownershipGeneration;
  }
  addEventListener(type, callback, options) {
    super.addEventListener(type, callback, options);
    if (callback && !(typeof options === 'object' && options.signal?.aborted)) {
      if (!this.observedEventTypes)
        observeObjectEventTypes(this, (this.observedEventTypes = new Set()));
      this.observedEventTypes.add(type);
      observeEventType(type);
      if (type === 'preupdate') this.owningScene?.trackObjectPasses(this);
    }
  }
  /** @internal Untouched pooled sprites need no lifecycle Event allocations. */
  dispatchObjectEvent(type, detail) {
    if (this.observedEventTypes?.has(type))
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(type, { detail }));
  }
  /** @internal Whether `emitUpdate(type)` would dispatch. */
  observesUpdate(type) {
    return this.observedEventTypes?.has(type) === true;
  }
  /** @internal Update payloads are allocated only for objects observing lifecycle events. */
  emitUpdate(type, dt) {
    if (this.observedEventTypes?.has(type))
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(type, { detail: { dt } }));
  }
  get scene() {
    return this.owningScene;
  }
  get destroyed() {
    return this.disposed;
  }
  /** @internal Called only by Scene during registration. */
  attach(scene) {
    if (this.disposed) throw new Error('Cannot add a destroyed scene object.');
    if (this.owningScene)
      throw new Error('Scene object already belongs to a scene.');
    this.owningScene = scene;
    this.ownershipGeneration++;
  }
  /** @internal Called only by Scene during removal. */
  detach(scene) {
    if (this.owningScene === scene) {
      this.owningScene = undefined;
      this.ownershipGeneration++;
    }
  }
  destroy() {
    if (this.disposed) return;
    this.disposed = true;
    this.owningScene?.remove(this);
    try {
      this.onDestroy();
    } finally {
      this.dispatchObjectEvent('destroy');
    }
  }
  onDestroy() {}
}
function observesUpdateAfter271(type) {
  const observers = this.observedEventTypes;
  if (!observers) return false;
  return hasObservedUpdateType(type) && observers.has(type) === true;
}
const observerBefore271 = SceneObject.prototype.observesUpdate;
export function setObserverVariant271(side) {
  SceneObject.prototype.observesUpdate =
    side === 'after' ? observesUpdateAfter271 : observerBefore271;
}
export function getObserverVariant271() {
  const current = SceneObject.prototype.observesUpdate;
  return current === observerBefore271
    ? 'before'
    : current === observesUpdateAfter271
      ? 'after'
      : 'other';
}
export function getObservedUpdateTypes271() {
  return {
    pre: hasObservedUpdateType('preupdate'),
    post: hasObservedUpdateType('postupdate'),
  };
}
```

## P272 — 採用同次 Group bounds 查詢的 affine inverse 重用

記錄時間（UTC）：2026-11-17T16:01:48.009Z。套件仍為 1.23.0，無 push。

### 範圍、硬指標與結果

- 基線為 P271 commit f56a8326f（runtime 仍為 P267）。先確認真正的呼叫路徑，不能把 ordinary world 的未觸發分支當成此優化的速度證據。固定 32,768 Sprite、四個 8,192-capacity emitter 的正式 Game，普通 local/world 每幀 Group queries/inverses 均為零；local isolation 有24次 queries、零 Group inverse；world isolation 有24次 queries、98,304次 Group inverse。每個結果都保留四個 count frames。
- 初版 cache inverse 仍在每個 child copy parent；第二版保留 parent Float32 元素讀取，只在 cache miss 寫入 parent，cache hit 直接還原 inverse。六個 affine 值用 Object.is；query-local 十二個數值與 ready flag，沒有新增 instance fields／typed arrays／跨 query state。兩個公開 updateWorldMatrix callbacks 的順序、callback 前 rectangle snapshot、Float32 inverse stores 與 multiply(world) 時序保留；不用 identity/revision 假設 matrix 沒被 callback 改寫。
- 採用第二版。world-isolation 的四個 count frames 均由98,304降到12次 Group inverse，全部 Matrix3 inverse 由131,076降到32,784；這是 operation count，不是 CPU／GPU／heap 或 FPS 的換算。普通／local-isolated controls 的 counts 不變。
- 兩版各固定八 cohort A/A 192 samples 再 A/B 192 samples；共768 samples、36,864量測 frames。每cohort只有一個 Game／Scene／renderer／canvas／pool，單一 core graph；module 初始化時裝一次固定 public trampoline，sample 只切 private function binding，不在每個 sample 改 prototype。初始65-frame sample 明確選 before；兩個選擇各 render 9-frame probe 並截圖，才開始六輪交替 ABBA/BAAB，每sample8 warm＋48量測frames。全量 raw、ties、極端值與五分項均保留，不減掉 A/A median，也不跨批比較 absolute 時間推論收益。
- 初版 isolated-world category sum paired median -0.9024218379575879%，六輪快，但 local-isolation control 也 -1.086193857636315%，且 nested target submit 五輪慢；不選初版。第二版 isolated-world submit -2.9857056169379614%／sum -2.557493135713568%，六輪快；nested submit -1.3588713363701357%，六輪快，sum -1.2970149456652615%，五輪快一輪慢。mixed submit 六輪快，但 sum 有一輪 +5.620251896790338e-9% 的浮點級正值，仍保留為 slower、不改成 tie。local-isolation control submit 也六輪快（-0.83081417842019%），不能把全部分項差異都歸因 inverse。
- 第二版 layer control simulation 六輪慢（paired median +19.09090642717265%，絕對 +2.0833330539365598 µs），其 sum 只有3/3方向、+0.45651676179501377%；plain-world sum +0.6086094932648607% 但3/3方向，small/empty 也保留。不用 percentage 隱藏小分母、controls 或 outliers。收益只支持這條局部 source-slot 路徑，不是 universal speedup。
- 兩版各 Sprite／target layer ×11 modes×三 backend，共132個動態 Game cases，合計1,125,432個 Object.is數字對照、每case nonblank matching PNG；真實 destroy callbacks 各2,178。正式 dev 與 minified ESM dist 另有24個大型 Game cases，皆實際自動 Scene simulation、三backend強制選擇、非空畫面及原生 bitmap cleanup；world-isolated 六組正式入口 counts 均為12。正式 CJS 入口15項 consumer assertions 通過。
- 新增兩個永久 consumer regression tests：child callback 改 parent affine／改成 singular/nonfinite，以及同一 group 的 callback 重入並暫改 parent，含不同 child rectangle 的 scratch 保護。兩個定向檔40 tests、strict tsc 與兩檔 scoped ESLint 通過。隔離完整 build只帶回四個 Group2D JS／CJS／maps，d.ts不變，11個使用者檔案受hash guard保護。

### 界線與初次失敗（不抹除）

1. 第一個 throwaway numerical oracle 誤把 Matrix3.compose 當 scalar API；實際簽章為 Vector2 position／rotation／Vector2 scale。最初 successful numeric comparisons 可能只驗到相同 NaN，故撤回其 finite 正確性主張，兩份原報告標為 pre-correction 保留如下，不拿來支持採用。永久 tests 第一次因同一參數錯誤而2項 RangeError失敗，既有其餘測試未失敗；當時後續 tsc／lint／build 尚未執行。修正後重新執行兩版 oracle，新增每個 successful 數字必須 finite、singular/nonfinite 必須明確為既有 RangeError；兩版分別1,536／2,048個 finite Object.is數字通過。真正 Game/CPU fixtures 一直使用實際 Game/ParticleEmitter/Vector2 API，不使用這個錯誤 compose setup，其量測不需重跑，也未重跑挑方向。
2. 複製版本第二次準備曾因 Prettier 換行使 guarded text replacement 找不到唯一区段而停止；讀取實際文字後修正，只影響 throwaway 準備，不修改正式 source。
3. 第一次 direct formal-native fixture 重用同一 canvas 跨 backend，WebGPU context 已綁定後，強制 WebGL2 正確回報 context unavailable。這是 fixture 生命週期問題，不是引擎降級；修正為每個 Game 新 canvas，24 cases 全通過，不壓制初始化錯誤或改 renderer validation。原失敗 log 保留摘錄。
4. Vite 原有 OPM dynamic-import analysis warning 保留，未修改 vendor／音訊／validation。沒有重新驗證 audio unlock、audio cleanup 或平台認證。
5. 所有 CPU／標準 benchmark 期間均未同時執行 formatter／tests／build／profile 或其他自啟 host 工作。固定 function binding 仍有 tiering/inlining、warmup、時序與 A/A 漂移限制；不同 spans 的變動不是已確認 JIT 或 GC 根因。frameWork 的四分項和不是完整 RAF CPU，submit 是 CPU submit，不是 GPU duration。正式 source／dist／CJS correctness 不擴張成這些入口的 paired CPU certification。
6. 僅以下記錄的 Chromium desktop automation，非 physical hardware／Safari／其他瀏覽器認證。未量測 heap、JS allocation 數或 GPU時間；程式沒有新增 instance fields 不等於量測到零配置。

### 固定 paired CPU 全量

每版四個8,192（small為128）emitter、static size/color/lifetime、生效的 sentinel life expiry 確認 Scene 真有 advance。isolation cohort 每emitter一個 isolate/opacity0.8 holder，rotation0.3／scale1.3,0.7、512×256 rectangle births，WebGL2／1280×720／pixelRatio1。Layer、plain-world、empty、ordinary local 的 controls 不假裝觸發大量 Group inverse。無 update/destroy listener，所有sample與cleanup listener/callback數皆0並由實際報告檢查。以下四批的每個實際 selected method 都已比對 label（A/A 全before，A/B每版96/96）。

### 完整可重建 throwaway fixtures

只用 /tmp，沒有 selector 加進正式 API。以下 initial directory 是 /tmp/xyz-p272，copy-eliding 是 /tmp/xyz-p272-copy-elision；native Sprite/layer 與 CPU driver 僅把 directory 全字串替換即得到第二版，已逐byte比對。第二版使用另列 shared-group 與擴充 parent-elements-reenter 的 corrected proof。所有 static module specifiers 都是 static import；page.evaluate 是 classic callback，必須在該 callback 內 dynamic import，已註明邊界。執行前先重建對應檔，P272_MODE=aa/ab、P272_BACKEND=webgpu/webgl2/canvas2d、P272_TAG=sprite/layer；不可同時跑兩個 native server 或在 CPU期間做其他工作。

#### baseline.mjs

```js
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { createServer } from '/Users/yueyuhoshizora/Code/Tooles/XYZ.js/node_modules/vite/dist/node/index.js';
import { chromium } from '/Users/yueyuhoshizora/Code/Tooles/XYZ.js/node_modules/playwright-core/index.mjs';
import {
  browserLaunchOptions,
  browserIdentity,
} from '/Users/yueyuhoshizora/Code/Tooles/XYZ.js/scripts/browser-launch.mjs';

const root = '/Users/yueyuhoshizora/Code/Tooles/XYZ.js';
const directory = '/tmp/xyz-p272';
const port = 5272;
const server = await createServer({
  root,
  configFile: false,
  server: { host: '127.0.0.1', port, strictPort: true },
  plugins: [
    {
      name: 'p272-count-only-baseline',
      configureServer(server) {
        server.middlewares.use((req, res, next) => {
          if (req.url !== '/p272-count') return next();
          res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/html');
          res.end(
            '<!doctype html><html><head><title>Real Group bounds operation count</title></head><body><canvas id="game"></canvas></body></html>',
          );
        });
      },
    },
  ],
});
let browser;
try {
  await server.listen();
  const launch = await browserLaunchOptions('chromium');
  browser = await chromium.launch(launch);
  const errors = [];
  const page = await browser.newPage({
    viewport: { width: 1280, height: 720 },
  });
  page.on('pageerror', (error) => errors.push(error.stack ?? error.message));
  await page.goto(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/p272-count`);
  await page.evaluate(async () => {
    // page.evaluate is a classic callback; module loading must happen inside it.
    const api = await import('/dist/src/index.js');
    const getBounds = api.Group2D.prototype.getLocalBounds;
    const invert = api.Matrix3.prototype.invert;
    let depth = 0;
    let queries = 0;
    let groupInverses = 0;
    let allInverses = 0;
    api.Group2D.prototype.getLocalBounds = function (out) {
      queries++;
      depth++;
      try {
        return getBounds.call(this, out);
      } finally {
        depth--;
      }
    };
    api.Matrix3.prototype.invert = function () {
      allInverses++;
      if (depth > 0) groupInverses++;
      return invert.call(this);
    };
    globalThis.countGroup272 = async (mode) => {
      if (document.visibilityState !== 'visible')
        throw Error('Hidden counting page');
      const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(
        new ImageData(new Uint8ClampedArray(64).fill(255), 4, 4),
      );
      const texture = new api.Texture(bitmap);
      const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
      const game = await api.Game.create({
        canvas,
        renderer: 'webgl2',
        width: 1280,
        height: 720,
        pixelRatio: 1,
        autoResize: false,
      });
      let rejectFrames;
      let runtimeError;
      const frames = [];
      const completed = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        rejectFrames = reject;
        const record = () => {
          if (runtimeError) {
            game.pause();
            reject(Error(runtimeError));
            return;
          }
          if (depth !== 0) {
            game.pause();
            reject(Error('Unbalanced bounds query'));
            return;
          }
          if (scene.tick > 16)
            frames.push({
              frame: scene.tick,
              queries,
              groupInverses,
              allInverses,
            });
          queries = 0;
          groupInverses = 0;
          allInverses = 0;
          if (scene.tick >= 20) {
            game.pause();
            resolve();
          }
        };
        class CountedScene extends api.Scene {
          tick = 0;
          update() {
            this.tick++;
            queueMicrotask(record);
          }
        }
        globalThis.sceneCount272 = new CountedScene();
      });
      const scene = globalThis.sceneCount272;
      game.addEventListener('error', (event) => {
        runtimeError = event.detail?.stack ?? String(event.detail);
        rejectFrames(Error(runtimeError));
      });
      const emitters = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const holder = mode.includes('isolated')
          ? new api.IsolatedGroup2D()
          : new api.Group2D();
```

```js
              return;
            }
            if (pending.warm > 0) {
              --pending.warm;
              return;
            }
            if (destroyCalls !== 0) {
              const p = pending;
              pending = undefined;
              game.pause();
              p.reject(Error('Destroy callbacks during live sample'));
              return;
            }
            const stats = game.frameWork;
            pending.simulation += stats.simulationMs;
            pending.navigation += stats.navigationMs;
            pending.afterUpdate += stats.afterUpdateMs;
            pending.submit += stats.renderSubmitMs;
            if (--pending.remaining === 0) {
              const p = pending;
              pending = undefined;
              game.pause();
              const result = {};
              for (const key of [
                'simulation',
                'navigation',
                'afterUpdate',
                'submit',
              ])
                result[key + 'Us'] = (p[key] * 1000) / p.frames;
              result.categorySumUs =
                result.simulationUs +
                result.navigationUs +
                result.afterUpdateUs +
                result.submitUs;
              const deliveredPre = preCalls - p.preAtStart;
              if (deliveredPre !== p.expectedPostFrames * preListenerCount) {
                p.reject(
                  Error('Lost/duplicated preupdate callbacks: ' + deliveredPre),
                );
                return;
              }
              const delivered = postCalls - p.postAtStart;
              if (delivered !== p.expectedPostFrames * listenerCount) {
                p.reject(
                  Error('Lost/duplicated postupdate callbacks: ' + delivered),
                );
                return;
              }
              p.resolve({
                ...result,
                boundsVariant: contractShared.getBoundsVariant272(),
                destroyCallbacksDuringSample: destroyCalls,
                destroyListeners: destroyListenerCount,
                postupdateCallbacksIncludingWarm: delivered,
                postListeners: listenerCount,
                preupdateCallbacksIncludingWarm: deliveredPre,
                preListeners: preListenerCount,
              });
            }
          };
          class MeasuredScene extends api.Scene {
            update() {
              queueMicrotask(record);
            }
          }
          if (config.bothTypesSeen) {
            const history = new api.GameObject();
            let historyCalls = 0;
            const priorListener = () => {
              historyCalls++;
            };
            history.addEventListener('preupdate', priorListener);
            history.addEventListener('postupdate', priorListener);
            history.removeEventListener('preupdate', priorListener);
            history.removeEventListener('postupdate', priorListener);
            history.destroy();
            if (historyCalls !== 0)
              throw Error('Detached history object unexpectedly updated');
          }
          const scene = new MeasuredScene();
          game = await api.Game.create({
            canvas,
            renderer: 'webgl2',
            width: 1280,
            height: 720,
            pixelRatio: 1,
            autoResize: false,
            frameWorkBudgetMs: 1000 / 60,

          });

          for (let depth = 0; depth < (config.depth ?? 0); depth++)

          for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            const target = config.target
              ? new api.ParticleLayer2D({ capacity: config.capacity })
              : undefined;
            const emitter = new api.ParticleEmitter({
              texture,
              target,
              capacity: config.capacity,
              rate: 0,
              lifetime: [1e6, 1e6],
              speed: [0, 0],
              angle: [-Math.PI, Math.PI],
              acceleration: [0, 0],
              startSize: [8, 4],
              endSize: [8, 4],
              startColor: [0.7, 0.2, 0.4, 0.8],
              endColor: [0.7, 0.2, 0.4, 0.8],
              seed: 17 + i,
              space:
                config.space === 'mixed'
                  ? i < 2
                    ? 'local'
                    : 'world'
                  : config.space,
              nozzle: { kind: 'rectangle', width: 512, height: 256 },
            });
            emitter.position.set(
              config.offscreen ? -10000 + 320 * i : 160 + 320 * i,
              360,
            );
            emitter.rotation = 0.3;
            emitter.scale.set(1.3, 0.7);
            if (!config.empty) emitter.emit(config.capacity);
            if (config.destroyListeners)
              for (const actor of emitter.children) {
                actor.addEventListener('destroy', onDestroyed);
                destroyListenerCount++;
              }
            if (config.isolated) {
              const isolated = holder.add(new api.IsolatedGroup2D());
              isolated.isolate = true;
              isolated.opacity = 0.8;
              isolated.add(emitter);
            } else holder.add(emitter);
            emitters.push(emitter);
          }
          if (config.diversity) {
            scene.add(new api.GameObject());
            scene.add(new api.Sprite({ texture, position: [40, 40] }));
            scene.add(new api.ParticleLayer2D({ capacity: 1 }));
          }
          const sentinel = scene.add(
            new api.ParticleEmitter({
              texture,
              capacity: 1,
              rate: 0,
              lifetime: [0.001, 0.001],
              speed: [0, 0],
              angle: [0, 0],
              acceleration: [0, 0],
              startSize: [1, 1],
              endSize: [1, 1],
              startColor: [1, 1, 1, 1],
              endColor: [1, 1, 1, 1],

                preAtStart: preCalls,

        const fixture = fixtures[0];
        if (fixtures.length !== 1) throw Error('Expected one shared Game');
        contractShared.setBoundsVariant272(
          controlMode === 'aa' ? 'before' : side,
        );
        return fixture.sample(frames);

        const result = [];
        for (const f of fixtures) {
          f.game.destroy();
          if (f.destroyCalls !== f.destroyListenerCount)
            throw Error(

                '/' +
                f.destroyListenerCount,
            );

            throw Error('Game destroyed borrowed Texture');
          f.texture.destroy();
          if (f.bitmap.width !== 0) throw Error('Native bitmap not closed');

            side: f.side,
            gameDestroyed: f.game.state,
            bitmapClosed: true,
            destroyListeners: f.destroyListenerCount,
            destroyCallbacks: f.destroyCalls,
          });
        }
        fixtures = [];
        return result;
      };
    },
    { controlMode: process.env.P272_MODE ?? 'ab' },
  );
  const matrixStartedAt = Date.now();
  const mode = process.env.P272_MODE ?? 'ab',
    cohorts = [
      {
        name: 'sprite-world-isolated-large',
        space: 'world',
        capacity: 8192,
        isolated: true,
      },
      {
        name: 'sprite-mixed-isolated-large',
        space: 'mixed',
        capacity: 8192,
        isolated: true,
      },
      {
        name: 'sprite-local-isolated-control',
        space: 'local',
        capacity: 8192,
        isolated: true,
      },
      {
        name: 'sprite-world-isolated-small',
        space: 'world',
        capacity: 128,
        isolated: true,
      },
      {
        name: 'sprite-world-isolated-nested',
        space: 'world',
        capacity: 8192,
        isolated: true,
        depth: 4,
      },
      {
        name: 'layer-world-isolated-control',
        space: 'world',
        capacity: 8192,
        isolated: true,
        target: true,
      },
      { name: 'sprite-world-plain-control', space: 'world', capacity: 8192 },
      {
        name: 'sprite-empty-isolated-control',
        space: 'world',
        capacity: 8192,
        isolated: true,
        empty: true,
      },
    ],
    rows = [],
    cohortProof = [];
  for (const config of cohorts) {
    const setup = await page.evaluate(
      (config) => globalThis.setupGame272(config),
      config,
    );
    const hashes = [],
      nonuniform = [];
    for (const side of ['before', 'after']) {
      const probe = await page.evaluate(
        (args) => globalThis.sampleGame272(args),
        { side, frames: 1 },
      );
      if (probe.boundsVariant !== (mode === 'aa' ? 'before' : side))
        throw Error('Wrong actual bounds method');
      const bytes = await page.screenshot({
        clip: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 1280, height: 720 },
        path: directory + '/' + mode + '-' + config.name + '-' + side + '.png',
      });
      const pixel = pngPixels(bytes);
      nonuniform.push(pixel.nonuniform);
      if (
        config.empty || config.offscreen ? pixel.nonuniform : !pixel.nonuniform
      )
        throw Error('Unexpected probe pixels for ' + config.name);
      hashes.push(crypto.createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex'));
    }
    if (hashes[0] !== hashes[1]) throw Error('Shared Game probe pixels differ');
    for (let round = 0; round < 6; round++) {
      const order =
          round % 2 === 0
            ? ['before', 'after', 'after', 'before']
            : ['after', 'before', 'before', 'after'],
        samples = [];
      for (const side of order) {
        const sample = await page.evaluate(
          (args) => globalThis.sampleGame272(args),
          { side, frames: 48 },
        );
        if (sample.boundsVariant !== (mode === 'aa' ? 'before' : side))
          throw Error('Wrong timed bounds method');
        samples.push({ side, ...sample });
      }
      rows.push({ name: config.name, round, order: order.join(','), samples });
    }
    const cleanup = await page.evaluate(() => globalThis.cleanupGame272());
    if (cleanup.length !== 1) throw Error('Not one shared Game');
    cohortProof.push({
      config,
      setup,
      oneSharedGame: true,
      oneSharedCanvas: true,
      preTimingNativeProbe: true,
      matchingPngSha256: hashes[0],
      nonuniform,
      cleanup,
    });
  }
  const result = {
    phase,
    mode,
    fixedBoundsTrampolineSelection: true,
    sameCoreGraph: true,
    matrixStartedAt,
    matrixCompletedAt: Date.now(),
    browser: browserIdentity('chromium', browser, launch),
    cohortProof,
    rows,
    errors,
  };
  fs.writeFileSync(
    directory + '/' + mode + '-game-results.json',
    JSON.stringify(result),
  );
  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(
      {
        phase,
        browser: result.browser,
        cohorts: cohortProof,
        rows: rows.length,
        samples: rows.length * 4,
        errors,
      },
      null,
      2,
    ),
  );
  if (errors.length) throw Error(errors.join('\n'));
} finally {
  await browser?.close();
  await server.close();
}
```

```js
    const p = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) walk(p);
    else {
      const relative = path.relative(stage, p),
        old = path.join(baseline, relative);
      if (
        !fs.existsSync(old) ||
        !fs.readFileSync(old).equals(fs.readFileSync(p))
      )
        changed.push(relative);
    }
  }
}

  throw Error(`Unexpected build outputs ${JSON.stringify(changed)}`);
for (const [p, h] of Object.entries(protectedHashes))
  if (hash(path.join(root, p)) !== h)
    throw Error(`Protected user file changed: ${p}`);

for (const file of names) {

}
fs.writeFileSync(
```

## P273 — 不採用 isolated GPU mapping 的 identity elision

UTC 記錄時間：2026-11-17T16:37:02.124Z。基線為 P272 commit 3ad6ac034，套件仍1.23.0。本輪只提交六份證據文件，不改正式 renderer／dist／API，不 push。

### 調查與硬指標

- Canvas2D 在每次 draw/pass 先準備 root inverse，未發現同樣逐 item inverse；WebGL2／WebGPU 的 private objectMatrix 則先 identity，再對 root world matrix copy/invert。除 actual Game counters 外，讀取三個backend的執行時序，沒有假定普通 world 會觸發隔離分支。
- 先評估最小無狀態改動，而非加入新 cache：只把 identity 移入非 root 分支；root copy/invert 覆寫全部九個元素，公開 root/child world callback、bounds offset 與 Float32 arithmetic 相對順序不變。renderer-owned scratch 不在正式 facade 公開。沒有新欄位、物件或跨pass狀態；這是 source 結構觀察，不是配置數量測。
- count-only 真實 Game：四個8192-capacity Sprite emitter、32768 active particles，1280×720、pixelRatio1、16 warm＋四個記錄frames。local/world isolation 在兩個GPU backend，每幀 total identity由32772變4，其中root-mapping identity由32768變0；root-mapping inverse仍32768、沒有省下inverse。普通 local/world的32719次identity不變（不把activeCount當實際逐item繪製數），Canvas2D全為零不變。每個case、每個frame完整保留。
- counter wrappers在初始化時安裝一次、delegate實際原方法並以finally平衡depth，沒有fake輸出；但會改變JIT可見副作用，因此只能說semantic call counts減少，不能說真正CPU stores少了固定數目，也不能換算CPU/GPU時間或FPS。它們沒有裝在CPU driver。
- 66個 native dynamic Game cases：Sprite／target layer各11modes×Canvas2D/WebGL2/WebGPU；562716個Object.is數字、signed zero比較、每case非空before/after PNG相同，2178個真實destroy callbacks與borrowed Texture／native ImageBitmap cleanup通過。world-isolated不是blank PASS；after WebGL2畫面有實際開啟查看。
- 固定12 cohort，WebGL2／WebGPU各world/local isolation、nested world isolation、plain-world、target-layer world isolation、empty isolation。每cohort同一Game／Scene／renderer／canvas／pool，actual backend明確檢查；先A/A 288samples、再A/B 288samples，共576samples／27648量測frames。每sample8warm＋48measured、六輪交替ABBA/BAAB，65-frame setup明確選before；兩個選擇各真正render probe才截圖。
- 每個GPU renderer只在module init把private objectMatrix裝一次固定trampoline；sample僅切兩個module的private function binding，controller逐次確保兩backend選擇相同。沒有每sample prototype mutation、沒有分開core classes、沒有混用Graph。A/A每label實際全before；A/B 144before/144after，逐sample檢查。全部五分項與raw/ties/outliers保留。

### 結論與對照界線

不採用。A/B WebGL2 world isolated sum median paired -0.12398152553977845%（3快3慢），local +0.280578402457853%（3/3），nested -0.4944802871173982%（4快2慢）；WebGPU world/local/nested sum分別 -0.4638572528587925%／-0.5252578755993668%／-0.08281324269326193%，皆4快2慢。目標submit方向也沒有任何六輪一致。A/A本身已有同量級方向差異，不扣除A/A median當作校正或把跨批absolute值當收益。

WebGPU empty control的simulation paired median +9.1867698807128%（絕對+164.58333353512µs、五輪慢），submit +10.788674556428548%（+163.54166584399854µs、四輪慢），sum +10.915127368300318%（+371.8750001086546µs、五輪慢）；A/A該sum範圍 -12.23847017279313%到+20.567375872853606%，也不穩定。保留這些偏移，不推斷已確認的單一JIT／GC原因或因果回退。plain/layer controls與所有微小／零分母分項均在下表，不挑較好方向重跑。

即使看似可以省掉source writes，本次沒有可靠CPU理由採用。mutable-call-target的trampoline、不同函式位置／class-method與standalone候選形狀、tiering/inlining、warmup及時間序列仍有source-slot限制；不是正式production／CJS CPU證明。frameWork四分項的和不是完整RAF CPU，submit不是GPU time，未量測heap／allocations／呈現FPS。只認證記錄的Chromium desktop automation，不是physical device／Safari／其他瀏覽器。

### 固定 A/A 與 A/B 全量

四個8192-capacity emitter，static size/color/lifetime，isolate holder每emitter一個且opacity0.8，rectangle births512×256，rotation0.3/scale1.3,0.7；nested加四層Group。source未加counter或observer狀態。每cohort sentinel life expiry確認真正Scene advance，native probes確認matching pixels；所有timed sample與cleanup的pre/post/destroy listener/callback數皆0，已逐項檢查。

### 可重建 fixtures 與失敗紀錄

以下prepare-fixture.mjs從基線commit的兩個renderer source產生隔離module，不複製整份renderer到本記錄；TS target/module均ES2022，再用repo singleQuote/trailingComma格式化。已實際用不同輸出directory重建，cmp確認兩個shared renderer與controller逐byte相同。controller/prototype中保留的mappingProof273 export沒有被本輪使用，不作額外matrix oracle主張，也不是正式API。

準備count driver時，最初把未閉合try區段送給Prettier，得到Unexpected token/EOF；未啟動測量。改為先處理完整script、最後才切prefix與補finally，格式化後才執行。沒有engine或native gate failure。原有Vite OPM dynamic-import warning保留，未壓制或修改vendor。CPU期間沒有formatter／tests／build／profile／其他自啟host工作，沒有重跑計時尋求想要方向。

每個Game新建canvas，避免P272已記錄的跨backend context綁定問題。分頁必須visible、強制backend失敗不fallback。page.evaluate是classic callback，只有此邊界內dynamic import；其餘static imports維持static。以下scripts全在/tmp，測完刪除。

#### prepare-fixture.mjs

```js

  directory = process.argv[2] ?? '/tmp/xyz-p273';
const config = { singleQuote: true, trailingComma: 'all' };
const oldBody =
    "    const e = out.identity().elements;\n    if (context.root) out.copy(context.root.updateWorldMatrix()).invert();\n    else if (object.worldSpace === 'world') {\n      const camera = context.scene.camera2D;\n      e[0] = e[4] = camera.zoom;\n      e[6] = -camera.position.x * camera.zoom + camera.renderOffset.x;\n      e[7] = -camera.position.y * camera.zoom + camera.renderOffset.y;\n    }",
  newBody =
    "    const e = out.elements;\n    if (context.root) out.copy(context.root.updateWorldMatrix()).invert();\n    else {\n      out.identity();\n      if (object.worldSpace === 'world') {\n        const camera = context.scene.camera2D;\n        e[0] = e[4] = camera.zoom;\n        e[6] = -camera.position.x * camera.zoom + camera.renderOffset.x;\n        e[7] = -camera.position.y * camera.zoom + camera.renderOffset.y;\n      }\n    }";
const paths = {
  webgl2: 'packages/graphics/src/webgl2-render2d.ts',
  webgpu: 'packages/graphics/src/webgpu-render2d.ts',
};
fs.mkdirSync(directory, { recursive: true });
for (const backend of ['webgl2', 'webgpu']) {
  const before = fs.readFileSync(root + '/' + paths[backend], 'utf8');
  if (before.split(oldBody).length !== 2)
    throw Error('Expected baseline mapping once');
  const after = await prettier.format(before.replace(oldBody, newBody), {
    ...config,
    parser: 'typescript',
  });
  const start = after.indexOf('  private objectMatrix('),
    end = after.indexOf('\n  private ', start + 1);
  if (start < 0 || end < 0) throw Error('Missing mapping method');
  const candidate = after
    .slice(start, end)
    .replace('  private objectMatrix(', 'function objectMatrixAfter273(');
  const className = backend === 'webgl2' ? 'WebGLRender2D' : 'WebGPURender2D';
  const extra = `\n${candidate}\nconst prototype273 = ${className}.prototype as unknown as {objectMatrix: typeof objectMatrixAfter273};\nconst before273 = prototype273.objectMatrix;\nlet selected273 = before273;\nprototype273.objectMatrix = function(this: ${className}, object: GameObject, context: Context2D, out: Matrix3, worldOnly = false): Matrix3 {return selected273.call(this, object, context, out, worldOnly);};\nexport function setMatrixVariant273(side: 'before' | 'after'): void {selected273 = side === 'after' ? objectMatrixAfter273 : before273;}\nexport function getMatrixVariant273(): string {return selected273 === before273 ? 'before' : selected273 === objectMatrixAfter273 ? 'after' : 'other';}\nexport function mappingProof273(object: GameObject, context: Context2D, out: Matrix3, worldOnly = false): Matrix3 {return selected273(object, context, out, worldOnly); }\n`;
  const emitted = ts.transpileModule(before + extra, {
    compilerOptions: {
      target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022,
      module: ts.ModuleKind.ES2022,
    },
  }).outputText;
  fs.writeFileSync(
    directory + '/shared-' + backend + '.mjs',
    await prettier.format(emitted, { ...config, parser: 'babel' }),
  );
}
fs.writeFileSync(
  directory + '/controller.mjs',
  "import * as gl from '/dist/packages/graphics/src/webgl2-render2d.js';\nimport * as gpu from '/dist/packages/graphics/src/webgpu-render2d.js';\nexport function setMatrixVariant273(side) {\n  gl.setMatrixVariant273(side);\n  gpu.setMatrixVariant273(side);\n}\nexport function getMatrixVariant273() {\n  const side = gl.getMatrixVariant273();\n  if (side !== gpu.getMatrixVariant273())\n    throw Error('Mismatched backend selection');\n  return side;\n}\nexport function mappingProof273(backend, ...args) {\n  return (backend === 'webgl2' ? gl : gpu).mappingProof273(...args);\n}\n",
);
```

```js
import * as gl from '/dist/packages/graphics/src/webgl2-render2d.js';
import * as gpu from '/dist/packages/graphics/src/webgpu-render2d.js';
export function setMatrixVariant273(side) {
  gl.setMatrixVariant273(side);
  gpu.setMatrixVariant273(side);
}
export function getMatrixVariant273() {
  const side = gl.getMatrixVariant273();
  if (side !== gpu.getMatrixVariant273())
    throw Error('Mismatched backend selection');
  return side;
}
export function mappingProof273(backend, ...args) {
  return (backend === 'webgl2' ? gl : gpu).mappingProof273(...args);
}
```

```js
        config.empty || config.offscreen ? pixel.nonuniform : !pixel.nonuniform
      )
        throw Error('Unexpected probe pixels for ' + config.name);
      hashes.push(crypto.createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex'));
    }
    if (hashes[0] !== hashes[1]) throw Error('Shared Game probe pixels differ');
    for (let round = 0; round < 6; round++) {
      const order =
          round % 2 === 0
            ? ['before', 'after', 'after', 'before']
            : ['after', 'before', 'before', 'after'],
        samples = [];
      for (const side of order) {
        const sample = await page.evaluate(
          (args) => globalThis.sampleGame273(args),
          { side, frames: 48 },
        );
        if (sample.matrixVariant !== (mode === 'aa' ? 'before' : side))
          throw Error('Wrong timed mapping method');
        samples.push({ side, ...sample });
      }
      rows.push({ name: config.name, round, order: order.join(','), samples });
    }
    const cleanup = await page.evaluate(() => globalThis.cleanupGame273());
    if (cleanup.length !== 1) throw Error('Not one shared Game');
    cohortProof.push({
      config,
      setup,
      oneSharedGame: true,
      oneSharedCanvas: true,
      preTimingNativeProbe: true,
      matchingPngSha256: hashes[0],
      nonuniform,
      cleanup,
    });
  }
  const result = {
    phase,
    mode,
    fixedMatrixTrampolineSelection: true,
    sameCoreGraph: true,
    matrixStartedAt,
    matrixCompletedAt: Date.now(),
    browser: browserIdentity('chromium', browser, launch),
    cohortProof,
    rows,
    errors,
  };
  fs.writeFileSync(
    directory + '/' + mode + '-game-results.json',
    JSON.stringify(result),
  );
  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(
      {
        phase,
        browser: result.browser,
        cohorts: cohortProof,
        rows: rows.length,
        samples: rows.length * 4,
        errors,
      },
      null,
      2,
    ),
  );
  if (errors.length) throw Error(errors.join('\n'));
} finally {
  await browser?.close();
  await server.close();
}
```

```sh
cmp /tmp/xyz-p273/shared-webgpu.mjs /tmp/xyz-p273/reconstruction-proof/shared-webgpu.mjs
```

## P274 — 不採用 constructor-time particle endpoint spans

UTC記錄時間：2026-11-17T17:13:11.037Z；baseline P273 commit c36da688f，runtime仍為P272。套件1.23.0，不push。本輪只提交六份證據文件，候選未進正式source／dist。

### 調查、候選與正確性硬指標

- ParticleEmitter constructor的pair/color會複製caller endpoints，且沒有公開reconfiguration setter。Sprite active batch已在迴圈外計算spans，但newborn appearance與target-layer writeTargetAppearance每次都取六個end-start差值。source尺寸則有合法變動生命週期，既有每tick refresh/memo不能改成constructor固定值。
- 候選把已由引擎擁有的normalized endSize/endColor tuples原地轉為sizeSpan/colorSpan，移除舊private endpoints；public options與錯誤文字不變。沒有新增正式arrays/fields、constant-endpoint特例或跨tick source-size cache。原先的start＋span×progress以及之後除尺寸／world axes乘法順序保留，signed zero不以return-start shortcut處理。Sprite batch、newborn appearance、target appearance三個路徑全部一起切換。未量測配置或heap，不把source結構當heap收益。
- 實驗僅一個canonical emitter class與core graph，保留原endpoints，再用slice複製兩個tuples並原地做差供候選讀取，保留normalized-array representation的來源；兩個side始終有同樣的額外fixture欄位／tuple。正式候選則不需額外tuples。三個候選methods在module init捕獲後移出prototype，再各裝一次固定trampoline，samples只切private function bindings，getter確保三者選擇一致。Scene仍以真正ParticleEmitter instance前進；不是兩個class或fake emitter。
- 288組確定性actual-core cases：Sprite/target×local/world×equal/changing/zero endpoints×point/rectangle/circle nozzle×八seed。每組九個snapshot steps，合計2592 steps、265800個finite Object.is數字比較通過，含signed zero、caller-owned arrays在constructor不被改寫、constructor後修改inputs不成為live config、rate births、expiry、stop/clear/reemit。source尺寸有普通16×16與cropped7×5，world birth受旋轉／負scale parent影響。這是原生ImageBitmap與真實core物件的數值proof，明確不是GPU rendering proof。
- 另有66個Sprite/target layer動態Game cases（各11 modes×Canvas2D/WebGL2/WebGPU），562716個Object.is數字與nonblank PNG一致，2178個真實destroy callbacks；borrowed Texture不被Game銷毀，顯式Texture.destroy關閉native bitmap。native每個side在constructor/emit前及每個actual Game frame前明確選中該side；after WebGL2 target-world圖片有開啟查看。
- fixed CPU：四個8192-capacity emitter、32768 active particles（small每個128，empty為零）、WebGL2／1280×720／pixelRatio1、static endpoint style、零velocity/acceleration、lifetime1e6、rectangle births512×256。五個layer targets（local/world、各isolated與small）加Sprite-local/Sprite-world/empty-layer三個controls。不以changing-input時序不同的PNG當同圖；timing使用static style，changing endpoints由獨立確定性probe覆蓋。

### 固定配對結果與不採用原因

先八cohort A/A 192samples，再同八cohort A/B 192samples，共384samples／18432量測frames。每cohort只有一個Game/Scene/renderer/canvas/pool；setup明確before65frames，兩個選擇各真正render9-frame probe且nonblank/blank control如預期、matching PNG，再六輪交替ABBA/BAAB，每sample8warm＋48measured。sentinel life expiry確認真的Scene advance；無update/destroy listeners，各sample/cleanup的callbacks與listener counts皆零。A/A labels皆實際before；A/B 96before/96after，已逐sample核對。

不採用。A/B layer-local-large afterUpdate paired median +2.3640386163982967%（+37.5000006364038µs，四輪慢），sum +2.524207167109396%（+112.50000027939632µs，四輪慢）；world-large afterUpdate -1.6670197402829128%（四輪快）、sum -1.4557234750062977%（五輪快），屬條件性收益。local/world-isolated sum分別 +0.6668010642782712%／-0.09161415178917025%，都是3/3方向；small-layer sum +5.183771504293545%（四輪慢）。

Sprite-local control afterUpdate -11.96385123934397%（六輪快），但Sprite-world submit +4.088889157439937%（+254.1666673496361µs，六輪慢），world-control sum +2.521599860039996%（五輪慢）。不能把未直接優化的submit或controls所有差異都歸因span；A/A本身也有大幅變化：Sprite-local sum +2.397789279075213%（五輪慢），small-layer sum -9.597373239456429%（四輪快），world-isolated sum +1.1704166647231347%（五輪慢）。全部raw／ties／outliers與五項分項保留，不減A/A median、不重跑挑方向，也不臆測已確認JIT/GC因果。

static source少六個差值不等於JIT實際少六個每粒子運算；編譯器可能已hoist/elide，這裡沒有測機器指令或證明單一機制。額外fixture tuples/class layout、mutable call targets、warmup/tiering/inlining與時序限制source-slot外推；不能將這些timings當正式production／CJS／GPU／FPS或heap認證。僅記錄Chromium desktop automation，非physical／Safari或其他瀏覽器。
